Moreover, it can approach the performance of RZF precoding after few iterations.

articleTitle: Network Recovery for Large-scale Failures in Smart Grid by Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: With the continuous development of smart grid, communication security become increasingly important. In order to cope with the impact of large-scale natural disasters or malicious attacks on grid communication and ensure the continuous and stable operation of the smart grid, this paper proposes a large-scale failures recovery method for power communication networks based on fault link weight values. First, the probability of the failure of the service path is calculated by the reinforcement learning, and then the weight value of each damaged link is obtained according to the link recovery resource and the probability. Secondly, a faulty link recovery model based on the fault link weight value is established so as to recover more failed services on the premise of limited recovery resources. Finally, in order to further optimize the faulty link recovery model, this paper establishes a Q-based link recovery model, and compares it with other algorithm simulation results to verify the feasibility of this method. The experimental results show that the fault link recovery combination obtained by the large-scale failures recovery method proposed in this paper can meet the requirements of a certain recovery resource and make the failed service more recoverable, thus ensuring the safe and stable operation of the power communication network.

articleTitle: An Improved Cuckoo search Algorithm for Optimizing the Beam Patterns of the Random Antenna Arrays
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Collaborative beamforming (CB) techniques have been introduced in wireless sensor networks to improve the transmission distance of a single sensor node. The biggest challenge for using CB is how to suppress the high sidelobe level (SLL). In this paper, an improved cuckoo search algorithm (IPCS) is proposed. In the case of optimizing the position coordinates of the array nodes, the dynamic adjustment of the discovery probability and an improved adaptive strategy of step size parameter are designed, to improve the convergence rate and the local searching ability of conventional CS algorithm, thereby making it suitable for optimizing the beam patterns of the distributed random antenna array (RAA). The performance of this novel method is compared with other intelligent optimization algorithms. Simulation results show that the proposed algorithm achieve better performance in terms of SLL suppression.

articleTitle: Minimum Completion Time Offloading Algorithm for Mobile Edge Computing
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In order to reduce the load of cloud services and the task completion time in mobile edge computing environment, this paper proposes the link selection strategy with the maximum equivalent bandwidth from the perspective of communication. Through the simulation results, it is verified that the maximum equivalent bandwidth strategy proposed in this paper can greatly reduce the task transmission time of edge servers compared with the traditional random selection strategy and stability strategy. Under the premise of the maximum equivalent bandwidth, this paper analyzes and compares with flooding algorithm, minimum execution time algorithm and minimum completion time algorithm. The results show that computing offloading of MEC based on the maximum equivalent bandwidth can cut down the task completion time.

articleTitle: An object Detection System Based on YOLOv2 in Fashion Apparel
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Object detection of fashion apparel items is an indispensable technical condition for fashion industry and e-commerce. To address this need, this paper constructs an object detection system (YOLOv2-opt) based on the YOLOv2. In this work, we innovatively combine deep convolutional neural network with fashion apparel items detection. Compared with the traditional machine learning algorithms and semantic segmentation, the method based on deep neural network can locate and classify objects fast and better. Since the characteristics of fashion apparel detection, we propose an optimization for the input and network layers of YOLOv2 in order to improve the detection performance. The types of fashion items we consider in this work include trousers, skirts, coats, T-shirts, bags. Through the experiments, we evidence that our system has achieved an average precision of 0.839 and average recall rate of 0.73, detection speed reached 56ms per picture. Our optimized system is more exact than the YOLOv2.

articleTitle: Research on Smart Household Appliance System Based on NB-IoT and Cloud Platform
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In this paper, a smart household appliance system based on NB-IoT technology and OceanConnect cloud platform is designed. The system mainly takes BC-95 as NB-IoT module and MSP430 as MCU to build the hardware system, combined with OceanConnect cloud platform to implement smart household appliance verification system. The system can realize communication between NB-IoT device and cloud platform based on CoAP protocol: device collects data and reports it to the cloud platform, and the cloud platform sends commands to the device. The test results show that the verification system can realize the communication between NB-IoT device and cloud platform, satisfying design requirements.

articleTitle: Research on LSTM-Based Load Prediction for Edge Data Centers
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In order to meet the demands of the application scenarios for the fifth-generation (5G), such as high transmission rate and low delay, the concept of Mobile Edge Computing (MEC) was proposed in industry. By deploying some servers with computing and storage capabilities in mobile access networks, MEC could meet the above demands. However, there is a problem of uneven resource utilization in edge data centers (EDC) currently. Considering the mobility-related factors of EDC to predict the workloads of EDC, the prediction results are conducive to resource allocation, so that resources can be reasonably allocated to improve resource utilization. In order to perform accurate load prediction, this paper jointly considers user mobility and geographic location information of EDC, and proposes a method of load prediction based on Long-Short-Term Memory Networks (LSTM). Experiments show that the prediction accuracy of the proposed method is averagely improved by 4.21%, compared with the state-of-the-art Autoregressive Integrated Moving Average Model (ARIMA).

articleTitle: Dynamic Partitioning and Task Scheduling for Complex Workflow Healthcare Application in Mobile Edge Cloud Architecture
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In this paper, we are investigating the energy consumption of mobile devices and cloud resources (i.e., virtual machines) while viewing the application partitioning and task scheduling problem in the offloading system. However, offloading system enables mobile device to separate the application tasks into local execution parts and cloud server execution parts. To minimize the energy consumption of mobile devices along with cloud resources in the considered problem we have nominated a new dynamic application partitioning task scheduling (DAPTS) algorithm. Since, DAPTS aims is to efficiently dynamically partitioning the application into tasks and schedule them on the mobile device and cloud resources that one may minimize energy consumption of both mobile devices as well as cloud resources simultaneously. Experimental results show that propose DAPTS outperforms as compared to the baseline approaches.

articleTitle: Distributed Probability Random Access Scheme in Satellite IoT System
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Satellite Internet of Things (IoT) network where IoT terminals randomly access the wireless channel and transmit packets to satellites develops rapidly in recent years. Although great progress on satellite multiple access has been made in Random Access (RA) algorithms, packets loss and low throughput present an obstacle for satellite IoT network. A distributed transmission RA scheme is designed in this paper that each terminal independently decides whether to transmit a packet or stay idle. Each terminal decides the packet transmission probability by the situation of network traffic load known by the system information that is sent from satellite on a broadcast channel to terminals. This problem can be formulated as an optimization problem with mathematical method, and it can be solved by genetic algorithm (GA). The simulation results show that the scheme we proposed promotes network throughput and packet loss rate is controlled within a considerable range.

articleTitle: Simulation and Implementation of Spectrum Synthesis Method for Linear Modulated Stepped Frequency Signal Based on Spectral Extraction
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: High resolution radar and multi-mode seeker technologies are the important study subjects in the domain of precision homing guidance. As an instantaneous narrowband and synthetic wideband waveform, stepped frequency radar signal has been widely exploited in many applications, since it allows high range resolution with modest requirements of the system bandwidth. In this paper, the spectrum synthesis method for linear modulated stepped frequency (LMSF) signal based on spectral extraction is adopted to avoid the range profile ambiguity and energy leakage which are the key problems of conventional signal processing method. The principle of the spectrum synthesis method has been analyzed in detail. The simulation results show, it is more flexible to select the number and form of sub-pulses and both high detection performance and high resolution range profile (HRRP) can be obtained.

articleTitle: Rule-based Complex Event Processing on Tactical Moving Objects
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: On a battlefield, tactical moving objects, such as airplanes and tanks, need to track and monitor. It is crucial for headquarters to know the event occurrence, especially complex events, of the objects in real time, such as jet fighter invading and ship collision. However, radars or other sensors are only able to detect primitive and simple events of the tactical moving objects. It is a challenge to manage large amounts of incoming simple events and analyze their relationships to infer complex events in real time. In this paper, we provide a clear solution to dealing with the challenges by using complex event processing (CEP), which is able to extract meaningful complex events based on specified rules. We find that the events of tactical moving objects are spatial-temporal highly constrained. Based on that, we define and formalize the semantics of CEP rules on tactical moving objects. Within a CEP rule, there are several intermediate events occurring in a specified order and presenting in a hierarchical structure. A CEP management system has been built for capturing, filtering and adapting raw events, as well as generating complex events based on CEP rules. We evaluate our system by using simulated event data that generated by our other project based on several scenarios, such as jet fighter invading, battleship crashing and sinking.

articleTitle: A Divide and Conquer Approach to All Solutions Satisfiability Problem
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: SAT, is one of the fundamental topics in computer science, which has a long history in AI. As a variant of SAT, the all solutions satisfiability problem(AllSAT) is widely used in the field of electronic design automation. It is to generate all or part solutions of a given SAT instance. The computational complexity of AllSAT is higher than general SAT, which leads to less research related and poor performance of existing AllSAT solvers. In this paper, we propose to solve AllSAT by a divide-and-conquer-based approach called DIV2, which solve more instances within the time limit. Besides, we present a segmentation strategy for DIV2, called Jaccard similarity segmentation, which improves the efficiency of DIV2. The experimental result shows that the method proposed in this paper, has a better performance than the state-of-the-art algorithms, with regarding to the number of instances solved and the total number of solutions found for SAT 2014 competition benchmark.

articleTitle: The Reliability Mapping Monitoring Method of Network Function Virtualization
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: The traditional reliability monitoring method of network function virtualization neglects the virtual subnet configuration module, which leads to the lack of integrity of the method. With the increase of network function complexity, the monitoring accuracy will decline obviously. A new reliability mapping monitoring method for network architecture is proposed. The function of the virtual network configuration information is obtained through the virtual subnet configuration module. The virtual transmission module is used to connect the functional modules in the network virtualization system, obtain an overall mapping, and send a request to create a virtual subnet mapping. Finally, the mapping reliability detection module is used to receive the request of creating virtual subnet sent by virtual network transmission module. The experiment proves that compared with the traditional network function virtualization reliability monitoring method, the designed new mapping reliability monitoring method can increase the monitoring coincidence degree by 17% under the fixed complex network structure, which can effectively improve the reliability monitoring accuracy.

articleTitle: Coverage Optimization Based on Improved Firefly Algorithm for Mobile Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: The optimization of coverage for mobile wireless sensor networks has been analyzed presently, and various optimization algorithms arise in many researches. However, the issue of optimization on node distribution in wireless sensor networks has not been well solved, especially in low convergence efficiency of current firefly algorithm. To overcome this deficiency, a new deployment scheme based on improved firefly optimization algorithm is proposed. In our proposal, a novel updating method has been used, which replaces the location of two nodes at a time instead of updating every node location in traditional firefly algorithm. The improved scheme is devoted to move the nodes of the densest region quickly and rapidly reducing the density of the node distribution. Not only that, it makes the WSNs reaching the maximum coverage in the shortest time. The performance of the proposed algorithm is compared with the previous algorithms by simulations. The results show that the improved algorithm can achieve larger network coverage and get the better distribution of WSNs.

articleTitle: Neural Network Aided SC Decoder for Polar Codes
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Theoretically, conventional decoders for polar codes can be entirely replaced by neural network (NN) with enough size and enough training, which called NN decoder. But the exponentially increasing training complexity becomes unacceptable when information length increases, which means only decoders for short codes can be trained practically. However, a successive cancellation (SC) decoder for long polar codes can be divided into several SC decoders for short codes, which can be replaced by several short codes NN decoders, then the whole decoder becomes our NN aided SC (NNSC) decoder. Besides, we defined Universal Set of NN, which can be combined into NNSC decoders for any long polar codes. In this paper, the main purpose of constructing NNSC decoder is increasing decoding efficiency of polar codes by taking advantage of NN, and in the meantime ensuring an acceptable performance compared to conventional decoding algorithms.

articleTitle: Multi-Feature Fusion Using Collaborative Residual for Hyperspectral Palmprint Recognition
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Recently, hyperspectral imaging has attracted more and more considerable research attention because of its discriminative information. This paper presents a multiple feature fusion strategy for hyperspectral palmprint recognition, combining texture LBP feature, direction LDP feature and global deep convolutional feature (DCNN). Compared to single patterns, the proposed method is focused on the combined use to improve the distinguishability. The LBP, LDP and DCNN are applied to the hyperspectral palmprint images (of an individual) in order to extract its features forming three feature matrixes. Each matrix contains redundant information and long dimensions. Thus, the 2D-PCA is applied to reduce the dimension of every feature matrix and generates a uniform feature vector. At last, residuals of each patterns based on the collaborative representation between the test data and training data are fused. The collaborative residual of the three patterns is exploited on final recognition. The proposed methodology was experimented on a large hyperspectral palmprint dataset consisting of 53 spectral bands obtaining an EER of 0.11% and an accuracy of 99.76% at recognition.

articleTitle: A Clustering-Based Algorithm for Device-Free Localization in IoT
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Device-free localization (DFL) is an emerging technology for locating targets by monitoring the changes of radio frequency (RF) signals. It has many potential applications since this technology does not require the targets to participate in the localization effort by carrying any electronic device. In this paper, we propose a simple line-of-sight (LOS) model and hierarchical clustering filter and localization algorithm (HCFLA) to locate device-free targets. Radio signal strength (RSS) of wireless links in the internet of things was utilized to find out effected links whose attenuation is more than a threshold. We use the HCFLA algorithm to filter out the valueless points of the intersections of effected links, and then to infer the number and location of the targets with the remainder valuable points. The proposed algorithm is validated using measurement data. Results show that the proposed algorithm can detect the number of targets in high probability, and the localization average error reaches to 0.7 meter in 4.5* 4.5 meters indoor square area.

articleTitle: Floor Plan Classification Based on Transfer Learning
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: The floor plan is one of the most common ways to display details information about space or residence. However, traditional classifiers such as Logistic Regression (LR) or K-Nearest Neighbor (KNN) cannot effectively read the high-level information from the floor plan. Besides, the training process requires a large number of labeled data which is difficult to collect. However, transfer learning can deal with classification problems by using existing knowledge to solve different but related problems. This paper presents a method to distinguish the structure of floor plans based on convolutional neural network and multi-layer perceptron (MLP). Firstly, the paper uses a famous convolution neural network known as Visual Geometry Group (VGGNet) as a feature extractor to extract features of images. And then design a unique Auto-encoder to reduce the dimensionality of data. Finally, the multi-layer perceptron is intended to achieve the classification job. Compared with traditional machine learning models, this method improves the accuracy of classification and proves the transfer learning actually has a beneficial effect on structured image Classification.

articleTitle: A Non-Parametric Method for Curve Smoothing
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Curve fitting is widely used in various fields. Smoothness is an important index to evaluate the fitting effect. Smoothness spline is a widely used and good smoothness method. However, the principle derivation of this method is complex, and the time complexity of the algorithm is high. As the number of data points increases, the running time will greatly increase. This paper presents a method of fitting curves by moving data points continuously. This method does not need to calculate any coefficient and has very low time complexity. Experiments show that the algorithm has good smoothing effect and short running time.

articleTitle: An Improved Fusion Algorithm of Path Planning for Automated Guided Vehicle in Storage System
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of large computation, poor real-time performance and GNRON (goals no reachable with obstacle nearby), an improved fusion algorithm of path planning for AGV (automated guided vehicle) in storage system is proposed in this paper, which combines the improved A* algorithm and the improved artificial potential field algorithm. The proposed algorithm features an innovative decision module, which could realize the self-invoking between the global path planning algorithm and local path planning algorithm to adapt to different storage environments. The simulation and experiment results verify the rationality and feasibility of the algorithm, proving its favorable prospects for application.

articleTitle: Fast Motion Estimation Algorithm for High Efficient Video Coding
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: High Efficient Video Coding(HEVC) is the latest generation of video compression standard after Advanced Video Coding(AVC). Which meets the video coding requirements of high-definition and high-definition video, and its real-time performance has been improved too. Inter prediction coding is one of the most frequently used methods in HEVC coding. Whether it is at the coding side or the decoding side, the motion search takes most time in the inter prediction. In the HEVC standard software HM, Test zone (TZ) Search has been used to replace the full search algorithm, which saves a lot of time on motion search, but it is still far from enough. This article proposes a fast search method based on neighbor blocks' move vector (MV). And the relationship between the Inter_2N×2N mode PU with the other modes of PU is used to judge whether narrow the search range. The experimental results show that the proposed algorithm saves about 23.5% motion estimation(ME) time and 19.37% total encoding time compared to TZ Search, and the bit consumption is basically negligible.

articleTitle: Network-Balanced Algorithm Based on Hierarchical Subnet Space for Software-Defined Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Software defined wireless sensor network (SDWSN) is a new network architecture for sensor networks. It provides an information monitoring and management technology solution for wireless sensor network, and has become a research hot spot in recent years. Despite the advantages of SDWSN, there are still some unavoidable problems such as over concentrated load and imbalanced energy consumption with the increase of network scale. To deal with the shortages of load and energy balance in SDWSN, we propose a new hierarchical subnet space based network balance algorithm. The proposed algorithm innovatively optimizes the network structure and forwarding rules of SDWSN. Fog computing is also applied to reduce packet transmission requirement, which helps to further balance load and reduce energy consumption. In our optimized network structure, the whole network is divided into several subnets and sub-controllers are selected for each subnet. Sensor data packets are collected and compressed in the sub-controller and sent to the center controller along the path consisted of sun-controllers. Simulation results show that our proposed algorithm performs better than other existed algorithms in load balancing and energy saving.

articleTitle: Exploiting an Unmanned Aerial Vehicle for Energy Efficient Data Collection in Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In this paper, an energy efficient data collection algorithm is proposed for Wireless Sensors Networks employing a single Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV-WSNs). In the system, since the position and the data amount of sensors are stochastic, the UAV as a relay scans the area along a fixed path to collect the data of all sensors. Energy saving is the main challenge to prolong the life time of the sensors. The main research of this paper is to reduce the energy consumption of all sensors by jointly optimizing the flight trajectory of UAV, the time schedule and the power of the sensor to transmit data. The original problem can be formulated as a non-convex and mixed-integer optimization problem. According to the number of sensors in the communication area of the UAV, we studied the problem by dividing it into a single sensor and multiple sensors case. Moreover, the successive convex optimization techniques and differential evolution algorithm are applied to solve the problem. Finally, we performed extensive simulations to compare our proposed algorithms with benchmark algorithms. The simulation results show that the proposed algorithm is better than the benchmark algorithm.

Index Terms: Speed Of The Unmanned Aerial Vehicles

articleTitle: Application of Artificial Neural Network in HRV Analysis
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: HRV reflects the tension and balance of cardiac nerve activity, and it is a non-invasive index to detect autonomic nervous activity. In recent decades, the relationship has been fully affirmed between autonomic nervous activity and a variety of diseases through a lot of studies, especially mortality rate of some cardiovascular diseases, especially the rate of sudden death. Therefore, on the basis of application of the artificial neural Network to HRV analysis, the HRV signals can be preliminary identified through the application of error Back Propagation Network (Back Propagation Network, BP Network) and its improved algorithm. Through parameter setup and training test on different algorithms of neural network, the result shows that the additional momentum method is used when the number of hidden nodes is 10 and the learning rate is 0.5 (momentum learning rate is 0.3), which can ensure that the correct rate of training and detection and recognition of the whole neural network is 93.96% and the stability is good. The artificial neural network algorithm is applied to the HRV analysis, which provides a new research field and application space for ECG intelligent analysis.

articleTitle: Truth Discovery on Categorical Multi-Valued Attributes with Source Relations
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In the era of big data, a mass of data fusion applications need to obtain accurate and complete attribute information about various objects. Most existing truth discovery methods are for single-valued attributes, which will be invalid for multi-valued attributes. They are usually based on the assumption that the data sources are independent of each other. It is not in line with the reality that related relationship occurs between them. Since multi-valued attributes are at large discrete, this paper proposes a truth discovery method incorporating the qulity and the correlations of data sources, namely Categorical Multi-Truths Finder algorithm (CMTF), which iteratively derives the accuracy and the recall rate of data source along with the truth set for each attribute. The experimental results show that CMTF outperforms the state-of-the-art.

articleTitle: Research on Digital Instantaneous Frequency Measurement Based on Passive Positioning System
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: The passive microwave detection and positioning technology is introduced into the low-altitude area alert and azimuth system for near-earth ground. The technique of single pulse orientation measurement receiver and digital instantaneous frequency measurement are used to locate the pulse description word (PDW) of the enemy target parameters. This paper studies an instantaneous frequency measurement technique using a seven-channel digital delay line frequency discriminating system in the frequency range of 8 to 18 GHz, and monitors and corrects the frequency measurement error caused by temperature in real time. Theoretically, it has a high accuracy of frequency measurement.

articleTitle: CRC-aided Iterative Decoding of Turbo-hadamard Codes
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Turbo-hadamard codes is an excellent low-rate turbo-type codes, but the decoding cost increases rapidly when the number of iterations increases with large parallel branches. This paper proposes a CRC-aided iterative decoding method to reduce the number of iterations while suffering no performance degradation. At each iteration, we perform Cyclic Redundancy Check (CRC) on the resulting bit sequence, and stop once it passes CRC to avoid unnecessary iterations. Otherwise, we generate multiple candidate paths based on the smallest corresponding LLRs. Then we perform CRC again until a first one passes CRC or reaches the maximum number of paths. Simulations show that this scheme can effectively reduce the number of iterations. Compared to the 2-state turbo-hadamard codes, the frame error rate increases by 1.1 dB at 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup> and the bit error rate increases by 0.9 dB at 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-5</sup> with 240-bit pseudo-random interleaving on the additive white Gaussian noise channel.

articleTitle: Fake Access Point Localization Based on Optimal Reference Points
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Wireless access points (APs) are widely used for jointing smart devices into networks. However, wireless communication brings many security issues, especially, personal privacy disclosure brought by fake APs. Previous works mainly focused on detecting whether there are fake APs and enabling users to choose reliable APs. The existing methods do solve some problems, but they have certain limitations on the client side. Therefore, we propose a simple and effective method of locating the fake Ap with a smartphone and removing it, which not only avoid the interference of the fake AP to legitimate APs, but also ensure subsequent users to directly access the secure AP without cumbersome verification processes. The positioning algorithm proposed considers the influence of reference points on the positioning accuracy, and it can obtain optimal coordinates of reference points through distance measurement algorithm. Finally, we evaluated the performance of our proposed solution in comparison to the existing method that is based on pre-installed reference points. The results show that our proposed solution can achieve better positioning accuracy.

articleTitle: Convolutional Neural Network-based Simple Online Multiple Object Tracking
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Online multiple object tracking (MOT) is difficult when multiple objects have similar appearance or under occlusion. Detections and appearance feature play an important role in MOT, but the distinguishing ability of traditional hand-draft appearance feature is in sufficient. This paper explores a pragmatic method to extract more robust appearance feature using convolutional neural network. We adopt the detection results processing by the state of art detector and extract the appearance feature by a convolutional neural network. In our method, the motion state is firstly estimated by Kalman filter. Then the appearance feature is further combined with the motion state to estimate the affinity scores between different detections and associated trajectories. Finally, detections are assigned to their corresponding trajectories by Hungarian algorithm. Our method has been test on standard MOT dataset MOT16, the evaluation results confirmed that combine motion state with the appearance information extracted neural network is efficient for tracking multiple objects continually and stably.

articleTitle: Frequency Offset Estimation Algorithm of VDES Signals Based on Cross-Correlation
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In VHF data exchange system(VDES), in order to solve the wide-range frequency offset problem of VHF data exchange-satellite (VDE-SAT) downlink, a frequency offset estimation algorithm for VDES Signals based on crosscorrelation was proposed. Firstly, character sequence and different Doppler frequency offset is available for the construction of local sequence, which is used of intercorrelation analysis with received signal to get a coarse estimation. Then, the rough estimated value compensated to received signal for eliminating the phase folding caused by argument calculation of the signal autocorrelation function. Finally, the proposed method overcomes the contradiction problem between high accuracy and wide extent of frequency offset estimation. Simulation results show that the range of the proposed algorithm can reach -4000Hz~4000Hz, and its accuracy is approximate to the Cramer-Rao bound. This estimation algorithm is reasonable for used of VDES receiver.

articleTitle: Scatter Inpainting Algorithm for Rain or Snow Removal in a Single Image
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Bad weather will lead to the decline of image quality of outdoor acquisition, especially the rain or snow weather. At present, most of the raindrops or snowflakes removing methods are focused on video, while there are few studies on single image rain or snow removal. In this paper a scatter inpainting algorithm to remove the raindrops or snowflakes in a single image is be proposed. In order to fully consider the boundary information of damaged region, the proposed method continuously to scan the pixel color values near the seed points with scatter lines and fill the damaged region, and repaired from outside to inside. The experiment results show that the proposed method could remove the raindrops or snowflakes, and retain most image details in a single image.

articleTitle: Hybrid Kernel LSSVM Model for Prediction of Short-Term Wind Speed
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In order to improve the prediction accuracy of short-term wind speed, a model based on Cuckoo Search (CS) optimized hybrid kernel Least Squares Support Vector Machine (LSSVM) is proposed. The algorithm first preprocesses the signal by Empirical Wavelet Transform (EWT), and filters out a part of noise interference. Then, combining advantages of the two kinds of LSSVM kernel functions, a hybrid kernel function LSSVM with comprehensive performance is constructed. Finally, with the help of CS algorithm, four parameters of the hybrid kernel LSSVM model are optimized, and performance of the algorithm is further improved. The validation of real wind speed data shows that the model can predict short-term wind speed effectively.

articleTitle: Research on Simulation of Cluster Routing Protocol for Industrial Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: LEACH protocol is one of the most important routing protocols in wireless sensor networks (WSNs). LEACH protocol is a hierarchical routing protocol based on clustering. To a certain extent, the LEACH protocol balances the energy consumption of every node; However, because the sensor nodes are mostly powered by batteries, the energy is limited, and the shortcomings of the LEACH protocol will cause premature death. In this paper, from the perspective of improving energy efficiency, an improved protocol based on LEACH protocol-l-LEACH-EQ protocol is put forward. Through simulation and comparison of MATLAB, it is concluded that the improved protocol has obvious advantages and can extend the working time of the whole network. The experimental results show that the improved routing protocol has a certain improvement in the node's survival time, energy consumption and so on.

articleTitle: Data-Dependent Tasks Re-scheduling Energy Efficient Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: A data-dependent task re-scheduling algorithm is present. First, the task priority is set to the sum of the up-rank and the down-rank of tasks, and the critical path and the critical resources of the task graph are calculated using the priority. Second, the corresponding resources of the scheduled task are selected based on the principle of the earliest finish time. And the tasks on the critical path are only scheduled only on the critical resources, which can generate an initial tasks scheduling scheme. Then, the energy efficiency values of each resource under the initial scheduling scheme are calculated. The resource with the lowest energy efficiency value from the resource set is removed and closed. Finally, update the set of available resources to perform a re-scheduling of the tasks using the same principles and aiming for the optimal resources with the low-efficiency resource closed. The analysis of example show that our algorithm performs better on the scheduling length and the energy consumption under the both homogeneous and heterogeneous resources.

articleTitle: CSI-Based Device-Free Indoor Localization Using Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Device-free indoor localization is an emerging technology enabling the localization of a target without equipped any devices in an area of interest, which is widely applied in the field of security and home care. Interrupted by the multipath effect, previous Received Signal Strength (RSS) based localization systems often suffer from low accuracy when localization. Motivated by this, we explore the stability of channel state information (CSI) in IEEE 802.11n and propose a device-free indoor localization system based on CSI through convolutional neural networks (CNN), where we combine the space diversity, time diversity and frequency diversity of CSI to design the more abundant localization features. Moreover, we use a denoising method to improve the efficiency of extracting features from the human body's influence on the CSI and improve the accuracy of the localization. The experiment demonstrates that the average accuracy of the proposed method could reach more than 97% in a typical office.

articleTitle: A TE Process Fault Diagnosis Method Based on Improved Wavelet Threshold Denoising and Principal Component Analysis
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: A large amount of noise is mixed in the actual process industrial data, which leads to a decline in data quality, which in turn affects the diagnosis results. In reality, the wavelet threshold method is generally used to remove noise. However, the hard threshold method which is in the wavelet threshold method has the disadvantages of poor signal continuity and signal oscillating. The soft threshold method has the disadvantages of constant deviation and large error of reconstructed signal. To this end, we propose a random soft-hard threshold algorithm which can combine hard and soft thresholds. Then the new algorithm is combined with the principal component analysis for fault diagnosis of the TE (Tennessee Eastman) process. The MATLAB simulation results show that the above method can effectively denoise, identify and detect faults more accurately, and can better find the variables that have the greatest impact on the fault.

Author Keywords: random soft and hard threshold method

articleTitle: Distance-Based Outlier Mining for Time Series of Police Calls for Service
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: A time series of continuous daily police calls for service can be used to measure patterns of social safety. In this article, outliers in the hourly pattern of police calls for service in Beijing, China are mined using a distance-based outlier mining (DBOM) technique. First, police calls for service are partitioned into 24 hourly counts (attributes) across each respective day in the dataset. Principle Component Analysis (PCA) is then used to process the data, in turn reducing the total attributes from 24 to two. Next, the DBOM method is used to mine outliers. Those outliers are then matched with the identifiable social or economic events. Results provide further support for ecological theories of crime in that they correspond with traditional holidays such as Spring Festival and New Year.

articleTitle: Analysis on Control Performance Assessment Based on Minimum entropy
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Most practical industry control systems are neither linear nor Gaussian. The performance of this kind control system cannot be described only by mean and variance. The minimum entropy control is effective method to solve this problem. Performance assessment benchmark based on minimum entropy is researched. The limitation of CPA based on the minimum variance benchmark is analyzed in this paper. Then the evaluation process of the minimum entropy control system is researched in this paper. Afterwards, influence factors of performance assessment benchmark based on minimum entropy are analyzed. Lastly, the simulation shows that the effective point distribution can improve the accuracy of performance assessment.

articleTitle: Throughput Analysis in Collaborative Communication Based on Relay Energy Harvesting
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Wireless powered relaying is a promising cooperative communication technique which has drawn much attention recently. In this paper, we consider the problem of throughput maximization based on relay energy collection in wireless cooperative communication system. When source node transmits radio-frequency (RF) signal with two antennas, relay without initial energy starts to collect energy from RF signal, when collected energy reaches the preset fixed transmission power, relay begin to amplify-and-forward information received from source to destination. We propose two models of energy harvesting (EH) model at the relay-continuous time EH and discrete time EH. For continuous time EH, the EH time can be any percentage of the total transmission block time. For discrete time EH, the whole transmission block is either used for EH or information transmission (IT). The simulation results are perfectly matched with the derived throughput expression, which show the correctness of the expression. The simulation results also show that throughput of the proposed discrete time EH model is better than that of the continuous time EH model.

articleTitle: Improved Dynamic Programming for the Shortes Path Problem with Resource Constraints in DAG
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In this work, we present the design and implementation of an efficient yet flexible solution framework for the shortest path problem with resource constraints, which is a critical subproblem in a bunch of optimization problems in the airline industry. We especially focus on directed acyclic graph since graphs in our application are acyclic by definition. Several improving strategies have been devised to improve the performance of the classical labeling algorithm based on dynamic programming. We apply the skyline algorithms to speed up the computation of pareto-optimal labels. We improve data locality and computational efficiency of label dominance with a specialized memory management strategy. Bi-directional dynamic programming techniques are also applied to further improve the performance. Numerical experiments on internal benchmark problems show that our implementation is in general an order of magnitude faster than that of the Boost Graph Library.

articleTitle: Hybrid Resource Allocation Algorithm Based on Spectrum Sharing and Separation in Ultra-Dense Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In an ultra-dense network, Femtocell Base Station is deployed in large numbers in order to deal with massive amounts of user communication data. How to allocate resources to users efficiently under limited resources is particularly important. We propose a spectrum allocation and separation based hybrid spectrum resource allocation scheme. In this scheme, first the FBS is clustered according to the interference, and the macro base station and the FBS with small interference to it use spectrum sharing to increase the system capacity. The macro base station and the FBS cluster that interferes with it are separated by frequency spectrum, which can effectively avoid cross-layer interference. Finally, according to the optimization objectives and constraints proposed by the scheme, the Lagrangian dual decomposition method is used to solve the FBS cluster, and the optimal spectrum resource allocation result is obtained.

articleTitle: PAPR Reduction via Degree of Freedom from Multiple Antennas in Large-Scale MIMO-OFDM Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Due to the high spectral efficiency and robustness against frequency-selective fading channels, large-scale multiple-input multiple-output orthogonal frequency-division multiplexing (MIMO-OFDM) has become a promising technology for 5G communication systems. However, large-scale MIMO-OFDM is also faced with the problem of high peak-to-average power ratio (PAPR) caused by multicarrier signals. In this paper, an algorithm, which uses the degree of freedom provided by massive antenna arrays, is proposed to reduce the PAPR in large-scale MIMO-OFDM systems. The proposed algorithm, constructing a PAPR reduction signal in the null space of channel matrix, exhibits good PAPR reduction performance. To reduce the complexity, a suboptimal algorithm is also presented. Simulation results verify the advantages of the proposed algorithms.

articleTitle: Structural Design of Operational Analysis and State Modeling for Power Secondary System
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: With the continuous expansion of the monitoring scope of power secondary systems and the continuous improvement of network security requirements, many safety equipment and business systems are operating in the system. They produce a large amount of raw security data and operation monitoring data. At present, these data are isolated from each other. it makes control of the system's overall operational status and security risks a challenge. In order to realize the monitoring of the overall operating status of power secondary systems and cross-asset collaborative security data mining analysis. This paper presents a non-supervised machine learning based power system analysis and state modeling. First, design a set of asset model rules for secondary power systems. It builds the host equipment, network equipment, security equipment, and business system itself running in the existing business system into an organic whole. Afterwards, we used intelligent machine learning techniques to “draw” the “contours” of normal operation of each business. It provides a contour model for overall system operation analysis and threat warning. Finally, based on this model and real-time analysis technology, we aggregate the data distributed in various business systems in real time. It provides comprehensive support for operation monitoring and safety protection of power secondary systems.

articleTitle: Democratic Supervision Makes Controls in Software-Defined Networks More Secure
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: The centralized control of Software-Defined Networking (SDN) brings innovation and convenience to the network, but many current SDN controllers also have some security bugs that are easily exploited by attackers. Once the master controller which has sufficient management rights is compromised, entire network can be damaged. For this, we propose a mechanism of democratic supervision in SDN, which adds a proxy between the control plane and the data plane to monitor whether the master controller is abnormal. The proxy sends OpenFlow requests from the switch to multiple diverse controllers and collects flow entries that they respond to. Then it compares these flow entries to judge whether the behavior of the master controller is different from that of other controllers. However, flow entries with the same function may be different in number or content, so we need to analyze their forwarding semantics to compare them, instead of simply comparing their contents. The advantage of this supervision mechanism is that it allows the controller to defend against many known or unknown attacks without debugging all its vulnerabilities. Experimental results show that it is effective in detecting malicious behavior, and it is also efficient under a certain scale of networks.

articleTitle: The Attribute-weight Cache Replacement Algorithm for Encrypted Files
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: For the purpose of improving the cache hit rate for encrypted files, a new cache replacement algorithm based on the access tree of files encrypted by CP-ABE - minimum similarity of attribute-weight algorithm (Minimal Attribute-Weight Similarity, MAWS) is proposed. The algorithm counts the number of attributes in the access tree and computes the weight of attribute. It creates a high frequency attribute-weight table to record the attributes that accessed by high frequency. It uses Pearson correlation coefficient and size of file to calculate the similarity of attribute-weight. The file with the minimum value of similarity of attribute-weight has the priority to be replaced. In experiment, the MAWS algorithm can get higher byte hit rate and higher hit rate of encrypted files by comparing with algorithms of FIFO (First-In First-Out), LRU (Least Recently Used), LFU (Least-Frequently-Used) and SIZE.

articleTitle: A Feedback Scheduling Algorithm Based on Resource Reservation
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of dynamic change of realtime system load, this paper proposes a resource reservation-based feedback scheduling model for soft real-time tasks, which can dynamically adjusts the CPU bandwidth of the server when the system load changes. The simulation experiment is carried out on the RTSim platform. Compared with the traditional scheduling algorithm, the experimental results show that the proposed scheduling algorithm has better performance.

articleTitle: A Robust Algorithm for Go Image Recognition in Go Game
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In this paper, image of go game recognition is proposed based on Hough transform algorithm. Firstly, preprocess the go image to reduce the amount of noise. Secondly, locate four corner coordinates by Hough transform to detect lines of unoccupied board for the opening of the game. Next, most significant difference from previous work is our use of simple geometric transformation model and in process of finding the grid. Another significant improvement is the use of Hough transform for circle around intersection to locate the piece. Finally, for each intersection, compute average brightness values around it and K-Means algorithm can be determined to quantize the colors. Experimental result in abundant go images shows that the proposed method has a good recognition performance on go images of different views, go boards and a certain degree of illumination nonuniformity.

articleTitle: Detection of Hepatolithiasis in CT Images for Image-Guided Surgery
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Hepatolithiasis is endemic in the Asia-Pacific region, where its prevalence can be as high as 30-50%. Complete cure of hepatolithiasis requires both extraction of the stones and elimination of bile stasis through surgery, and therefore it is essential to detect hepatolithiasis at an earlier stage. The easiest way to diagnose hepatolithiasis is by Computed Tomography (CT) images. The detection/segmentation of hepatolithiasis from CT images is an important prerequisite for computer-aided diagnosis, treatment planning, and monitoring of hepatolithiasis. In this paper, a novel and efficient method is proposed for the easy detection of this deadly disease in CT volumes based on the well-known segmentation methods and morphological operations. The detection process involves the pre-processing of input images, image segmentation and morphological operations which helps to identify the presence of hepatolithiasis which in this case is the presence of small stones. The proposed method is validated on sixteen liver CT images provided by the First Affiliated Hospital of Guangzhou Medical University. A sensitivity of 100% and an accuracy of 95% were obtained.

articleTitle: A Sliding Window Based Efficient Transmission for Underwater Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Underwater sensor networks (UWSNs) are different from terrestrial wireless sensor networks that rely on medium waves like electromagnetic waves. In underwater scenarios, underwater acoustic communication has the characteristics of low bandwidth, high latency, low packet delivery ratio, high interference and high energy consumption, which makes higher requirements for underwater communication. Reliability and effectiveness are two major concerns for routing protocols in UWSNs. In this paper, a sliding window based efficient transmission(SWT) is proposed to address the problem of low delivery ratio. In SWT, the source node is allowed to send multiple packets continuously before stopping and waiting for an acknowledgment. There is no need for the senders to wait for an acknowledgment when a packet is sent, which can aggravate the delivery of the packet. If the packet is lost or transmitted incorrectly, the selective repeat ARQ protocol will be executed. Simulation results show that the proposed protocol outperforms other routing protocols in reliability and effectiveness.

articleTitle: $\boldsymbol{\mu} \mathbf{cos}$-II Porting and Low Power Mode Design Based on STM32L
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: This paper introduces the migration method of μ C/OS-II on STM32L with Cortex-M3 core and realizes the example of serial port interrupt and led light task scheduling based on μC/OS-II operating system. A method for low power consumption and wake-up under this platform for the low power mode problem that is not considered on μcos-II is designed. The success of the system transplantation and the stability after transplantation are verified by the serial port task and the LED light. The serial port terminal receiving and receiving function of the pc end is used to verify the correctness of the system interrupt, and the current verification low power mode design is measured by measuring the low power mode. The μ C/OS-II migration method under the STM32L platform, the design of the serial communication and the design of the low-power mode have practical significance for the future low-power communication devices, which can reduce the workload required for secondary development. Make application development on top of the platform simple.

articleTitle: Protecting Hidden Location Visit Privacy with High Trajectory Data Utility
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: With the spread of social network applications with check-in service, people's trajectories are continuously recorded. The trajectory data are often published for personalized recommendations and activity mining. However, publishing trajectory data makes users' hidden location visits vulnerable to inference attacks. These hidden location visits could be considered as leaked, if an adversary can infer them with a high confidence. In this paper, we study the problem of protecting hidden location visits in the publication of trajectory data, assuming an adversary can do inference attacks on trajectory data. We propose a hidden location visit privacy protection algorithm employing location replacement and location suppression, to protect hidden location visits against inference attacks. We also design a number of techniques to make the anonymized trajectory data match users' behavior patterns. The experimental results show that our algorithms can efficiently prevent inference attacks on real datasets while preserving high trajectory data utility.

articleTitle: Controllability of Wave Propagation through Periodic Waveguides
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Exact and approximate controllability of wave propagation in a periodic structure is studied. Control is carried out via a source placed inside the structure. Using the Green's function approach exact controllability is reduced to solution of infinite dimensional problem of moments. A sufficient condition for approximate controllability is derived. Resolving controls sets are constructed in both cases. Numerical examples are considered.

articleTitle: Gas Emission Prediction in Coal Mining Faces Based on GA-SM-SVR
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In order to accurately predict the gas emission quantity from the coal mining face, a gas emission prediction model based on support vector regression (SVR) machine optimized by a real-coded genetic algorithm (GA) and an improved simplex algorithm (SM) has been proposed. The method of parameter optimization for the penalty factor and kernel-function parameter in this prediction model overcomes the disadvantages of the traditional single genetic algorithm, such as prematurity and slow convergence speed. Moreover, the method can obtain better model parameters and improve the training speed of SVR. According to the influence factors of gas emission, 13 major factors were selected as independent variables to predict gas emission. The experiment results show that the prediction model can predict the gas emission quantity within a small error. Compared with the other SVR models for the prediction of gas emission from coal mining faces, the proposed SVR model has higher prediction accuracy, faster training speed and better generalization ability.

articleTitle: Kernelized Correlation Filter Tracking with Scale Adaptive Filter and Feature Integration
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Recently, kernelized correlation filter (KCF) has been a popular tracker for high accuracy and robustness with high speed. However, KCF tracks objects with a fixed size template without scale estimation, causing tracking failure during target scale changes because of learning background or local appearance of the target. In this paper, we incorporate a separate scale filter into KCF tracker with feature integration. Experiments have shown that our tracker outperforms KCF and other scale adaptive trackers on distance and overlap precision while attaining relatively high speed.

articleTitle: Real-Time Simulation of Brush Behaviors in Chinese Calligraphy with the Sense of Immersion
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: This paper presents a real-time system for simulating the brush behaviors in Chinese calligraphy. With regards to the geometric profile of the Chinese brush, the “skinned mesh” modeling method has been adopted and an algorithm for fast computing of mesh rotation parameters has been developed to realize the two deformation effects i.e. bending deformation and torsion deformation during the process of brush pen writing. An ink diffusion model based on particle system has been developed. It can control the diffusion effect of ink on the paper surface. Based on the above techniques, a brushwork simulation system featuring a head mount display and a force feedback device has been developed, achieving excellent real-time performance and immersion effect.

articleTitle: Power-Grid Services Oriented Coordinated and Unified Control Technology of IP and Optical Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: The increasingly diversified and complex new services of the smart grid have put forward the requirements for collaborative control of traditional power IP data networks and optical networks. Thanks to the advantages of centralized software and software control network (SDN) technology, this paper proposes a centralized unified control architecture for IP and optical networks for power services and a service coordination control mechanism to realize power IP networks. Efficient coordination of optical networks; and under the unified control architecture of IP and optical networks, the IP layer flow table and optical layer flow table convergence mapping algorithm are proposed based on OpenFlow protocol, and the unified control interaction mechanism between IP network and optical network is designed to improve the power IP network. Efficient support for business with optical networks.

articleTitle: Proposal Generation by Learning Visual Relationship
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Proposal generation aims to generate bounding box candidates that contain objects. The key for proposal generation is to produce very few bounding boxes that can achieve high recall. In this paper, we propose a novel proposal generation algorithm which introduces visual relationship into proposal generator. The intuition is that objects always exist in co-occurrence, which can be clues for generating proposals coherently. Specifically, it is achieved by concatenating a novel relationship network with region proposal network, and jointly training them end-to-end. Experimental results on Visual Relationship demonstrate that our method can achieve better performance compared with state-of-the-art, especially when evaluating at the top limited number of generated proposals.

articleTitle: The Dynamic Long-Term Equity DWRR Algorithm In Mine IoT
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: With the informatization and modernization of mining industry, the contradiction between the increased transmission requirements and the limited bandwidth caused by the quality of service requirements of multi-services in mine network proposes a high demand for transmission efficiency. In this paper, a dynamic long-term equity scheduling algorithm is proposed to improve the scheduling performance of gateway in mine network. The algorithm ensures the longterm equity by taking the historical accumulation of delay into consideration. In addition, the arrival rate of packets is also considered to relieve congestion effectively when facing the burst traffic flows. The simulation results verify the algorithm can avoid congestion effectively by adjusting the bandwidth allocation of the queue when suffering the burst traffic flows or accumulating an excess of historical delay.

articleTitle: Use FCN to Accurately Judge the Frontal Face or Side Face
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Face-to-unlock is widely used in the fields of authentication, mobile payment and other information security. In the process of face-to-unlock, the detection for frontal face and side face can greatly avoid people's non-active intention triggering verification function and greatly improve the security of unlocking. Based on this reason, this paper establishes a set of model to judge frontal face and side face, by combining the latest FCN (Fully Convolutional Networks) algorithm with the geometric method creatively, to make the recognition rate for frontal and side face reach to 99.82%, far higher than by OpenCV traditional methods under the same data set. At the same time, in model training, this paper has improved training speed and model generalization ability by transfer learning technology.

articleTitle: Multi-Antenna Common Clock Measurement for Multi-Platform Applications
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: The development and application of GPS technology promotes the research on attitude determination. This paper is a review of GNSS high precision attitude determination algorithms and their potentials in other GPS applications. This paper focuses on investigating GPWU and multipath effect-related measurement errors. After surveying the existing data processing methods and algorithms, the paper introduces the progressive achievements by the Engineering Center of SHMEC for Space Information and GNSS. An algorithm for yaw angle determination based on the GPWU effect is proposed, in which simplified equipment uses a single antenna to replace the multi-antenna receiver to measure the yaw angle. A series of experiments, including rotating platform tests, and vehicle and shipborne tests are carried out to validate its feasibility. Asides from GPWU, a new application which mitigates the baseline multipath effect in a kinematic shipborne environment based on the MHM approach, is also presented. An experiment is conducted to verify the MHM model for multipath correction in a dynamic ship loading environment. The experimental results show that the RMS of observed residuals and baseline solutions are reduced.

articleTitle: Design of Spectral Line Agile Observation and Analysis Platform
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: The 40 m radio telescope of Yunnan Observatory is an important radio observation and research platform in China. The telescope will be retrofitted to cover the approximately 12 GHz observation band in the S-Ku band. The transformation of the C-band with multiple radio lines has been carried out. The development of efficient digital analysis terminals will help them to obtain higher quality observations in observation and science. The agile transceiver solution is an emerging receiver design solution in the field of software radio. The analog front-end circuit can change the local oscillator frequency and filter bandwidth under program control, and realize a high-Q programmable filter to select any narrow-band signal of 200KHz-56MHz in the 6GHz band. With the back-end down-conversion and acquisition and output circuits, this design is suitable for the refinement of narrow-band line observation in radio astronomy. The flexible local oscillator frequency adjustment provides the possibility for fast frequency switching calibration.

articleTitle: Comparison of Fingerprint Matching Methods for Wi-Fi Indoor Positioning
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Currently, positioning in indoor environment enjoys heavy demands in many public places. Considering that methods for outdoor positioning such as satellites localization are not applicable in indoor environment, Wi-Fi indoor positioning technology, regarding signal indicators as fingerprints, is a popular approach. However, most prior researches focus on the single device in position identification. As a result, the Euclidean distance similarity method, which is widely used for fingerprint matching of a single device, is not suitable for multiple devices. To solve the problem, this research aims to find a better matching method for multiple devices. An experiment is set to find the characteristics of Wi-Fi Received Signal Strength Indicator (RSSI) and create fingerprints for every position point. Since at least 92% RSSIs at one position point centralize at a specific value in the stable environment, the most centralized value is selected as fingerprints. Using the collected data and fingerprints, two matching methods- Euclidean Distance method and Cosine Similarity method, are compared in fingerprint matching for the same and different devices. The experiment results demonstrate that, by using two methods, the precision for same device matching is similar. However, for different device matching, Cosine similarity method, which has obviously increased the match accuracy, is a better method in fingerprint matching.

articleTitle: Stereo Matching Based on Improved Census Transform
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In order to reduce the mismatch rate of binocular stereo matching algorithm, a stereo matching algorithm based on improved Census transform is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the classical Census transform is improved, the mean value rather than the center pixel is used as the reference value, and the three states based on the pixels' distances are used to describe the relative relationship between each pixel in the transform window and the reference value; Secondly, the sparse transform window is used to reduce the computational complexity of the algorithm, and the transformed Hamming distance is calculated as the matching cost; Finally, in the maximum disparity range, the points with the least matching cost are selected as the matching points by WTA algorithm, and the disparity is refined by sub-pixel fitting. Experimental results show that the improved Census transformed image has more detailed information in the depth discontinuous region. Compared with the algorithm that directly uses the gray feature as the matching base elements, the proposed algorithm has better operation speed and matching accuracy.

articleTitle: Matching Pursuit Based Sparse Time-Frequency Analysis for Seismic Signal
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: This paper first reviews the principle of short time Fourier transform (STFT) and analyzes the disadvantage of STFT. Then it establishes the relationship between the short time observation and the spectrum. Based on the relationship and the sparse constraint, a sparse time-frequency model is proposed to avoid the disadvantage of STFT, fitting the sparse prior of the local observed signal. After that, matching pursuit method is employed to solve the proposed model. Experiments are then carried out on the seismic signal, comparing with some state-of-the-art time-frequency methods. Results show that the proposed method is able to compete with the state-of-the-art time-frequency methods and is capable of obtaining high-resolution time-frequency distribution, which is of great importance to seismic signal spectrum decomposition.

articleTitle: Research on Congestion Control Algorithms for Real-time Audio and Video Stream
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Aimed at the problem of poor transmission reliability and the lack of congestion control mechanism in UDP instant messaging field, a series of simulations and experiments are conducted to study the Google congestion control algorithm issued by the IETF WebRTC project group. This paper proposes a congestion control algorithm based on the arrival delay of received packets, estimating the network queuing delay, and calculating the current congestion status of the network based on the packet loss ratio. The experiment focuses on the analysis of bit rate changes during the competing with other flows for the bandwidth channel and the minimum enqueuing delay.

articleTitle: The Combinations of Loss Functions and Schemes for Mammographic Classification
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: The analysis of mammographic images effectively is a burning question recently. So the research of binary classification whether a whole mammographic image has masses or not is proposed in this paper. The two main issues are the class imbalance of INbreast database and the effect of classification. To address these, focal loss, center loss and three kinds of schemes are proposed. Focal loss is put forward to address class imbalance by multiplying a modulating factor. Center loss concerns about enhancement of discriminative power by handling inter-class features, that is similar to the first two schemes. Moreover, the third scheme is used to solve the class imbalance with L1 norm. The experimental analyses demonstrate the effectiveness of the combination of diverse loss functions and schemes. The convergence rate increases to varying degrees.

articleTitle: Dynamic Flow Scheduling in a Software-Defined Network Environment
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Network traffic conditions and topology change constantly; however most current flow scheduling schemes either assign flows to paths statically, not taking into account dynamic topology or traffic changes, or rely on specific topological or traffic characteristics to work. This paper proposes a practical and generic method of flow scheduling, which works in any types of networks. In our solution, flow scheduling occurs not only when a connection begins, but also when triggered by changes in topology and time. Our flow scheduling algorithm uses a weighted rating system taking hop count, link load, and switch load into account, and can adapt to changes in the network topology. As a proof of concept, we implemented a prototype of our solution and integrated it into the Floodlight controller platform. Preliminary evaluation results have demonstrated the effectiveness of our flow scheduling solution.

articleTitle: A High Performance Consensus Algorithm for Consortium Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Blockchain is an emerging decentralized infrastructure and distributed computing paradigm. Blockchain has been widely used in many industries including finance, energy, and cloud computing. Consortium blockchain is known as the permissioned blockchain, in which each user needs to be authorized. Distributed consensus is the core issue of consortium blockchain technology. In order to solve the disadvantages of using Proof of Work (POW) algorithm in consortium blockchain, such as computing resources waste, long block confirmation delay and low throughput, we designed and implemented a high performance blockchain consensus algorithm based on message passing technology called HPBC. HPBC algorithm can work well in asynchronous networks with Byzantine nodes. Results from theoretical analysis and performance evaluation show that HPBC algorithm provides safe and reliable distributed consensus services in consortium blockchain with low overhead. Finally, we summarized HPBC algorithm and briefly explore its further research directions.

articleTitle: Text Sentiment Analysis: A Review
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Sentiment analysis is a big branch in the field of natural language processing. The development of text sentiment analysis not only has a great influence in the field of natural language processing, but also has a profound influence in the fields of politics, economy and social sciences which are influenced by people's subjective view. As an interdisciplinary research field, text sentiment analysis has been paid more and more attention by scholars both at home and abroad. The research process and progress of sentiment analysis on the basis of investigation and analysis are summarized in this paper. It is also introduced that the common sentiment lexicon and corpus, the sentiment analysis based on dictionary, the sentiment analysis based on the conventional machine learning algorithm and the sentiment analysis based on the deep learning algorithm. The sentiment analysis of the Chinese and some special texts are discussed. Finally, the difficulties of text sentiment analysis and the future development direction are summarized.

articleTitle: Spoofing Attack of Drone
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: This paper investigates the requirements of spoofing attack on multiple drones which are navigated by GPS signals and can communicate with each other. Moreover, the performance of spoofing attack with different numbers of counterfeit signals is studied. This work also studies and simulates the spoofing attack on drones navigated by OTDOA positioning which is defined by 3GPP and can be provided by cellular networks.
