The compared experimental result showed that, the accuracy rate and recall rate of Adaboost-C4.5 decision tree to determinate privacy concerns is the highest in the three methods.

articleTitle: Multiple Parallel Frequency-Hopping Communication System Applying to Anti-Follower Jamming
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: A new frequency-hopping communication system is proposed which has excellent anti-follower jamming properties. Traditional frequency-hopping communication is designed by switching the channel it used quickly in a pseudo random way to avoid being detected as well as escaping the jamming, and the frequency-hopping sequence is only a one-dimension pseudo-random vector, while the novel one which is called the multiple parallel frequency-hopping communication system has a high-dimension pseudo-random frequency-hopping pattern, so it is impossible to be cracked in the communication span. Furthermore, the tradition frequency-hopping communication will be failed once a follower jamming tracking and disturbing successfully, while the proposed multiple parallel frequency-hopping system is almost completely unaffected even one of the high-dimension frequency-hopping sequences is blocked completely. Finally, combined with the variable frequence-hopping idea, a 4D frequency-hopping pattern is recommended in order to achieve a better balance and higher cost-benefits.

articleTitle: Recognition of Access Control Role Based on Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In order to solve the problem that the user-role relationship is difficult to be intelligently allocated in the role engineering of access control in the open environment such as big data, this paper chooses the convolutional neural network to research the access control role recognition. Compared with the traditional user-role assignment method, which is necessary to conduct manual role-granting work for a large number of users through the research and analysis of security experts, the convolutional neural network can be used to omit the artificial role granting process. Based on the existing user's behavior log information in the current information system, this paper transforms the user's behavior characteristics into grayscale images, and proposes an improved convolutional neural network RmNet-7 to automatically extract user behavior characteristics for access control roles recognition. This method has achieved good experimental results in the CERT Insider Threat r2 dataset, and can achieve 80.6% recognition accuracy in the test set.

articleTitle: Research on Business Recognition Perception for Active Early Warning of Power Optical Network
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: The power optical communication network is the backbone network of the power system communication private network, which carries the core business of power grid data transmission. The expansion of power optical networks and the Continuous increase in the variety of power services pose new challenges to optical network fault monitoring and protection capabilities. In order to meet the requirements of power optical communication network resource dynamic allocation, fault diagnosis and service-aware traffic scheduling, this paper addresses the challenges brought by the current intelligent power terminal multi-service access to the power optical transmission network. Based on the analysis of the application and performance improvement requirements of the terminal access, combined with the software-defined optical network control separation strategy and optical network resource virtualization function, a power optical network service perception model based on port and depth detection is proposed, which creates favorable conditions for the operating state of monitoring and controlling the grid.

articleTitle: Stepwise Noncoherent Accumulation Acquisition for High-Dynamic DSSS Communications
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: For direct sequence spread spectrum (DSSS) communication circumstances, the high-speed relative movement with large acceleration between the transmitter-receiver pair causes a large variation rate in Doppler shift. Moreover, the long transmission distance significantly deteriorates the received signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) at receiver. To address the acquisition problem under not only the very weak received signal but under the high dynamic scenarios as well, in this paper, we propose a stepwise noncoherent accumulation (SNCA) acquisition scheme with dynamic noncoherent accumulation length (DNCAL) capping for various signal strength, which is based on the traditional fast Fourier transform based partial matched filter (PMF-FFT) acquisition architecture. First, we compensate Doppler shift variation rate in parallel so that it is small enough to be ignored in one Doppler shift variation rate bin. Second, we adopt noncoherent accumulation to overcome the problem caused by the weak received signal. And, the minimum noncoherent accumulation length (MNCAL) for a specific acquisition probability under constant false alarm rate (CFAR) is analyzed quantitatively. Third, the SNCA acquisition scheme with DNCAL capping defined by the MNCAL for a specific acquisition probability under CFAR is developed to further reduce the average NCAL. Simulations results show that the analysis of MNCAL is effective, and our proposed scheme can obtain almost the same acquisition probability with less NCAL, compared with the PMF-FFT acquisition scheme with fixed NCAL.

articleTitle: Research on Big Data Storage Model of Oilfield Assay Data Based on MongoDB
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In sample analysis, because of different types of sample assaying project result in different types of data models to be used for storing these different types of assaying data. So far, all assaying data models almost employ relational data model, it is well known that system retrieval efficiency will reduce with the accumulation of data volume. Not only that, some of assaying data models possess sparseness issues, which must occupy a lot of data storage space. Today, it becomes possible to solve these issues with the emergence of various advanced big data platforms and models. Based on the study of the assay data model used in the oil field and the data model in the NoSQL, a method for storing assay data using a document model is proposed in this paper, which effectively solves the problem of inefficient and difficult management in the traditional relational model. Finally, we implemented the prototype system of assay data storage based on MongoDB, and verified the feasibility of storing data by document model. The results show that the proposed assaying data model can improve efficiency of data retrieving and data storage, which possesses better extensibility and pervasive.

articleTitle: Modeling and Accessment of the Regional Energy Internet Based on Multi-Agent
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: One of the main prospective conceptions of the energy internet (EI) is to make full use of renewable resources to meet the load demand with well dynamic quality and high reliability. Multi-agent systems have intrinsic advantages such as flexibility, autonomy and scalability which are very helpful in the modeling of the EI. In this context, the generation-storage-load regional EI model is developed using agent-based modeling method. And the operating state of each part of the model can be observed through the designed interface. Furthermore, the energy router is constructed to schedule the power flow in the system. The simulation results show that the interaction between agents and the schedule strategy in the regional EI can achieve a better supply-demand balance. Moreover, the system can make full use of renewable energy and alleviate the peak load pressure of the main power grid.

articleTitle: A Frame Prioritization Based on Classified Contentions in Multi-hop Wireless Ad hoc Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Since wireless signal is attenuated with distance, the spatial location of transmission pairs may have a seriously impact on the performance of contentions based medium access control (MAC) protocol. In this paper, we mainly consider to classify the contentions among wireless stations based on their spatial locations and propose a novel frame prioritization based on classified contentions scheme. In the proposed scheme, we define a transmission opportunity (TOP) for each transmission pair, which is based on the signal quality and withstanding ability against interference between the transmission pair. With the defined TOP, each transmission pair is classified in participating in contentions with other wireless stations. We demonstrate that the proposed scheme outperforms the IEEE 802.11 distributed control function (DCF) scheme by approximately 20% for 20 transmission flows in terms of aggregate throughput, average delay and average frame collisions probability.

articleTitle: Abstract Structure of Data Communication in IoT Application
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Data communication in Internet of Things (IoT) application plays an important role in IoT systems. This kind of communication involves many links and its process is complicated because of the characteristics of IoT. In order to express the whole process of data communication clearly, this paper proposes the abstract structure of the data communication in IoT applications in terms of the characteristics of IoT. This abstract structure has the characteristics of Service Oriented Architecture (SOA) and gives a full description of the system's data communication, which can be used in various aspects of the IoT application and system.

articleTitle: An Effective Cluster Heads Selection Method for Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: An effective cluster heads (CHs) selection scheme based on the energy and density is proposed for the wireless sensor networks. In the proposed method, the residual energy and the dynamic density of nodes are jointed to determine the CHs to balance the energy consumption, where the nodes with more neighbors and more residual energy will be preferred as CHs. Moreover, the dynamic weight is used to trade off the effect of the residual energy and node density in the selection of CHs. As the residual energy of the node decreases, the weight value will make the residual energy have a higher priority, so that the nodes with high density and low energy can avoid death of being selected as a CHs. Simulation results show that the proposed algorithm can balance energy consumption and greatly prolong the network lifetime compared with the exiting schemes.

articleTitle: Design of the Indoor Positioning Glasses for the Blind Based on the LiFi Technology
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In recent years, indoor and outdoor positioning technology for the blind has attracted much more attention. The outdoor positioning technology has relatively matured. However, three-dimensional indoor positioning technology is facing many problems. Due to low positioning accuracy as well as slow positioning speed, there is no ideal implementation system at present. Light Fidelity (LiFi) technology is a new wireless transmission technology that uses the visible light spectrum, such as the light emitted by a light bulb, to transmit data. It transmits signals through the changing light of LED lights. When LED lights are properly laid out in the building, not only the function of lighting but also that of transmitting information are met at the same time. It is a good way to solve indoor positioning problems. This article studies an indoor positioning glasses for blind based on the LiFi technology. Different from other indoor positioning technologies such as ultrasound and wireless fidelity (WiFi), the design of indoor positioning glasses for the blind will propose new ideas of three-dimensional indoor positioning problems for the blind.

articleTitle: An Ensemble Learning Algorithm for Indoor Localization
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In this paper, we investigated the problem of localizing a smartphone with iBeacon signal strengths utilizing an ensemble learning algorithm. We built a real testing environment and examined the performance of the ensemble learning algorithm in our positioning system that outperformed any single classifier individually. We also proposed two approaches to improve the accuracy: Exponentially Weighted Moving Averages (EWMA) to deal with wireless signal fluctuation, and data augmentation for enlarging existing data volume. Further, the extent of the density received signal affecting the accuracy of localization by using different intervals was discussed. Most importantly, we tested our algorithm in a real environment. In order to combat overfitting, data balancing on training datasets in each reference point was introduced. By a series of comprehensive experiments, we have corroborated that the weighted fusion algorithm is capable of localization with high accuracy.

articleTitle: Efficient Frequency-Domain Equalization Scheme for High-Order Faster-Than-Nyquist System
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In this paper, an efficient frequency-domain equalizer (FDE) scheme based on minimum mean-square error interference canceling category is proposed for the high-order Faster-Than-Nyquist (FTN). Turbo-like iterative decoding architecture is used to achieve better performance without imposing excessive computational complexity. The details and the proof of soft-decision FDE are given in this paper, and the formulations of FDE employing high-order modulations are also given. The simulation results demonstrate that while 16QAM is applied, FTN systems with FDE can obtain 0.55dB performance gain compared to Nyquist systems with the same spectrum efficiency. In addition, the FDE-FTN system just loses about 0.1dB compared with the MAP-FTN system, while the computational complexity of FDE is only 4.3% of MAP Equalize. Thus, the proposed FDE is a low-complexity and efficient algorithm for the high-order FTN systems.

articleTitle: An NFV Framework for Supporting Elastic Scaling of Service Function Chain
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Enabling elastic scaling is the crucial advantage of Network Function Virtualization (NFV), of which the common usage is Service Function Chain (SFC). But how to scale SFC elastically on an NFV platform while ensuring performance and cost-effectiveness, remains to be vague and challenging. We propose ESFC, a user space service chain management framework to reallocate computing resource of each NF components dynamically based on real-time statistics, while minimizing performance overhead. The ESFC framework monitors load on a service chain at high frequency (1000Hz) and employs proactive resource allocation policy to enable elastic scaling. ESFC utilizes an asynchronous mechanism to notify the to-be-scaled NF, which will be reallocated with computing resources via thread. Moreover, ESFC adopts a perfect distribution algorithm to reduce cache invalidation and state migration while scaling, which are crucial to performance. The results show that ESFC could adjust the devoted resources dynamically and achieve up to 3x higher cost-effectiveness without compromising performance. Comparing with the latest popular SFC platform, ESFC achieves higher performance up to 1.3x under the same condition.

articleTitle: Energy-Efficient Phase-Aware Load Balancing on Asymmetric Multicore Processors
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Comparing to the traditional symmetric design, single-ISA asymmetric multi-core processors were shown to deliver higher performance at lower energy costs. In such systems, load balancing is a challenging problem. Traditional algorithm is based on the load contribution prediction according to the task priority and the CPU utilization, ignoring the different characteristics of phases within a single task. Such approach might lead to suboptimized load balancing decisions, especially when concerning energy efficiency. In this paper, we propose a novel phase-aware load balancing method. Based on empirical data, proposed method could distinguish different execution phases. Comparing to HMP load balancing, the evaluation results show that the energy cost can be saved by 4% using the proposed approach while the CPU frequency is dynamically changed. If the CPU frequency is fixed, the energy cost can be saved by 10%.

articleTitle: Towards General Software-Defined Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: With the rapid development of the Internet of Things and Cyber Physics Systems, wireless sensor networks face both opportunities and challenges. Software-defined wireless sensor networks, as a promising new type, have been slow to develop so far and have lagged behind application requirements. The enrichment of sensor node resources complements the common software-defined of wireless sensor networks, which can jointly promote the application and development of wireless sensor networks. Based on this, this paper proposes a general software-defined wireless sensor network and elaborates the key technologies. Subsequently, an application scenario was described in light of actual needs, and the corresponding opportunities and challenges were analyzed.

articleTitle: Method of Time Sampling Error of Time-Interleaved ADC Based on Statistical Rule
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: The rapid development of digital technology requires higher Analog Digital Converter (ADC) sampling rates. Single-chip ADC is difficult to meet this require. The Time Interleaved ADC (TIADC) based on ADC parallel sampling can solve this problem and is therefore widely used. However, due to current hardware levels, the sampling interval of the TIADC is non-uniform and there is a time sampling error (TSE). There are currently a number of algorithms that can estimate the TSE, but must work in an environment where the frequency of the input signal is known. This paper improves an existing TSE estimation method that enables parameter estimation with unknown input signal frequencies. The proposed algorithm constructs the relationship between signal variance and TSE. In the implementation process, the TSE estimation value is inverted by statistical signal variance. Simulations show that the normalized TSE estimation error value variance is 0.01.

articleTitle: Enabling Work-Conserving Bandwidth Guarantees for Multi-tenant Datacenters with Network Support
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Bandwidth guarantees and work conservation are the two most desirable properties for multi-tenant datacenters, which are the key to providing predictable performance for tenants' applications by giving lower bounds on bandwidth that each tenant can obtain, and to improving network utilization for datacenter providers by enabling the reuse of spare network bandwidth or unused bandwidth allocated to a tenant. Current approaches, however, cannot effectively achieve work-conserving bandwidth guarantees, as they either cannot provide accurate bandwidth guarantees or are not work-conserving. In this paper, we present FastLane, a host-based mechanism with network support that can effectively achieve bandwidth guarantees and work conservation simultaneously. Specifically, FastLane splits every flow between a pair of virtual machines into two subflows which are marked with red color and green color respectively. The subflow with red color is rate-limited at the rate of its corresponding guarantee to achieve bandwidth guarantees, while the one with green color is used to achieve work conservation. Moreover, FastLane leverages the weighted fair queueing which is widely available in commodity switches to slice network bandwidth for each kind of subflows. Experimental results show that our approach can achieve accurate bandwidth guarantees and effectively utilize the network.

articleTitle: Weighted $l_{p}$ Minimization for Compressive Channel Estimation in FDD Massive MIMO
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: The paper proposes a weighted l<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">p</sub> minimization algorithm for downlink channel estimation in frequency division duplexing (FDD) massive multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) system, in which we take the popular l<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">p</sub> minimization algorithm named as Iteratively Reweighted Least Squares(IRLS) method for example. The proposed algorithm involves two stages, in which it first diagnoses the downlink support by utilizing the channel sparsity in angular domain and spatial reciprocity for uplink and downlink channels, and then a weighted IRLS algorithm based on the diagnosed support is used for downlink channel recovery. The diagnosed support is used for generating the weighting matrix in the weighted IRLS. The restricted isometry property(RIP) based analysis results for the lp minimization are given out. The results has the general form for 0 <; p ≤ 1 and can be specified to the RIP analysis results for standard l<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub> and weighted l<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub> minimization which are given in other literatures. Hence our analysis results have the more general form. Simulations show that the proposed method can achieve higher estimation accuracy compared with IRLS, weighted subspace pursuit, weighted l<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub> minimization and standard l<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub> minimization.

articleTitle: A Recommendation Method of Educational Resources Based on Knowledge Structure
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: With the development of online learning platform, network education resources become more and more rich. It makes online learners easier to choose the time, place and content of learning. Because of the huge number of educational re-sources in learning platform, it is difficult for learners to find learning re-sources quickly and efficiently. The user-based collaborative filtering recommendation algorithm is improved by knowledge structure. A new method of education resource recommendation is brought up in this paper. In this method, not only the recommendation result accords with the learner's interest, but also accords with the existing knowledge system of the learner. It better meets the learner's individualized learning needs and improves the learning efficiency. In this paper, the experiment was carried out by the method of controlled experiment. The experimental results are evaluated through two aspects of correlation score and learning process score, and good experimental results have been obtained.

articleTitle: Array Configuration for Distributed Spaceborne Coherent Aperture Radar
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: It is inevitable for the future battlefield target surveillance radar to utilize space-based platform. What's more, the higher the signal-to-clutter-noise ratio (SCNR) of the radar echo is, the more accurate information the radar will obtain from the target. Therefore, distributed spaceborne coherent aperture radar (DSCAR) technique is proposed for moving target indicator (MTI) to achieve higher SCNR. However, grating lobes and high sidelobes caused by the long baseline will degrade its detection performance. In this paper, aiming at the above problems, a new method based on Optimally Irreducible Arrays (OIAs) and Minimum Redundant Arrays (MRAs) has been proposed. Simulations are also carried out, showing the feasibility and the effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: An Adaptive Energy Consumption Optimization for Massive MIMO Systems with Imperfect CSI
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: The rapid development of wireless communication requires higher and higher energy efficiency. In this paper, the ratio among the total consumed power over the channel capacity is used to find the optimal power distribution point where the power has the greatest gain in capacity. In the actual communication system, the channel estimation error is a non-negligible problem. This paper establishes an uplink and downlink channel feedback model, which can obtain more perfect channel state information. This paper focuses on the optimal power allocation algorithm for imperfect channel state information. Consequently, the analysis and simulation results show that the channel estimation error will affect the optimal energy consumption ratio and the optimal energy consumption ratio is presented. And the optimal value is better than the situation where the channel state information is completely unknown at the transmitter.

articleTitle: Cluster Formation and Power Control for M2M-Enabled Two-Tier Cellular Network
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: The vast amount of the machine type communication devices (MTCDs) in machine-to-machine (M2M) communications and their limited energy budget are the crucial challenges to transmission scheme design. Clustered communication has been considered as one key technology for supporting M2M wireless networks with a large number of communication devices. This paper investigates the optimization problem of cluster formation and power control for M2M-enabled two-tier cellular network. To solve the mixed-integer non-linear programming problem, this paper proposes an algorithm that transforms the problem into a coalition structure generation sub-problem embedded with an optimal transmission power sub-problem. Compared with other approaches for solving the cluster formation and power control problem, simulation results show that the proposed algorithm can effectively solve the target problem and decrease the total energy consumption.

articleTitle: M-ary Orthogonal Signal and BER Performance in Wireless Communication Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: We propose a novel M-ary orthogonal spread spectrum scheme in this paper. The proposed scheme can improve the communication performance and frequency efficiency of wireless communication systems. We detail the schedule for constructing of spreading codes and analyze the bit error rate (BER) performance. The results indicate that the proposed M-ary orthogonal signals can obtain better anti-noise performance than direct sequence spread spectrum (DSSS) system. In addition, the new scheme can dramatically improve the bit error performance of communication system, leading the BER curve to get closer to Shannon capacity. Analysis and simulation indicate that the influences of signal peaks can be eliminated by using the proposed scheme, and the scheme improves the efficiency of information transmission and information security. We also drive the closed average BER expressions of M-ary orthogonal signals with cyclic shifting operation in Nakagami-m fading channels. Simulation shows that the proposed scheme can achieve more than 5 dB coding gain at BER over the DSSS signal in additive white Gaussian noise (AWGN) channel.

articleTitle: Design of Bluetooth DOS Attacks Detection and Defense Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Based on analysis of the principle about Bluetooth DOS attacks and security deficiencies of specifications, channel quality detection scheme is designed to detect the DOS attacks outside the piconets, device feature detection scheme is designed to detect the DOS attacks inside the piconets, and the defense mechanism to the attacks is implemented in Bluetooth link manage layer using the LMP data unit designed in this paper. Experiment results demonstrate that the scheme can defend system from DOS attacks preferably.

articleTitle: Research on Security Isolation Method for Wireless Public Network Oriented to Smart Power Distribution Service
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Intelligent distribution of communication networks is a key link to ensure power supply reliability, improve grid operation efficiency and service quality. Aiming at the security problem of wireless public network communication access with power terminal in the background of smart grid, by analyzing the current status of power wireless public network access, analyzing the security isolation requirements of the distribution terminal service, based on Bayesian classification algorithm will be used. The electrical service is securely partitioned, and a simple security isolation architecture for wireless public network access is proposed. The security zone and the wireless public network are isolated by the terminal server, and a specific security isolation scheme is elaborated. This method provides end-to-end and hierarchical high-quality services for the service, and has simple operation and low investment. It is of great significance for the future application of the wireless public network in the distribution of the electric communication network.

Author Keywords: intelligent power distribution and utilization communication network

articleTitle: Kinect V2 Edge base Registration with RANSAC-ICP
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: This article proposed a method to increase the precision of RGB-D registration applying RGB and depth obtained from Kinect V2. Procedure consists of 2 major components. The first part is to convert the image depth into the resolution and field of view (FOV) of color images and find both edges. Second part is to use both edge images from the first step to adjust registration result together with RANSAC (Random sample consensus) and ICP (iterative closed point) to reduce error between both edges. The experimental results showed that the proposed method improved the accuracy of RGB-D registration.

articleTitle: Research on Improved LEACH Clustering Protocol in Energy Inhomogeneity between Clusters in Network
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Since traditional clustering protocols sometimes use average clustering algorithms, the number of nodes in each cluster is generally equal. When routing between clusters uses multiple jumps, it will lead to excessive data transmission by cluster head node near the base station, resulting in excessive energy consumption near the base station. In the average clustering routing protocol, whether the communication between clusters adopts single jump or multiple jumps, it will lead to the problem of uneven energy between clusters in the network. In order to solve this problem, the non-uniform clustering method can be adopted. A static routing protocol is proposed: EBL (Energy Balanced LEACH) clustering routing protocol.

articleTitle: Building Syndrome and Symptom Association Network by Bayesian Network
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: The syndrome differentiation and treatment is the basic principle of traditional Chinese medicine to understand and treat diseases. Data-oriented scientific quantitative analysis on Chinese medicine dialectical thinking is of great significance to the development of traditional Chinese medicine. In this paper, combining clinical case data and expert knowledge, we build a Bayesian network model for the diagnosis of liver syndrome. Then inference forecasting was conducted on the model to verify the medical records, turning out to be of good ability of syndrome differentiation. Finally, the discussion of feasibility and insufficiency of the applications of Bayesian network in Chinese medical diagnosis is given.

articleTitle: Challenges and Statues of Rectifier for Far Field Wireless Energy Harvester in Power Variation of Input RF/microwave Signal
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Rectifier is the core of far field wireless energy harvester (FFWEH) and its performances have imposed serious effects on application of FFWEH system. In the real applications, environmental conditions such as absorption, reflection, multipath fading lead to lots of challenges to harvester development, especially its core rectifier. In the paper, challenges and the relative approach of rectifier development for FFWEH in variation of incident RF power are presented. Firstly, the characteristics of rectifier tightly related to the incident wave power are briefly introduced. Then, Challenges in rectifier design are analyzed in details. Lastly, recent approaches for these challenges are reviewed and analyzed in details. Depended on these effective approaches rectifier can get enhancement of performances to mitigate impacts of environment conditions.

articleTitle: A Column Generation Based Algorithm for Airline Cabin Crew Rostering Problem
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Airline crew rostering problem is an important research area in airline operations research. In this paper, we present a column generation based algorithm to solve this problem. The objective is to assign a personalized roster to crew member which minimize the number of unassigned pairings and ensure the fairness to crew members. To minimize the unassigned pairings, when there is a shortage of qualified crew members, we offer operation to allow relaxing some soft rules when generate rosters. Line-of-Work for crew members are generated in parallel, which improve the efficiency of the algorithm. The algorithm we propose in this paper has been put into production in a major airline in China and has a good performance.

articleTitle: Interleaver-Aided Successive Cancellation Flip Decoding Algorithm for Polar Codes
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: When the code length is finite, the successive cancellation list (SCL) decoding of polar codes shows as good error-correction performance as low-density parity-check codes and turbo codes and it will be used in high-speed communications. However, since the hardware complexity of the SCL increases linearly as the size of the list increases, it is difficult to use the high-complexity SCL decoding for devices with limited resource such as IoT devices. The successive cancellation flip (SCF) decoding algorithm has been proposed to solve the problem of high hardware complexity and to enhance the error-correction performance of successive cancellation decoding. However, the conventional SCF decoding has high computational complexity. In this paper, we propose the interleaver-aided successive cancellation flip (ISCF) decoding to reduce the computational complexity. The computational complexity of the ISCF decoding is less by at least 32% than the conventional SCF decoding for error frame at Eb/N0=3.5dB.

articleTitle: Single Image Dehazing via Relativity-of-Gaussian
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: To avoid halo artifacts and brightness distortion and achieve ideal visual effects, in this paper a relativity-of-Gaussian method (ROG) for single image dehazing is proposed. Firstly, we estimate the global atmospheric light only in the sky regions to minimize interference in other regions. Then, we use an adaptive boundary constraint ROG filtering to optimize the transmission properly which can reduce the halo artifacts. Finally, we remove the haze and produce a more natural visual recovery effect with an improved dark channel method. Experimental results show that this method outperforms state-of-the-art haze removal methods in terms of both efficiency and the dehazing visual effect.

articleTitle: Wideband Magnetoelectric Dipole Antenna with Stable Wide E-Plane Beamwidth
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: This paper presents a wideband magnetoelectric dipole antenna for wide beamwidth applications. Placed on aluminum plate and fed by a L-shaped feeding line, the proposed antenna can provide a wide bandwidth with satisfactory radiation properties. The two arms of antenna are bent to substantially increase the beamwidth. It is found that the antenna can deliver a measured impedance bandwidth from 2.0 to 2.8GHz for SWR<;2. Measured results show that the half-power beamwidth of the proposed antenna is 174°±4.6° in the E-plane and 96°±4.4° in the H-plane. Gain is 4.6dBi±0.44dBi at the frequency band of 2.0-2.8GHz (33.3%). Due to its simple configuration, wide bandwidth and stable wide beamwidth, it is promising for applications in base stations and wideband wide-angle-scanning phased arrays.

articleTitle: Railway Network Modeling Using Building Block of Timed Coloured Petri Nets
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Formal verification is likely an alternative to check safety property of the system model. However, to design an abstract model of huge railway network manually may cause errors because of its complexity. This paper proposes an alternative to generate a formal railway network model from the building blocks of Timed Coloured Petri Nets. Instead of constructing the formal model of a railway network model from scratch using CPN Tools, we provide a set of predefined building blocks of the high-level railway network components, including a train station building block, a rail building block, etc. A set of mapping rules are provided to generate the high-level railway network in terms of building blocks, into Timed Coloured Petri Nets automatically. The resulting formal model is verified using CPN Tools to ensure the correctness, safety, and liveness of the formal railway network model.

articleTitle: Analysis and Fusion Algorithm of Weak Target Based on Infrared Dual-Band
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of anti-background interferen ce for weak targets in infrared images, Infrared single-band da ta cannot fully reflect image details and outline information du e to single image information. This article uses infrared dual-b and detector to capture long-range weak target images. Firstly, the illuminance of weak targets under different wavelengths a nd different temperatures is analyzed. At the same time, the sp ectral characteristics of dual-band images and the three-dimen sional gray distribution of weak targets are studied, the textur e information of each plane of the dual-band image is also anal yzed. Based on this, the spectrum processed image is used to st udy the dual-band fusion algorithm, and a fusion algorithm ba sed on gray-scale contrast modulation is proposed. Finally, the results of the other five algorithms are compared, and the perf ormance evaluation methods are used to evaluate each fusion algorithm. The experimental results show that the proposed algorithm can enhance the grayscale of the weak target in the ima ge, suppress the background, identify the target, and solve the problem of anti-background interference of the weak target in the infrared image.

articleTitle: Design of Manufacturing Big Data Access Platform Based on SOA
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In view of the lack of big data access platform in current manufacturing industry, the big data access platform was studied based on SOA. With the analysis of big data characteristics and the big data access business in manufacturing industry, the overall architecture of the service oriented manufacturing big data access platform was built. The whole technical scheme of the platform was introduced and the platform functional design was the elaborated. The platform has functions of the data access management, data processing management, log management, database management and the distributed storage management. These provide good foundation for manufacturing big data service.

articleTitle: A Low-Complexity Method of NB-IoT Identification
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: This paper presents a low-complexity method of identifying the Narrowband-Internet of Things (NB-IoT) signal. Generally, 128-point FFT is needed in the identification procedure and the FFT point cannot be reduced any more if the number of cyclic prefix (CP) sampling points is kept to be an integer. However, the NB-IoT signal does not need such high FFT point as the bandwidth is only 180 kHz. In the proposed method, the FFT point is further decreased and an approach of solving the non-integer number of CP sampling points is provided. Through the experiments on the practical NB-IoT signal, the proposed method shows excellent performance in identifying the NB-IoT signal with less running time and low computational complexity.

articleTitle: Secrecy Polar Coding Scheme for Relay-Wiretap Channel
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a secrecy polar coding scheme for a relay-wiretap channel where a four-node configuration with a trusted relay node is applied under a decode-and-forward (DF) strategy. Based on the channel polarization phenomenon of polar codes, confidential information is sent to the relay and destination nodes using their good bit channels; random bits are fed to the good bit channels of the eavesdropper. By using two time slots, the destination node can recover the message from the source node while the eavesdropper cannot get any information about the message. The design eliminates the need for the source and the relay to have prior knowledge of the degraded eavesdropper channel in order to guarantee secrecy. The proposed method ensures the security of the transmitted confidential message. The simulation results indicate improvements in the coding rate and the bit error rate (BER) performance over existing techniques.

articleTitle: Research of Feed Forward Control of a Sewage Treatment Process Fuzzy Control System
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Sewage treatment process is a nonlinear system with a large time-delay. The system is vulnerable to interference. Control of sewage treatment process is a challenging problem. This paper proposes an effective method that combines an optimized fuzzy controller and a feed-forward controller to control a sewage treatment process. Firstly, an optimized fuzzy controller based on adjusting of a parameter α is designed. The optimized controller can generate different rules by changing the parameter α. The value of α is determined by solving the objective function optimization problem. Secondly, a new feed-forward controller based on back propagation (bp) neural network is designed that doesn't need mathematical models of control channel and interference channel. Simulation results show that the bp network based feed forward controller could compensate interference in the fuzzy control system. It is valuable especially when mathematical models of control and interfere channels is unknown. Simulation results also show that the proposed method is more effective than single fuzzy control method. It achieves a higher performance in the elimination of interference and reducing stable error.

articleTitle: Multi-swarm Particle Swarm Optimization Algorithm Based on Clustering Dynamic Grouping
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: A multi-swarm particle swarm optimization algorithm based on clustering dynamic grouping(DGMSPSO) is presented for the problem of easy to getting struck at local optima in optimization process and low precision of the particle swarm optimization algorithm. The clustering grouping strategy is introduced to enhance the location information of the particles to each other in the search process to improve the diversity of the algorithm. Local search ability and global ability of the algorithm are balanced with the dynamic adjustment strategy. The results of simulations on the test functions show that the dynamic grouping process is stable, feasible and effective, and has fast convergence and high accuracy compared with several other PSO-based algorithms in terms of global searching ability and convergent speed.

articleTitle: Discharge Voltage Time Series Classification of Lithium-ion Cells Based on Deep Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Cells among lithium-ion battery packs often exist inconsistency due to production variability in industrial process, which the inconsistency may lead to the reduction of the available capacity and premature failure of the battery packs. To relieve the inconsistency of cells among a battery pack and screen cells with similar electrochemical characteristics for a series-cell configured battery pack, we present a new method for lithium-ion cell selection using discharge voltage time series classification (DVTSC) based on deep neural networks (DNN). In addition, we selected 61177 cells with capacities between 2.06 Ah and 2.10 Ah as experimental samples. The samples were preprocessed to obtain a labeled training set for the DNN model, which the size of the labeled training set is 3000, including 2000 training samples and 1000 test samples. Then we compared two classical baseline methods and four deep neural networks methods for time series classification. The results show that FCN has the best performance on three metrics and can effectively screen abnormal cells in the discharge voltage time series on an unlabeled test set.

articleTitle: Double Weighted RPCA Denoising Algorithm for Color Images
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Image denoising is the process of removing the noise and recovering clean images from noisy images. Lots of algorithms have been proposed in last decades in this field, while most of them are aimed at gray images and ignore the correlation and difference between the RGB channels. In this paper, a double weighted Robust Principal Component Analysis (RPCA) denoising algorithm for color images (C-W2RPCA) is proposed. Superior to previous algorithms, it takes into account the spectral correlation, different noise levels for different channels, as well as the importance degree of image component described by singular values. Experiment shows that the proposed C-W2RPCA outperforms the competing methods.

articleTitle: Dynamic Access Control Model Based on FAHP in Cloud Environment
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: The characteristic of the cloud computing, resources sharing, determines that user behavior trustworthiness is crucial to the security of cloud resources. However, the traditional access control model (Role Based Access Control, RBAC) is only based on user identity trust and does not consider whether the user behavior is trusted or not, and the authorization mechanism is static, lacking of flexibility. Moreover, the lack of monitoring of user behavior makes it unable to timely detect and prevent the illegal operation of users. In view of the above several problems, this paper improves the traditional RBAC model, introduces the concepts of user trust evaluation and security level to the RBAC, uses the fuzzy analytic hierarchy process (FAHP) to calculate the user trust value, supervise and control the process when the user executes permissions, so as to achieve the purpose of dynamic access control based on user identity trust and behavior trust. The results of validation analysis of the improved model show that the improved RBAC model overcomes the shortcomings of the traditional RBAC model and can better protect the security of cloud resources, with small control granularity and good flexibility.

articleTitle: Modularity-Based Clustering Approaches for Economics Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In this paper we analyze modularity-based algorithms to obtain clustering of economics data sets. In particular, we investigate whether there are correlations between the financial data flows between different countries and economic agreements between countries. We apply different methods to both data sets and compare the obtained results by a maximum weight matching. Surprisingly, we see that there is not a very strong correlation between financial flows and agreements between countries.

articleTitle: A New Tracking Technique with the Memory Discriminator for High Sensitivity GNSS Receivers
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In this paper, a new discriminator is presented. This method combines a frequency discriminator named Differential Amplitude (DA) and a moving window function. DA was specially designed for enhanced sensitivity tracking of Global Navigation Satellite Systems (GNSS) signals. And the window function is used to select different portions of the carrier Doppler measurements. This combination, named memory discriminator, can improve the quality of Doppler estimates by reducing the variance of the measurements. In this way, the discriminator can reduce noise and hence achieve better tracking performance. Performance comparisons tested by using live GPS data have been made between the proposed method and the traditional ones, which include frequency-locked loop (FLL) assisted phase-locked loop (PLL), FLL and DA. Simulation curves indicate that the presented method has a remarkable advantage over other algorithms.

articleTitle: Image Deblurring Algorithm Using ACCELERATED Gradient Descent Method
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In this paper, we address an important problem of current image processing practice in a simply implementable way. More specifically, we develop a parametric image processing algorithm for removing blur effects from an image and recovering the initial unnoised image. Mathematically, the debluring problem is formulated as a non-convex optimization problem which is solved using the accelerated minimization method (accelerated gradient descent). Numerical analysis of several blurred images allows to estimate the advantages and drawbacks of the algorithm.

articleTitle: A New Feature Extraction Method for Medical Images Integrity Verification
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: With the development of multimedia and communication technologies in domains like telemedicine, it's critical to determine whether an medical image has been modified by some processing. In this paper we propose a new feature extraction method for blind integrity verification. Derivatives of the input image are computed first and then these derivative images are used to extract features. Besides, previous works mainly pay attention to the medical image modification based on global image processing methods. In this paper, we focus on local and global image processing detection. MURA dataset and 7 image processing methods are used to evaluate the proposed method and experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Detection Efficiency Analysis of Cooperative Spectrum Sensing in Cognitive Radio Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Cognitive radio (CR) has been widely used in bandwidth-constrained wireless communication system to overcome the problem of spectrum scarcity (e.g. CR-assisted D2D communications). As the key technology of CR, the spectrum sensing must be able to detect the vacant spectrum accurately and swiftly. There is a conflict between the better performance and the smaller feedback overhead for observation in spectrum sensing. Recent studies do not analyze the conflict quantitatively, most of which put focus on improving the performance of sensing while reducing the overhead. In this paper, the concept of detection efficiency is first proposed. A detection efficiency function is defined to analyze how to find the tradeoff between the performance and overhead in cooperative spectrum sensing. Based on energy detection, we derive the analytical expressions of one-bit hard combination and two-bit softened hard combination schemes for cooperative spectrum sensing. Moreover, we analyze how to adjust the scheme to maximize the detection efficiency according to the specific number of bits for transmission under the conditions of limited communication bandwidth. Numerical results provide excellent guidance for finding the tradeoff between the performance and the feedback overhead.

articleTitle: A DHR-Based Security-Critical Task Scheduling Algorithm for Heterogeneous Processing System
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Mimic defense techniques can solve unknown vulnerabilities as well as backdoors without prior knowledge based on DHR structure. Compared with traditional defense methods, DHR structure brings dynamic and heterogeneous factors into systems to enhance security. In this paper, we discuss the security-critical scheduling problem in DHR-based processing system and propose MHF algorithm according to the characters of heterogeneous processing nodes with different performance. While ensuring task schedulability, MHF algorithm improves the average heterogeneity of processing nodes as high as possible when allocating redundant versions of a task. Simulation results show that the average heterogeneity of MHF algorithm is 22.7% higher than that of RF algorithm when tasks' guarantee ratio approaches 100%.

articleTitle: Research on Parallel Encryption Technology in the Emergency Platform of High Speed Railway in China
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Data security in cloud computing is a very challenging task, searchable encryption techniques are used to search on encrypted data without the need for decryption. It's the measure which can satisfy the demanding of security of railway data stored in the cloud. In this paper, the characteristics of high-speed railway data in the emergency platform is analyzed, so a data set of high speed railway emergency platform is built according to parts of scene of accident and classification method. Thus, by searching with parallel searchable encryption schemas, emergence plans for the accident characteristics can be retrieved, which can testify the algorithm's feasibility. CP-ABE is used to realize access control for search result in order to eliminate files without right of users. This method can guarantee security of railway data as well as raise the search efficiency, and it provides a new explication for dealing with high speed railway emergency information.

Author Keywords: cipher text policy attribute based encryption

articleTitle: Research on Key Management Server Key Re-encryption Technology
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: This paper researches the key re-encryption technology of the key management server, and solves the storage security problem faced by massive key management under content association key encryption mechanism. The key management server must ensure the security of the managed key. Re-encrypting the key, for example, is a good strategy. The key data in the key management server is mostly presented in a flattened form, and there is no obvious feature structure in the data. Therefore, the key data is re-encoded by the run-length encoding algorithm, then the re-encoded key data is analyzed to determine the sensitive data extraction algorithm, and the compression coding and the sensitive data extraction are combined to realize the key re-encryption. The test results show that the method can realize the re-encryption of the key.

articleTitle: Adaptive Composite Phases Modulation/Demodulation Based on Transform Domain Communication System
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Transform domain communication system (TDCS) is a cognitive anti-interference system that can dynamically generate interference-orthogonal waveform. However, the low spectrum efficiency of the cyclic code shift keying limits its potential practical applications. Besides, TDCS only provides adaptive waveform rather than adaptive modulation. In this paper, an adaptive composite phases modulation/demodulation method is proposed to solve the low spectrum efficiency problem. Compared with the existing methods, it can achieve a considerable high spectrum efficiency and adaptive transmitting rate without signaling overhead.

articleTitle: A Color Image Encryption Scheme Using Inverse Fractal Interpolation Function
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: A color image encryption scheme based on inverse fractal interpolation function has been proposed. The inverse fractal interpolation function owns good chaotic natures and therefore can be applied to generate pseudo-random sequences to scramble the plain image pixel positions and then diffuse the scrambled image to get ideal cipher-image. The performance and security analysis of the proposed image encryption scheme have been carried out, including key sensitivity analysis, histogram analysis, correlation analysis, entropy analysis, and differential attack analysis, etc. Results show that the proposed image encryption scheme is secure enough to be adopted for the secure image communication applications.

articleTitle: The Method for Single Well Operational Cost Prediction Combining RBF Neural Network and Improved PSO Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In order to meet the requirements of single well operation cost variation and high prediction accuracy, this paper proposed a single well operation cost prediction method based on RBF neural network and PSO algorithm, which takes the advantage of with the global search ability and search optimization of PSO, and the fast convergence and strong generalization ability of RBF. Firstly, to solve the shortcomings of the particle swarm algorithm's local search ability, the inertia factor and learning factor in the PSO algorithm are optimized. Then the improved new particle swarm optimization algorithm is applied to the parameter calculation of the RBF neural network to optimize the center value and width vector of the hidden layer Gaussian function, which helps to improve the accuracy of the RBF neural network. Experiment results demonstrated that the improved PSO optimized RBF neural network model has higher accuracy and generalization ability in operational cost prediction.

articleTitle: Application of Spoof Surface Plasmon Polariton in Reducing Radiation Loss of Asymmetric Microstrip Lines with Small Radius Bends
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: A novel program which aim at solving the radiation-loss of an asymmetric microstrip line with small-radius bends is presented in this article and this program is properly proven. Asymmetric microstrip line with small radius bends are widely used in modern communication systems and highly integrated circuits, so the hot issue about reducing of radiation loss which in the circuit that an asymmetric microstrip line with small radius bends needs to be solved. This paper proposes an asymmetric microstrip line structure with small radius bends that adopts spoof surface plasmon polariton (SSPP) double-sided belt structure to effectively reduce its radiation-loss. we can clearly see that the radiation-loss about the asymmetric microstrip line with small radius bends added with the SSPP structure can be effectively reduced about 2 dB or more when phases are during in the 4GHz-17.2 GHz. According to the contrast of simulation and measurement results between this structure and the traditional asymmetric microstrip line with small radius bends.

articleTitle: Estimating Target Situation Based on 77GHz Radar Sensor for ACC System
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Knowing the situation of the target in front is very important for safe driving when the vehicle is driving at a high speed. In this paper, a new method for estimating target situation based on 77GHz millimeter wave sensor for ACC system is proposed. First, Multiple sets of velocity and range values are obtained by taking multiple measurements of the target in short time periods. Then, using multipoint linear fitting to estimate the acceleration of the target. At last, judging the target situation by the magnitude of the acceleration. Simulation results prove that this method can efficient estimate the acceleration of the target and then achieve the purpose of judging its situation.

articleTitle: An Anti-jamming Approach for Infrared Target Tracking Using Trajectory Prediction and Network Flow
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: With the infrared imaging tracking system widely used in the target tracking field, various infrared jamming methods make the infrared target tracking algorithm face severe challenges. How to effectively resist infrared jamming has always been an important problem of infrared target tracking. Infrared jamming mainly manifests as occlusion jamming and similar object jamming. In this paper, a robust anti-jamming approach is proposed. Firstly, a detection method of continuous strong jamming is used to accurately detect the location when the jamming occurs exactly. Then the trajectory prediction algorithm based on a particle filter deals with the occlusion jamming. And an improved multi-target tracking algorithm based on the minimum cost network flow is used to eliminate the similar object jamming. Finally, using simulated data to evaluate the proposed approach. The simulation results show that compared with the existing anti-jamming method, the anti-jamming approach has good robustness and accuracy for solving the similar object jamming and occlusion jamming caused by infrared jamming.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Hybrid Protocol Based Two-Way Decode-and-Forward Relay Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In this paper, a wireless energy harvesting relay network based on decode-and-forward (DF) mode is considered, where the relay node is energy constrained and it harvests energy through radio-frequency (RF) signals from the source node. Then the relay node uses the harvested energy to decode and forward source information to the destination node. In the hybrid power-time switching based relaying (HPTSR), the block time T is divided into two parts. One is used for energy harvesting and information processing, and the other is used for information transmission from relay to destination nodes. During the part of energy harvesting and information processing, the portion of the received signal is used for energy harvesting (EH) and the other portion of the received signal. The rest of the received signal is sent to transmit source information to the relay node. We derive the analytical expressions of outage probability and ergodic capacity in the two-way DF network. The numerical results provide practical insight into the different system parameters. In particular, the numerical results show that the DF mode significantly outperforms the amplify-and-forward (AF) mode in terms of outage probability and ergodic capacity performance.

articleTitle: Design of a Large Area Array CMOS of Camera System that can Automatically Zoom
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In order to realize automatic zooming of large area array cameras, a large area array CMOS image sensor CMV20000 produced by CMOSIS Corporation is used as the research object. The camera system is based on FPGA and DSP. Integrate electric sliding table in the system and place the image sensor on the electric slide, moving it to achieve zoom. The FPGA and DSP are the main control units of the camera. And the image acquisition is realized according to the working mode and driving timing of the CMOS image sensor. The experimental results show that the design of the large-area array CMOS camera with automatic zooming scheme is feasible. The system runs stably and the high-quality image is obtained. The design solves the shortcomings of the existing large-area array CMOS industrial camera that cannot automatically zoom.

Author Keywords: large area array CMOS image sensor

articleTitle: A Pyramid Image Matching Algorithm for Chang'E-2 CCD Images of the Moon
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: The Chang'e-2(CE-2) satellite is equipped with a three-line Charge-coupled Device (CCD) stereo camera with a resolution of 7 meters. Through the camera's linear array scanning images, the stereoscopic images transmitted by CE-2 are processed. The results obtained from the processing can theoretically build a digital elevation model (DEM) with a resolution better than 10 meters. In this paper, an image matching algorithm is proposed as a code link of the built DEM, which can obtain homonymy image points with high accuracy. In view of the acquired CCD image data, the essay introduces the Wavelet Pyramid stratified matching algorithm to process the modified data. In the whole matching process, the feature points of the image are extracted with the Forstner, Moravec, and Harris operators based on gray features, which are then processed by the hierarchical matching algorithm of the wavelet pyramid. The proposed algorithm reduces the error rate of image matching and shortens the matching time and searching time of the non-homonymous image points. CCD image data simulation experiments show that the algorithm can reduce the error rate to 10.38%.

articleTitle: Word-Level and Character-Level Mixed Features for Chinese Short Text Classification
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In this paper, a novel method is proposed to solve the problem of insufficient representation of single character-level features or word-level features. In view of the short length, sparseness and strong context dependencies of short text, our method takes word-level vectors and character-level vectors as inputs simultaneously, and encodes sentence semantics by two Long Short-Term Memory (LSTMs) or bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory (BiLSTMs). The outputs of the entire sentence combined two outputs from word-level vectors and character-level vectors. For Chinese short text classification, our experiments show that the combination of word embedding and character embedding can complement each other in the sentence semantic representation, which helps to improve the classification performance of Chinese short text.

articleTitle: Clock Skew Elimination Using Robust Regression in Time Triggered Communication
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Time triggered communication satisfies the transmission requirements of some critical safety systems in the fields of avionics technology, transportation, industrial automation and so on. Unfortunately, AS6802 standard of time triggered communication discusses only the clock synchronization procedure, not the method of clock skew elimination. Additionally, considering the unconventional synchronization requirements of time triggered communication, traditional algorithms cannot be well applied to time triggered communication. This paper proposes a clock skew elimination based on robust regression method. Firstly, the proposed algorithm robustly evaluates the clock skews of local clocks. Secondly, these clock skews are eliminated by dynamic progressively compensation. It solves the clock sudden jump problems of direct compensation and outlier impacts of the least square algorithm. Consequently, the simulation results show that clock synchronization precision of the algorithm in this paper outperforms direct compensation and non-robust least square compensation as long as the ratio of outliers in the network is no more than 50%.

articleTitle: An Improved Adaptive Sampling Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: For the observation of the Harmful Algal Blooms (HABs) whose chlorophyll concentration obeys the Gauss distribution, an improved adaptive sampling method for a small autonomous underwater vehicle (AUV) based on the Gauss Process Regression (GPR) is proposed. The adaptive sampling process is divided into three stages: the search, the comb sampling and the escape of the hotspot region. This method enables AUV to switch the sampling stages, online path planning and complete the rapid observation of the unknown area through updating the sampling information of its own environment. Under the environment of four hotspot regions, the comparison simulation experiment proves the effectiveness of the algorithm, which can quickly observe the interest regions and obtain the low error estimation of the characteristic distribution. It also proves that the algorithm can effectively avoid the repeated sampling to the same hotspot region, further improve the observation precision of the hotspot region and reduce the prediction error of the hotspot region.

articleTitle: An Energy Efficiency Optimization Algorithm Based on the Factor for Portion of Time Division in Backhaul-Constrained Ultra Dense HetNets
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: The ultra dense networks (UDN) are considered as a key technology of 5G for its ability to increase communication capacity. However, the problem of constrained backhaul and the lack of energy which is caused by micro base station without power supply equipment are two mainly bottlenecks of UDN. In order to solve the problem of low micro base station's energy efficiency (MIEE) due to constrained backhaul, we propose an energy efficiency optimization algorithm based on the factor for the portion of time division (FPTD). The optimization problem considers a joint design of downlink precoding, power allocation and the FPTD, meanwhile, we utilize first order Taylor convex approximation (FOTCA), convex slack variable and one-dimensional search method (ODS) to solve. Simulation results show that the proposed FPTD-based energy efficiency optimization algorithm (FEEOA) is improved with much better energy efficient compared with the primitive scheme without FPTD, and more throughputs can be transmitted at the same energy consumption.

Author Keywords: factor for portion of time division

articleTitle: Functional Safety Assessment and Security Protection Framework of Cyber Physical Machine Tool System
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In recent years, the Cyber-Physical system has received extensive attention from the academic community. As a working machine for high-end intelligent manufacturing, CNC machine tools have undoubtedly played a supporting role in Cyber-Physical Production Systems. Therefore, the development of cyber physics CNC machine tools (CMPT) and cyber physics control systems (CMPTS) has become an important direction for the development of the intelligent manufacturing industry. The security problems and protective measures it faces are increasingly becoming the focus of research in the field. The security of CPMTS is mainly divided into functional safety and information security. This paper proposes a functional safety evaluation method combining information security, and constructs a BCCPMTS framework that integrates blockchain technology, which provides a new idea for establishing a safe and robust CPS.

articleTitle: Hardware-Based Adversary-Controlled States Tracking
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Return Oriented Programming is one of the most important software security challenges nowadays. It exploits memory vulnerabilities to control the state of the program and hijacks its control flow. Existing defenses usually focus on how to protect the control flow or face the challenge of how to maintain the taint markings for memory data. In this paper, we directly focus on the adversary-controlled states, simplify the classic dynamic taint analysis method to only track registers and propose Hardware-based Adversary-controlled States Tracking (HAST). HAST dynamically tracks registers that may be controlled by the adversary to detect ROP attack. It is transparent to user application and makes few modifications to existing hardware. Our evaluation demonstrates that HAST will introduce almost no performance overhead and can effectively detect ROP attacks without false positives on the tested common Linux applications.

articleTitle: Application of Big Data Technology in Evaluation of Operating State of High-Pressure Hydrogenation Heat Exchanger
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: The high-pressure hydrogenation heat exchanger is an important device of the refinery, but the high-pressure hydrogenation heat exchanger is exposed to the problem of leakage caused by ammonium salt corrosion. Therefore, it is very important to evaluate the operating status of the hydrogenation heat exchanger. To improve the method of using the traditional method to evaluate the operating status of hydrogenation heat exchangers, this paper proposes a method for evaluating the operating status of hydrogenation heat exchangers based on big data. For noisy data common in the industry, this paper proposes an automated noisy interval detection algorithm. For the problem that the sensor parameters have high dimensions and there are unrelated dimensions, this paper proposes a key parameter detection algorithm based on Pearson correlation coefficient. Finally, this paper presents a system-based health scoring algorithm based on PCA (Principal Component Analysis) to assist site operators in assessing the health of hydrogenation heat exchangers. The evaluation of the operating status of the hydrorefining heat exchange device based on big data technology will help the technicist to more accurately grasp the status of the industrial system and have positive guiding significance for the early warning of the failure.

articleTitle: Gateway Nodes Selection Strategy for Hierarchical Edge-Cloud
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Edge-cloud has been viewed as a promising approach to effectively reduce communication latency by pushing computing servers to the edge of network. A distributed online task scheduling approach for hierarchical edge-cloud has been proposed in prior work. However, this approach hasn't fully addressed load balancing issue of the system. In this paper, I model the hierarchical edge-cloud as a multi-queue system, and propose a gateway nodes selection strategy based on greedy algorithm to dynamically balance loads among those queues. Simulation result demonstrates the proposed strategy outperforms baseline algorithms in term of failed requests rate and percent idle time.

articleTitle: Zenithal People Detection Based on Improved Faster R-CNN
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: With the development of computer vision, zenithal people detection has attracted much attention in our society. Recent algorithms have shown effective performance which are mostly based on machine learning and hand-crafted features. However, the detection of the surveillance with large and various pedestrian flow still has limited success due to the head irregularity and occlusion. To address this problem, in this paper, we propose an improved zenithal detection network based on Faster R-CNN. We extend the network to a more discriminative and effective one by adopting a “joint-loss” function and presenting a new combination of the anchors according to the characteristic of human head feature. Note that the new anchors proposed are more appropriate to the head detection task. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed framework has substantially better accuracy of state-of-the-art methods.

articleTitle: Spectral-Spatial Graph-Based Semi-supervised Hyperspectral Image Classification
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: One of challenges for hyperspectral image classification is small training set versus high dimensional data.
