Graph-based semi-supervised learning method, which is capable of exploring the intrinsic geometric structure in hyperspectral image data, has been applied to relieve the obstacle of small training set. Hyperspectral images are rich in spectral and spatial information. In this paper, we present a novel spectral-spatial graph-graph semi-supervised hyperspectral classification method. First, SNN-graph and KNN-graph are constructed to capture spatial dependency and spectral similarity, respectively. Then, a PCA process is employed to integrate the two graphs into a spectral-spatial graph. Finally, a semi-supervised learning is performed on this graph. Experiments on real hyperspectral image data demonstrate the effectiveness of our method.

articleTitle: Minimum Redundancy Broadcast in Multi-channel Multi-radio Wireless Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Network-wide broadcasting is very necessary in wireless networks. A large number of broadcast protocols are developed for wireless networks. However, most of these broadcast protocols focus on Single-Channel Single-Radio (SC-SR) networks. The broadcast protocols in SC-SR networks are often node-centric. It is not suitable for Multi-Channel Multi-Radio (MC-MR) networks, as SC-SR broadcast protocols cannot effectively distinguish the performance differences between the multiple channels equipped by the nodes. We proposed the MOCAB algorithm, a distributed algorithm, which can effectively compute a broadcast tree in MC-MR networks. Our approach is to represent a MC-MR network with a simplicial complex rather than a graph. The simplicial complex can effectively grasp the concept of group in the network. By using a special complex called minimum overlapping neighborhood subcomplex, we can achieve minimum redundancy broadcast. We compare the performance of our algorithm with CAB algorithm. Results show that our algorithm uses 10.9% less receptions.

articleTitle: A Modified UWB Antipodal Vivaldi Antenna with Elliptical Lens
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: An antipodal Vivaldi antenna with elliptical slots at flower-shaped configuration and a half elliptical-shaped dielectric lens is proposed in this paper for UWB applications. The structure of the slots is used to extend the low-end frequency bands. Besides, the dielectric lens is presented to improve the gain at high frequency bands. The application of slots at flower-shaped structure helps the antenna lower the low-end operating frequency by 290MHz. In conclusion, this proposed antenna achieves a -10dB |S11| with bandwidth of 1.97-12GHz. Accordingly, its peak gain values in the range of 4.95-13.6dBi.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of Software-Defined Wireless Sensor Network Based on Mobile Agent Topology Discovery
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In wireless sensor network, how to quickly match the real-time changing network and reduce the energy consumption in the topology discovery process has been a hot research topic, especially in the network with a large amount of mobile nodes. This paper proposes an improved mobile agents topology discovery (IMATD) protocol for software-defined wireless sensor network (SDWSN). This protocol uses mobile agents (MA) to quickly and efficiently go through each node in the network and collect their topology-related information so that each node can obtain the entire network's topology information. And the mobile agents report and update collected topology information to the controller periodically, so the controller can achieve efficient network management. The simulation results show that the proposed protocol can effectively reduce topology discovery convergence time, reduce topology discovery energy consumption, and balance node energy distribution of the entire network.

articleTitle: Performance Prediction for CSR-Based SpMV on GPUs Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Sparse matrix-vector multiplication (SpMV) is a critical operation and domains computing cost in a wide variety of real-world scientific and engineering applications. While many sparse storage formats and their computing kernels have been developed in recent years, CSR (Compressed Sparse Row) is still the most popular and widely used sparse storage format and CSR-Based SpMV usually has better performance for sparse matrices with large number of nonzero elements. This paper presents a performance prediction model built by using machine learning approach to accurately predict the execution time of GPU-accelerated SpMV using CSR kernel. The prediction accuracy of our proposed model is evaluated on a collection of fourteen sparse matrices. The results of our experiments performed on two different NVIDIA GPUs demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposed approach.

articleTitle: Research on Random Source Points Aggregation Method of Urban Logistics Based on Hierarchical Clustering
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Aiming at the characteristics of multi-category, distribution, multi-single quantity and randomness of delivery orders in the city, this paper proposes a simplified method based on hierarchical clustering for random destinations of urban logistics. The points are clustered to form a cluster family according to a set threshold, and the clustering result is approximated as a single source point. It simplifies the randomness of urban logistics orders and lays a foundation for the optimal matching of orders and vehicles based on single-source point-based urban logistics sharing and distribution.

articleTitle: Development of Ultra-Fast Laser Controller Based on Network Integration
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: With manufacturing industry upgrading rapidly, special machining technologies, such as ultra-short pulse laser machining, have been widely used in automobiles, microelectronics, aerospace and other high-tech industries for its many advantages. The laser CNC machine tool that is a complex system integrating optics, mechanics, electricity and detection, which leads to different protocols between functional modules in the system. How to satisfy the interconnection among modules in the system becomes the key to system development. Combining with the requirement analysis of the system, a hierarchical networked model of control system has been put forward based on the technology of software and hardware platform for multi-bus protocol and analyzed the integration of modules among different field buses, also analyzed the collaborative control mechanism among the modules of the system. Finally, the serial port has been taken as an example to introduce the communication implementation of ultrafast laser controller, and the feasibility of the design scheme is verified by actual machining.

articleTitle: Bad Data Identification in Power System Based on Improved GSA Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Based on the analysis of the improved GSA (gap statistical algorithm) data mining technology, it is applied to the identification of bad data in the power system. Aiming at the shortcomings of this method, a new data preprocessing method and clustering method are proposed. The improved GSA method is a technique to determine the most appropriate number of clusters. The original measurement data is tested by the improved RBF neural network, and the obtained results are clustered by the improved clustering method, and then the optimal number of clusters is judged by using the elbow criterion. Compared to the original algorithm, it can determine the number of clusters faster, greatly reduce the running time, and successfully identify the bad data in the power system.

articleTitle: User Identification for Enhancing Recommendation by Social Media
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: With the eye-catching development of the Internet, new television technologies such as bi-directional Set-Top Box (STB) are appearing. Moreover, the studies of program recommendation based on STB are beginning to gather momentum. Previous methods mainly provide recommendations to TV users on the basis of regarding one account as one person, which ignores the feature of TV shared by more than one person in most instances. Again, the less interaction between TV and users makes personal information difficult to obtain or even not. In this paper, we propose a method to identify users in a single account by taking advantage of social media data and community detection algorithm. By collecting the information of specific micro-blog users related to program and program type label from Electronic Program Guide (EPG), program-based network diagrams are constructed to carry out user identification through community detection algorithm. Hereafter, we use the same recommended method for comparison experiments. Results show that the performance of recommendation applying the proposed method is more effectively than previous approaches.

articleTitle: Battery Grouping Based on Dynamic Gaussian Mixture Model
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: The lithium-ion battery group contains dozens of similar batteries, the inconsistency of characteristics of individual batteries can seriously affect the performance and life of the whole battery pack. In this paper, we propose a dynamic mixed Gaussian model for battery groping. Firstly, the static termination voltage and the capacity are used for clustering according to conventional method. Then clustering results utilize the whole battery discharge sequence and proposed the method for battery grouping. Finally, through actual production standards, the model structure is dynamically adjusted to meet the demand for the battery grouping number. Compared with the actual production, the proposed method proves the effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: Research on Multipath Mitigation Method for BOC Signal Based on CCRW Technology
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Binary Offset Carrier (BOC) modulation technology is gradually replacing the traditional BPSK modulation signal as the main modulation method of the new generation satellite navigation signal due to its superiority in multipath suppression performance and code tracking accuracy. However, the tracking and mis-locking problem of BOC signals has become a key point limiting the widespread application of BOC signals. In this paper, we use code reference waveform (CCRW) technology and optimized Bump-jump (BJ) algorithm to analyze the multipath performance of low-order BOC signals under five code reference waveforms. Aiming at the high peak BOC signal with many peaks and high peak-to-peak ratio, we propose a new code reference waveform ensures the high-order BOC signal has good anti-multipath performance and solves the problem of extremely easy mis-locking of its receiver.

articleTitle: Maximizing Minimum Phase Difference Based Hybrid Beamforming for Multiuser mmWave Massive MIMO systems
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a hybrid beamforming algorithm based on maximizing the minimum phase difference for millimeter-wave (mmWave) massive multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) multiuser systems. The proposed algorithm uses the channel gain threshold and the correlation characteristic of the array response vectors to select vector sets that provide higher signal power from analog beamforming vector codebook. Then, inter-user interference is measured by the phase difference between the analog beamforming vector and the main propagation path array response vector. Additionally, the criterion of maximizing the minimum phase difference is proposed to suppress the strongest inter-user interference. Analysis and simulation results show that the proposed algorithm can provide higher system sum rate with lower computational complexity than traditional approaches.

articleTitle: STACKEEPER: A Static Source Code Analyzer to Detect Stack-based Uninitialized Use Vulnerabilities
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: An uninitialized use vulnerability occurs when a memory region is accessed before initialized. This kind of vulnerability is common in C and C++ but sometimes it is not easy to detect. In this paper, we propose a byte-level model to detect uninitialized use vulnerabilities in the source code and build STACKEEPER, a flow-sensitive, path-sensitive and byte-sensitive static analyze tool against source code. By scanning the XNU source code we discovered several known or previously unknown uninitialized use vulnerabilities.

articleTitle: Design of an 3-Element Arc Array of Microstrip Antenna for Widen Bandwidth and Adjusting Beam Direction
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In the detector design of RFID, radio frequency identification devices, the antenna beam needs to meet the conditions of high gain and adjustable direction to cover the room and corridor in indoor environment,. In this paper, an 3-element arc array of microstrip antenna based on circularly polarized microstrip patch antenna are studied by quasi-Newton method in HFSS(high-frequency structure simulator). In this array, three probe-fed circularly polarized microstrip patch antenna, whose working frequency is 915Mhz, is placed on an arc array and the two array elements on both sides are symmetric. It is investigated that gain and bandwidth of the antenna array can be enhanced and the beam direction can be adjusted by properly arranging these array elements. The driven patch is a perturbed square one with two diagonal corners truncated in order to realize circular polarization. The model of antenna array has a gain of 5.9dB with a 3dB axial ratio bandwidth of 23.8%. The proposed antennas have been made and measured. The experimental results are basically the same as the simulation results. The research results provide a new idea for the design of microstrip antenna array, which can obtain higher gain while adjusting the beam direction of the antenna array.

articleTitle: Mobile Phone Spam Text Classification Based on Prior Knowledge
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Due to the rapid development of the Internet, the data generated by people in life is growing at an exponential rate, and Short Message Service (SMS) data is one of the social media products of mobile phone users. The main discussion direction of this article is how to distinguish spam messages and obtain effective information from them, and distinguish the information expressed by the messages themselves. In recent years, Deep learning has made great breakthroughs in the field of textual classification of natural language processing, so this paper will do more research and breakthrough on spam texts using the deep learning method. This article will introduce a Model (RCM) combined with a priori information extracted by Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) and Convolutional Neural Network (CNN). Firstly, obtain the temporal and spatial information characteristics of the sentence using the bidirectional LSTM as the prior information of the information itself before reading the information, and then merge with the feature information processed by the CNN to improve the accuracy of the spam prediction. Compared with the previous model, there is some innovation in getting the priori information extracted by LSTM, and it is also improve the performance standard.

articleTitle: Multi-modal Adaptive Steganography Algorithm with Variable Parity Check Matrix
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: At present, steganography has a wide range of problems such that the user has lower participation in the steganography process and it's difficult to ensure the security of the steganography algorithm. This is the main cause that steganography cannot go out of laboratory to become practical. In order to solve this problem, this paper proposed a multi-modal adaptive steganography algorithm with variable parity check matrix. Based on the guarantee of high anti-statistical detection, the algorithm gets multiple embedding modification modes by controlling the parity check matrix structure using shared key and establishing the mapping relationship between the key and the height, width of the parity check matrix. Thus, the steganography algorithm becomes secure and controllable for users. The security analysis and experimental results show that the algorithm has higher complexity and can maintain high anti-statistical detection.

articleTitle: Joint Data/Pilot Tracking Techniques for the Modern Beidou B1C Signal
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: The BIC signal of the Chinese Beidou III navigation system brings new features compared to the previous civilian signals, such as new modulation technique (i.e. Binary Offset Carrier BOC), data/pilot channels, secondary code and so on. These innovations are able to enhance the signal tracking robustness, but require adapted special techniques to track this new signal. In this paper, two joint data/pilot tracking techniques are introduced to enable the dual channel (i.e. data and pilot) tracking, which are called semi-joint data/pilot and joint data/pilot respectively. Both methods can realize signal tracking and enable data extraction at the same time, while the later one results in less power loss but needs additional computational resources. Furthermore, the bump-jump method is brought in to resolve the side peak issue caused by BOC modulation. The experiment results demonstrated that the proposed tracking methods could enable the BIC signal tracking process without locking on the side peaks, while the tracking sensitivity of the joint method was around 1.1dB higher than the one of the semi-joint method, but required additional 90% correlations.

articleTitle: Research on the Positioning Precision of Ranging Methods in VHF Data Exchange System
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In order to ensure the safety of maritime navigation, and provide reliable resilient position, navigation, and time (PNT) information for E-Navigation, upgrading the existing AIS system and adding a ranging mode to the VHF Data Exchange System (VDES) is a direction that researchers are now very concerned about. This paper introduces the application of two ranging algorithms TOA and TDOA in VDES system, expounds the positioning principle of the algorithm and then the horizontal dilution of precision (HDOP) of the two algorithms were also compared and summary in detail.

articleTitle: A Method to Improve the Teaching Effect of Mobile Communication Course by Establishing Propagation Loss Model
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In the course of the undergraduate mobile communication, the teaching design of combining theory with practice plays an important role, which not only consolidate the learners' relevant theoretical knowledge, but also enable the learners to experience the difficulties and challenges brought by designing mobile communication systems that conform to the real environment. Firstly, we used MATLAB to simulate the influence of different propagation parameters on propagation loss. Secondly, this paper implemented the measurement scheme through Huawei's E392u-92 terminal, GPS receiver, GENEX Probe software, ENNX Assistant software, SignalLTEMap software, and personal computer, and measured the field strength value of 2.6 GHz mobile communication network of Yunnan Normal University in China. Furthermore, we present a method to calculate the propagation distance based on elevation data, and use the least-square method to correct the propagation loss model (PLM) for different propagation environments. Finally, the three parameters of mean error, root mean square error, and standard deviation are used to evaluate whether the corrected PLM is suitable for real propagation environment. Through the teaching analysis in recent years, we have found that the content of this paper has improved the teaching effect of the mobile communication course and realized the teaching goal of combining theory with practice.

articleTitle: JRAS and LRAS Strategies for Two-Way Full-Duplex Amplify-and-Forward Relaying
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Antenna selection and relay selection for full-duplex (FD) two-way amplify-and-forward relay system, where a multi-antenna node communicates with a single-antenna node via exploiting a series of single-antenna relays, are studied. Tradeoffs between system performance and selection complexity, an optimal joint relay and antenna selection (JRAS) strategy and a suboptimal low-complexity relay and antenna selection (LRAS) strategy are proposed and compared. The evaluation of the two selection strategies are performed by outage probability approximations in closed-form. Furthermore, we analyze the impact of relay location and diversity order on system performance with the two proposed selection strategies. Moreover, the effects of residual self-interference (RSI) caused by FD technique on system performance were given out. Finally, simulation results are used to verify the accuracy of the theoretical analysis.

articleTitle: Secure Transmission Based on Differential Spatial Modulation with Artificial Noise
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In this paper, we investigate the secure transmission based on differential spatial modulation with artificial noise in multiple-input single-output wiretap networks, where a cooperative jammer help the secure transmission between transceivers in the presence of a passive eavesdropper. We derive exact and asymptotic closed-form expressions for secrecy outage probability and effective secrecy throughput of the network. Finally, numerical simulations demonstrate that increasing the transmit power of transmitter or cooperative jammer can improve the secrecy performance of the system, but too large transmit power at transmitter or cooperative jammer is not helpful. Moreover, increasing the number of antennas at transmitter or cooperative jammer brings up better secrecy performance.

articleTitle: Sentiment Classification Based on Specific Target
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In a given target, identifying the emotional polarity of a specific target in a comment based on the context information is a more meaningful and in-depth classification task. Until now, researchers have provided many solutions to solve this task. However, in previous studies, many people have overlooked the link between goals and content. This paper proposes a new model to learn the relationship between goals and contexts. at the same time, it also pays attention to the semantic relationship between sentence words. the experimental results have achieved excellent performance in SemEval 2014 data set.

articleTitle: Facial Expression Recognition Algorithm Based on LDN and SVM
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: This paper proposes a facial expression recognition algorithm based on LDN and SVM. The image in the JAFFE facial expression database is used as the experimental object. The image preprocessing is performed by the histogram equalization method. The LDN feature values of facial expressions are extracted, and then the facial expression feature histogram sequence is classified and trained, and the image was identified by using the trained classification model. Through the simulation test on the MATLAB platform, the experiment proves that the facial expression recognition method is feasible and effective.

articleTitle: Open-Loop Precoding Scheme for Multi-Beam Mobile Satellite Communication Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Multi-beam joint precoding technique has received significant attention since its capability of improving the transmission rate in multi-beam satellite system. Existing works on precoding technique assume the availability of accurate channel-state information (CSI) at the satellite transmitter. Unfortunately, the precoding method has suffered considerable limitations due to the huge transmission delay in mobile satellite communication system. To deal with the problem, this paper proposes an open-loop multi-beam joint precoding scheme. This state-of-the-art strategy compensates for the drawbacks of the conventional precoding schemes. In addition, an optimal power allocation scheme is also presented to put the system resource to good use and further eliminate the effects of inter-beam interference as well as channel fading. Simulation results demonstrate substantial performance gains compared with traditional frequency reuse scheme.

articleTitle: Improved Joint Unitary ESPRIT Target Tracking Algorithm for Bistatic MIMO Radar
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: A number of joint direction-of-departure (DOD) and direction-of-arrival (DOA) estimation algorithms have been proposed over the last few decades for target position estimation. However, the pairing process between the DODs and DOAs estimation results in high computational complexity. In this paper, we propose an improved unitary estimation method of signal parameters via rotational invariance technique (U-ESPRIT) algorithm for joint DOD and DOA estimation without a pairing operation. Therefore the algorithm is able to avoid a pairing process and reduce calculation cost. The simulation results demonstrate that the proposed algorithm can effectively enhance the accuracy of identifying and locating targets for bistatic multiple-input multiple-output radar system.

articleTitle: Incomplete Contract-Based Ownership Allocation for Operator in Mobile Edge Computing
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Mobile edge computing (MEC) has emerged as an appealing paradigm to accommodate demands for computation intensive applications. By investing in resources in MEC, departments (DPs) of the operator (OP) can move services closer to network edge, which receive profits from their respective investment in different resources. The trading of resources and services between DPs is usually modeled as a long-time contract. In this paper, we study the relationship between the ownership allocation and invest policy of DP, and then we investigate the problem that how to choose the optimal investments in an MEC scenario. In specific, we first develop a general investment system model with multiple DPs of the OP to participate in MEC. Then, we formulate the optimal investments of the utility maximization problem. Furthermore, we focus on a special ownership allocations with two DPs and two resources. An analysis of the ownership allocation and invest efficiency is given. Finally, simulation results demonstrate that DPs are motivated to make more investments and receive more utilities under its own integration.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Production Planning Management System Based on SSH
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In order to effectively improve the development efficiency of manufacturing enterprises production management systems, and reduce the costs of development and maintenance, this article aims to propose a solution of B/S architecture based on SSH, which is based on the software requirements of the process of production procedure and data statistics analysis of a large state-owned steel enterprise, and through researching the Struts, Spring and Hibernate framework mechanism. According to the principle of the MVC3 layer architecture, the solution uses Hibernate technology to carry out bottom package for database operation, realizes the controller layer with Struts technology, separates and encapsulates the business logic of the production procedure with Spring technology according to the low coupling standard. At last, a real-time monitoring application system with features of human-computer interaction and constantly monitoring the entire production procedure line is designed, which improves the timeliness and controllability of the whole process from product planning, production, sales and delivery. The case shows that the SSH fusion architecture reduces the application complexity and coupling, and improves the development efficiency and maintainability of the system and enhances the scalability of the system in building complex business systems.

articleTitle: REEFS: An SDN Hyper File System Based on Erasure Coding
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: This study proposes a hyper file system, named REEFS (Resilient Erasure-codE File System), which is based on erasure code (EC) and integrates the technologies of software defined networking (SDN) and the distributed file system (DFS). REEFS utilizes the EC to encode a data object or file into n blocks for storing in n storage nodes in the DFS. REEFS is fault-tolerant since any k out of the n blocks can recover the data object. An algorithm, called Residual Network Multiple Shortest Path (RNMSP), is developed for finding the shortest paths from the file source to n storage nodes to reduce the file data block transmission latency, while maintaining high data availability. The shortest paths are used by the SDN controller to manage SDN switches to forward block data. The RNMSP algorithm is compared with other related algorithms to show its superiority in terms of the average file transmission latency.

articleTitle: Short-Term Load Combination Forecasting Based on Cluster Analysis
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Short-term load forecasting in power grids is a necessary part of designing larger power systems and its accuracy can affect real-time control and security functions. So, this paper proposes a new method, which have better performance by using cluster analysis. For the purposed of reducing the redundancy of the training samples and making the training more targeted, this paper proposes the PSO-AFCM clustering algorithm to select similar days. We use an adaptive function that can determine the number of clusters, and optimize the adaptive FCM clustering algorithm with PSO to avoid falling into local convergence. Therefore, the PSO-AFCM clustering algorithm can improve the accuracy of clustering and make the selection of similar days more precise. Finally, the LMBP-Elman-LSSVM combined prediction model is used for load forecasting. The example shows that the proposed method improves the prediction performance and improves the accuracy of load prediction by comparing with the traditional LMBP neural network, Elman neural network and LSSVM.

articleTitle: On Practical Applications of Channel-Aware Polar Codes
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Channel-specific property of polar coding deteriorates error-correcting performance once the channel is time variant or the estimation of bit-channels is inaccurate. Therefore it restricts the feasibility of polar codes on several applications. One of the solutions is channel-aware construction of polar codes, which adjust the construction to match the current channel on the fly. To reduce time and space complexity, the channel-awareness is executed only for the bit-channels in window size. However, how large enough for a window size is ambiguous in literature. In this paper, two algorithms are proposed to optimize the window size of channel-aware polar codes. In addition, the performance of channel-aware polar codes with practical constraints and channels are provided. The experiment results show that there is almost no performance loss when the practical issues are considered, and the advantage of channel-awareness would be obvious in practice.

articleTitle: Crack Detection Using Fast Spectral Clustering Considering Graph Connectivity
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Cracks on pavement roads cause various traffic problems. Therefore we should repair them properly. Nowadays a variety of crack detection methods in computer vision have been proposed. Spectral clustering is one of them and an effective method, but suffers from processing time due to the large amount of calculation. Among them, calculating of Laplacian-matrix and eigenvalues especially affect processing time. Therefore we propose two methods to improve the efficiency of algorithm. One applies sparse process considering graph connectivity for Laplacian-matrix, and the other considers amount of pixel of crack of pavement road images.

articleTitle: Topological Interference Management for Three-Cell MIMO-NOMA with Alternating Connectivity
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Topological interference management refers to the methodology of increasing the capacity of interference communication networks in which the transmitters have no knowledge of CSIT but the network topology structure. In this paper, the topological interference management problem is studied for the three-cell MIMO-NOMA scenario under alternating connectivity states where base stations (BSs) are allowed to track changes in topology structure and a mixed CSIT setting is exploited. The novel degrees of freedom (DoF) outer bound of the network is derived and the corresponding achievability is further investigated. Besides, the case where all connectivity states are equiprobable is also analyzed.

articleTitle: Channel Calibration Method for ISAR Imaging System
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: When the inverse synthetic aperture radar (ISAR) system images the target, the radar emits a wide band linear frequency modulation (LFM) signal. The received echo is modulated by the radar transmitting channel and receiving channel, which is no longer an ideal LFM signal. Then the echo is mismatched with the ideal matched filter, which results in the range profile defocusing. In order to improvSe the imaging quality, a channel calibration method for the ISAR imaging system is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the radar illuminates nearby fixed-point target and receives the baseband echo. Secondly, construct the channel calibration coefficient with an ideal matched filter to eliminate the adverse effect on imaging caused by the non-ideal characteristics of transmitting channel and receiving channel. Simulation experiments verified the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Affine and Magnitude Transforms Based Data Augmentation Comparison for SAR Automatic Target Recognition
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In this paper, we investigate and compare multiple data augmentation techniques in image classification targeting SAR images. Previous research showed that simple data augmentation techniques are still proven to be effective such as Affine transformations, cropping, flipping and color inverting training images. We use the SDMS MSTAR Public dataset, apply data augmentation techniques once at a time and record the results for the same convoluted neural network. Traditional transformations are powerful, however there is still no clear way to choose among infinitely many ways to augment the training data. A comparative study of simple Affine and color based augmentation techniques for SAR images is proposed. Finally we discuss the reasons why some strategies are more successful than others for the case of radar images.

articleTitle: Web Evaluation Analysis of Tourism Destinations Based on Data Mining
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: The paper aims to analyze the emotional tendencies of the massive tourism reviews released by the tourists through OTA online, combined with the models of the emotional analysis in the tourism field and the advanced technologies such as big data, artificial intelligence and so on. According to the unstructured text information of online reviews, this paper adopts the Expand Vector Space Model (EVSM for short) to represent text knowledge and Web Text Classification Algorithm to extract the emotional features of tourists effectively. The experimental results illustrate the algorithm is easy to implement with high performance and accuracy. Furthermore, an empirical study on tourism resources of Hainan Province is conducted in the final as the important references of tourism marketing strategies, which involves the emotional analysis on tourism web evaluation of the 5A and 4A scenic spots and data analysis of communication operator on the inherent rules of tourists such as interests, trails and consumption behaviors.

articleTitle: An Novel Face Image Super-Resolution Based on Sparse Representation and Wasserstein Distance
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Face super-resolution has attracted much attention in recent years. Many algorithms have been proposed. However, these approaches only perform well under the condition that the input is noiseless or has small noise. These existing approaches think the measure of between LR and HR is Euclidean distance. Euclidean distance cannot measure well the condition that the image's pixel values tend to have random fluctuations of varying magnitudes or the image is represented as sparse high-dimensional data. In this paper, we propose a novel sparse representation and Wasserstein distance based face super-resolution approach that seem the measure of between LR and HR as Wasserstein distance. Specifically, we introduce the fused Lasso to the least squares representation of the input LR image in order to obtain a stable sparse representation, especially when the noise level of the input LR image is high. Experiments are carried out on the benchmark FERET face dataset. Visual and quantitative comparisons show that the proposed face super-resolution method achieves comparable performance to the state-of-the-art methods under noiseless condition, and yields superior super-resolution results when the input LR face image is contaminated by strong noise.

articleTitle: DPDA: A Moving Target Defense System Based on Detection and Prediction Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: As a new technology to change the rules of cyberspace games, moving target defense provides a new idea for reversing the asymmetry between the attacker and defender. This paper proposes a moving target defense system based on detection and prediction mechanism--DPDA system (detection-prediction-defense-assessment system), which utilizes the centralized control and programming flexibility of the SDN network. DPDA system is modeled as a discrete event dynamic system (DEDS), and performs detection of existing attacks based on real-time events. On the other hand, the attack probability transformation is used to adjust the transformation period based on the log-normal distribution function for unknown attacks. Finally, the simulation test environment is built. The results show that DPDA can implement more efficient active defense than the system with fixed transformation period.

articleTitle: ISAR False Target Array Generated by Sub-Nyquist Sampling Jamming in Fast and Slow Time
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Sub-Nyquist sampling is a common means of interfering with inverse synthetic aperture radar (ISAR) imaging, which has been validated for the feasibility of sub-Nyquist sampling jamming against ISAR imaging in down range domain. In order to generate more false target images, taking sub-Nyquit sampling in both domains to get false target image array is proposed in this framework. The jamming signals, which are formed by the intercepted radar signals under the sub-Nyquist sampling theorem and scattered by moving targets, are collected by ISAR to obtain final images show that the deceptive false-target images retaining the real target information will be induced. Simulated trails and real data of a Yak-42 plane are used to validate the correctness of the analyses and the finally well-focused false-target images greatly support the effectiveness of the sub-Nyquist sampling idea in the countermeasures of ISAR.

articleTitle: Research on Regional Traffic State Identification Method Based on MRGA-FCM
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: To solve the problem of traffic state identification for regional road network which includes large amount of data and difficult calculation, improve every link of the fuzzy C-means clustering algorithm, a traffic state identification method for urban road network was proposed combined with genetic algorithm and MapReduce parallel programming model of cloud computing. A typical road network environment with twelve intersections was set up in VISSIM simulate software, and the model was verified by the simulated data. Experiment results show that the proposed model can accurately identify the traffic state of the road network, and greatly improve the efficiency of traffic state identification.

articleTitle: Multi-criteria Collaborative Filtering Based on Matrix Filling
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In multi-criteria collaborative filtering, the data sparsity is a critical factor affecting the effectiveness of the algorithm. Existing solutions generally remove low-efficiency data through dimensionality reduction, decomposition, etc. While at lower data dimension, they also lose original data information, which impacts the accuracy of predicted ratings. This paper adopts a new processing strategy and proposes to use the matrix filling method to handle the missing data. Firstly, an improved similarity algorithm combined with the Jaccard Similarity Coefficient is used to calculate the predicted rating. Secondly, the Reliable Factor is introduced to prevent the error of filling data. Finally, multiple linear regression is employed for aggregating the ratings of the criteria to eventually yield preferred predicted ratings. A series of experiments show that the proposed method can precisely reflect the user's similarity and achieve better results in predicted ratings, in contrast to traditional methods.

articleTitle: Joint Encoding/Decoding Algorithm Design Based on Hidden Information for Short-Length LT Codes
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: To handle problems of the low encoding efficiency and the high decoding cost in short-length LT code, a novel joint encoding and decoding optimization method is proposed in this paper. Based on the weighted statistical probability value of original information groups, the encoding optimization algorithm targeting at transmitting original information groups uniformly is presented at the transmitter. And a multi-layer decoding algorithm with vary number of layers, which utilizes the the redundancy information in the stopping set is proposed to achieve a tradeoff between the computation complexity and the redundancy cost at the receiver. Simulation results under different conditions demonstrate that the proposed encoding and decoding optimization method could improve the encoding efficiency significantly and could reduce the decoding overhead effectively.

articleTitle: A Fuzzy Logic Based Warning Scheme of Monitoring Systems for IoT Cloud Services
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: A reliable monitoring system is significant to guarantee the equilibrium operation of cloud services. Based on the monitoring system, a novel state warning scheme using fuzzy logic is proposed in this paper. The improved exponential smoothing algorithm is applied to predict the reference value and calculate the dynamic threshold interval. Then, the service overall abnormal degree from each monitoring indicator can be obtained by designing and applying the fuzzy logic. Therefore, the system can respond quickly based on the evaluated alarm level. Finally, several experiments are conducted to evaluate the performances of the proposed warning scheme.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Active Cancellation System Based on DRFM
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Based on the basic principle and key technology of the repeater cancellation system, an airborne active repeater cancellation stealth system based on DRFM is designed. Considering the influence of energy cancellaty, target echo signal-to-noise ratio and radar detection factor synthetically, The influence of system direction finding error on is analyzed and based on radar uncertainty principle, regarding the delay measurement error of the incident radar signal under the Gaussian envelope as upper bound, the analysis method of system performance limit is given. Simulation results show that the decrease of the distance between target and radar will increase the cancellation performance requirement of the system and it requires high system direction finding accuracy to have a good cancellation effect. However, when the signal envelope is Gaussian envelope, the system cannot achieve highperformance cancellation stealth.

articleTitle: Modeling Wireless Sensor Networks on FPGA Platform: A Stochastic Network Calculus Approach
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Weibull fading channel has a wide range of applications in wireless fading channels as we know today. In this paper, an FPGA-based wireless channel emulator is presented. We investigate the quality of service (QoS) performance of wireless channels subject to weibull fading channel on an FPGA platform based on stochastic network calculus. In order to analyze the performance, we aim at deriving the service curve of weibull fading channel. With the closed-form stochastic service curve, the QoS performance like stochastic delay and backlog bound can be derived. Simulation results verify that the delay and backlog are inversely proportional to their bounds. Moreover, through numerical experiments, we show the method is not only capable of deriving stochastic performance bounds, but also can provide guidelines for designing transmission strategies on FPGA platform.

articleTitle: MAC Protocol Analysis Based on Adaptive Wireless Sensor Network
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: High performance communication of wireless sensor network requires MAC protocol to have QoS guarantee function to meet the real-time and reliability requirements of data transmission. The protocol adaptively adjusts the number of sites access and the arrival rate of information grouping to meet the requirements of video voice services such as average waiting time, average site length and throughput. Simulation results show that the protocol model does not change IEEE802.11 standard channel access, without any additional communication overhead, improves both network throughput performance and QoS functionality.

articleTitle: Magnetic Ring Detection System Based on Multi-camera Vision Technology
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Magnetic rings play an important role in the manufacture of high-tech products in the fields of aerospace, military electronics, and automobiles, whose manual detection of surface defects is costly, inefficient, and low-precision. In order to solve these problems, this paper proposes a magnetic ring multi-defective stereo detection system based on group vision technology, which completes the detection of each surface of three-dimensional magnetic ring. The detection algorithm has a recognition rate of 100% for defects such as cracks, adhesions, hanger adhesions, pitting, and a recognition rate of more than 90% for defects such as fibers and foreign objects. The average working speed of the system is over 120 per minutes and the defect detection accuracy is within 0.05 mm. The accuracy and efficiency of the system can completely meet the requirements of actual production.

articleTitle: Research on Key Management Scheme for Dynamic Revocable Key-Aggregate Cryptosystem
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: With the development of cloud storage technology, how to realize ciphertext sharing on the basis of the security of cloud data has become an urgent problem to be solved. According to the demand of secure and efficient ciphertext sharing access for many kinds of ciphertext data in the cloud, this paper proposes a key management scheme for DRKAC. This scheme supports dynamic growth of data categories and user revocable. Safety analysis shows that this scheme is forward security. And formal analysis shows that this scheme is CPA security.

articleTitle: A Model-driven Approach for Formal Verification of Embedded Systems Using Timed Colored Petri Nets
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: The exponential use of time dependant and concurrent embedded systems in safety critical situations demands correctness of their behavior. Early design phase verification techniques allow us to ensure system's safety with minimum cost. In Model Driven Software Engineering (MDSE), Unified Modeling Language (UML) is considered as a standard way to visualize system's design but it is a semiformal language and lacks support for precise verification mechanisms to guarantee system's safety. To solve this issue, we have proposed a model driven approach to formalize timed and concurrent embedded systems using Timed Colored Petri Nets. This paper describes the rules for transformation of timed UML State Machines (source model) to Timed Colored Petri Nets (target model). We have focused on timing and behavioral aspects of concurrent embedded systems. We have also demonstrated the applicability of our approach with the help of a benchmark case study using CPN Tools.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Tobacco Slice Feeding Based on Semi-supervised Learning
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In order to improve the uniformity and the utilization rate of the feed liquid in the process of wet leaf feeding and reduce the reduction value of the brightness of the tobacco slice. Under the condition of no circulating hot air, the liquid macromolecular mass was cut into small molecular mass using the small molecular processor of permanent strong magnetic material liquid and the influence of tobacco slice feeding on the uniformity of feeding, the change of the lightness value of the tobacco slice and the sensory quality is analyzed. We can draw the conclusion by semi-supervised clustering analysis: under the condition of no circulating hot air, through the process of the small molecules of material liquid and when the radial Angle of the nozzle is 87.2°, the axial Angle of the nozzle is 91.6°, storage time is 4 h, the uniformity of feeding increased to 62.95%, the decreased value of the brightness of the tobacco slice reduced 2.28 and the sensory evaluation value increased 3.94.

articleTitle: A Low-Loss Broadband One-Way Transmission Structure Based on Nonreciprocal Coupling
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Based on Surface plasmons States (MSPs) and coupling effect, a novel low-loss broadband one-way transmission structure is proposed in this paper, which composes of a two-way transmission line channel and two one-way ferrite loop channels. By applying a static bias magnetic field (BMF), One-way Edge States (OWES) of ferrite are excited, which results in the unidirectional coupling between the two-way channel and one-way channel. Excellent forward transmission efficiency can be achieved due to the cut-off of the forward coupling. On the other hand, the good coupling of the reversed transmission ensures good isolation. By cascading two one-way channels, a broadband property can be achieved for the structure is equivalent to a multi-frequency bandstop filter. To validate the design, a prototype was fabricated and measured. Both the simulation and experiment results verify the low-loss one-way transmission property.

articleTitle: Dynamic Memory Access Monitoring Based on VMM
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Memory access monitoring is an important fine-grained monitoring method, which monitors system status at single instruction execution and data access level. However, this kind of fine-grained monitoring method based on VMM (Virtual Machine Monitor) causes significant performance overhead, especially when monitoring dynamic data. This is because safety critical data and non-critical data is located mixed in memory, while the hardware only supports monitoring central memory regions. In this paper, we will propose a dynamic and flexible memory access monitoring method, named DynMon, which can adjust the timing to monitor and select the critical data to be monitored automatically. DynMon monitors safety-critical data and significantly reduces performance overhead by triggering monitoring only when it is highly likely that these data will be accessed. Besides, DynMon can be easily deployed on systems with support of hardware-assisted virtualization, while it does not need any modification of the monitored system. In the evaluation, the results show that DynMon can reduce 22.23% performance overhead. Besides, the performance cost can be tolerated, when monitoring the safety-critical data set in out prototype.

articleTitle: The Design of Soft Base Station Based on Docker
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Today's mobile network is increasingly developing toward virtualization. Through Network Function Virtualization (NFV) [1], we can flexibly deploy BS to virtual machines. Some signal processing modules implemented by software have extremely high complexity and real-time requirements, such as LTE turbo decoder [2], FFT. General-purpose computer is difficult to satisfy these requirements, the virtual machine is even worse. To solve above challenges, in this paper, we propose to design the LTE soft base stations(SBS) in Docker [3], utilize a range of hardware accelerators (HA) to speed up signal processing and design an efficient HA framework for multiple SBSs sharing the HA resources simultaneously. In our design, the real computer has multiple FPGA accelerators with different functions, which are accessed by a unified Linux driver. Each SBS runs in a Docker container and has a virtual acceleration memory. They can send processing requests and get responses to communicate with the host OS by reading and writing to the memory. In host OS, we design an efficient scheduler to distribute processing task to HA. In this paper, we use LTE turbo decoder as an example of a hardware accelerator and evaluate the performance by running multiple 10M bandwidth LTE SBS.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Business Processes Efficiency Analysis System
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: With the continuous development of information technology, most enterprises have realized office automation and the business process runs through the whole life of enterprise activities. The importance of business processes to modern enterprises is self-evident. With the development of business processes, business process reengineering as an advanced management theory has become an important issue in the production and management of modern enterprises. However, most companies do not have a efficiency analysis system to evaluate existing business processes, so they cannot effectively reengineer business processes. In addition, the cost of process reengineering is very high, and blind transformation will result in a waste of manpower, material resources and financial resources. So, although the business process reengineering theory has been advanced, the implementation success rate is very low. In this paper analyzes and studies the composition and characteristics of Primeton platform. Based on this, a business process efficiency analysis system is constructed, which can dynamically and accurately display the efficiency of the department and activity nodes. The system provides a reliable data reference for business process reengineering and can effectively guide companies to effectively evaluate existing business processes.

articleTitle: Design and Realization of Covers Monitoring and Controlling System
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: At present, the urban pipe networks are widely distributed and of various kinds. The existing technology cannot detect and deal with the abnormality of covers in pipe networks in time, which may easily lead to hidden danger and threaten the safety of life and property. To solve such problems, a convenient and low-cost intelligent covers monitoring and controlling system is designed. This paper mainly studied the design and the realization of the platform. Its' function mainly includes the localization management of the cover, cover status real-time detection and alarm for abnormal information, covers basic information management (including addition, delete, modification and query of the data), covers maintenance history record and query (including maintenance date, type, and head). This platform is realized with C# programming. GIS map is added to realize the location display of the covers. The terminals and the platform adopt Modbus RTU protocol standard to realize communication with GPRS wireless network. The basic information and monitoring history of the covers are stored in the Access database. The operation shows that the platform performs well.

articleTitle: An Adaptive Multicast Bandwidth Allocation Mechanism in TDM-WDM PONs
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In this paper, an adaptive bandwidth allocation mechanism is proposed for the efficiency of multicast services in TDM WDM PONs. First, in the downstream direction, analyze data collision of ONUs between different wavelengths as the mixed integer linear programming model, and solve it by the heuristic algorithm that assigns correlated ONU's assignment to wavelengths. Next, calculate adaptive weights allocation between multicast sessions to guarantee the fairness. Simulation results show that this mechanism can achieve better bandwidth utilization and higher throughput when the traffic load is heavy.

articleTitle: A Mixed Signal Separation Algorithm Based on Wavelet Transform
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: When there is fault in the gearbox whose support is elastic, the vibration signal is complicated. Using the traditional methods for fault diagnosis may get wrong result. Based on the analysis of the characteristics of the steady modulation and impulse modulation signals, a mixed signal separation algorithm using the advantages of the inner product transform and the wavelet packet transform is proposed. Firstly the steady modulation components are extracted from the signal by taking inner production between the signal and the various basis functions. Then the impact modulation ones are gotten from the remaining parts of the signal by using wavelet transform. The simulation result and the experiment result show that the proposed method can extract the two kinds of signals effectively.

articleTitle: A Fast Object Proposal Assessment Method Based on Edge Directions
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Closed boundary is a powerful cue for objectness assessment in object proposal generation. We observe that a closed boundary should consist of as many as possible block edge directions when it is divided into small blocks, and the amount of different block edge directions should be roughly the same in consideration of the refl ectional symmetry of an object. Based on this observation, we propose a fast object proposal generation method, where a novel edge-directions-based objectness feature and a simple objectness measurement in terms of entropy are pro-posed for effi cient objectness assessment. The objectness feature is designed to describe the distribution of edge orientations. For computational reasons, each block edge direction is represented by using the non-normalized Haar transform (NHT) coeffi cients which requires only several integer addition and subtraction operations. Experiments on the Pascal VOC2007 dataset show that the proposed method takes the least running time which requires only 0.03 second to generate a set of high-quality object proposals for an image, and achieves comparable performance compared with state-of-the-art methods.

articleTitle: Photographic Image Synthesis with Highway Residual U-net
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Photographic image synthesis is a new research focus in the field of deep learning, which uses the known image description information to generate the image approaching to the real scene. In this paper, a novel photographic image synthesis method based on the highway residual U-net (HRU) is proposed. The proposed highway residual blocks (HRBs) are embedded between the levels of the U-net and the proposed HRBs effectively filter the information transmitted by each level of the U-net and speed up the convergence of the network. In addition, the resize-convolution layers in HRU are used to replace the deconvolution layers to reduce the checkerboard artifacts in the synthesized images. HRU can be trained end-to-end with the image description map and the corresponding photographic image. Extensive experiments on Cityscapes dataset and GTA5 dataset demonstrate that images synthesized by the presented approach are considerably more realistic than other synthetic approaches.

articleTitle: Synergistic Union of Word Embedding and Knowledge Graph for Words Semantic Similarity Measure
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: This paper presents a method for measuring the semantic similarity between words. The previous work on words semantic similarity measure have focused on either knowledge based or word embedding based. However semantic similarity between words do not perform well within specific domains. Therefore in this paper we introduce a word semantic similarity measure namely KVEC that was created by the synergistic union of word embedding based and knowledge graph based semantic similarity methods. Through experiments performed on proverbial word similarity dataset, we show that KVEC semantic similarity method whose maximum correlation coefficient reached 0.818, which outperform both, knowledge based method and word embedding method training on corpus.

articleTitle: An Improved On-line Strategy for Exploring a Simple Grid Polygon
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: This paper considers the problem of exploring an unknown simple grid polygon with a mobile robot. The robot is equipped with a short-sighted sensor that can only detect the four cells adjacent to its current position. The robot starts from a specified cell s which is adjacent to the polygon's boundary. The goal of the robot is to visit each cell and to return to s. We are interested in the strategies that can lead the robot to complete this task with a short exploration tour. The performance of the strategy is measured in terms of the competitive ratio, with respect to the length of the optimal path for an exploration with complete knowledge of the polygon. We propose a new on-line exploration strategy which achieves a competitive ratio of 7/6.

articleTitle: Research on Stylistic Features in Translation Based on Supervised Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: This paper uses supervised classification algorithms to study the changes of stylistic features caused by the translators and the differences between Chinese and English languages in the process of translation. We collect the original and translation works of A Tale of Two Cities and Jane Eyre in English and Chinese. Firstly, we make a list of features and calculate these values of texts for each stylistic feature. Then the Information Gain (IG) values of each stylistic feature in both Chinese and English texts are calculated respectively. Finally, the values of each feature are added to each classifier in order according to their IG values to observe the performance of each classifier. This paper analyzes the change about stylistic features' competence in distinguishing texts in the process of translation, from the perspective of contrastive linguistics and the translator roles and so on. The experimental results show that the ability of each classifier to distinguish the style differences in the translation version is mostly decreased compared with the original one. After translation, the IG values and orders of each stylistic feature vary greatly.

articleTitle: An Adaptive Predistortion Algorithm Based on Parallel Two-Box Model
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of predistortion algorithm in the authors' previous works[1], which need set the threshold value threshold in advance according to the amplitude distribution characteristics of modulation signal and PA model, this paper construct the objective function, analysis the relationship between the objective function and the BER performance of system, and on this basis, an adaptive predistortion algorithm based on parallel two-box method is proposed. The proposed method adjusts the threshold value threshold automatically, which can guarantee the BER performance of system under AWGN channel consists with the original parallel two-box model, improve the work efficiency of predistortion algorithm, the computation complexity of the proposed method was less than 70%.

articleTitle: Median Based Wiener Filtering interpolation method for Progressive display using Local Homogeneous Area Selector
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: This paper proposes an efficient intra-field deinterlacing algorithms using local adaptive median-based Wiener filtering interpolation method (LAMWF) using Local Homogeneous Area Selector (LHAS). The LHAS is introduced to determine the local homogeneous area where the center unknown pixels belongs to. After using LHAS, a median-based Wκiener filter is proposed to interpolate the missing unknown pixel. Since LAMWF is only implemented on the optimal neighboring pixels in a homogeneous area, which makes it has good capacity of preserving edge and texture details. Experimental results have shown the efficiency of the proposed method with significant improvement over conventional methods in terms of both objective PSNR performance and subjective image qualities. What is more, it has benefit of lower complexity than most of the existing algorithms.

articleTitle: An Optimized Anti-Noise Receiving Method Based on Spreading Spectrum Audio Watermarking System
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In spreading spectrum audio watermarking system, the random noise on full-frequency is very common, which greatly affects the receiving efficiency. In this paper, we proposed an optimized receiving method, which is specially used to resist full-frequency domain random noise. For most audio signals, especially voice signals, the energy is mainly concentrated in the middle and low frequency bands, and the energy in high frequency band is less. We take advantage of this feature to optimize the performance of spreading spectrum audio watermarking system. Experimental results show that our optimized receiving method will ultimately improve the decoding performance.

articleTitle: A Fusion Prognostics Framework for Electronic System
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Based on the research and analysis of prognostics technology in Prognostics and Health Management(PHM) and its technological evolution, the state of the art of prognostics methods at home and abroad is classified and summarized. Combined with the advantages of fault prognostics based on physics-of-failure model and fault prognostics based on condition monitoring, a conceptual framework based on fusion prognostics of electronic systems is proposed, and the workflow is described in detail. Finally, the existing problems and challenges of prognostics technology for electronic system are analyzed, and the main development direction of the technology is prospected.

articleTitle: Fault Detecting and Excluding upon S-RANCO and Lagrange Interpolation
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS) plays an important role in modern society. However, the receiver may obtain wrong measurements because of faults on one or more satellites, which may lead to positioning deviation. Due to the above reason, the ability to detect and exclude satellite faults is very important to help us ensure the accuracy of positioning. Receiver Autonomous Integrity Monitoring (RAIM) is a kind of technology used in domain of GNSS to detect fault. In this paper a novel methodology is proposed for fault detecting and excluding (FDE), which has two steps based on S-RANCO and Lagrange Interpolation. First, the S-RANCO algorithm is used to find the satellites that produce the error measurements. Then, the Lagrange Interpolation is used to infer the current measured value with the measurements of the historical epochs. Simulation results show that positioning with the integration of S-RANCO and Lagrange Interpolation is more accurate than both positioning with all satellites and positioning with all satellites without fault.

articleTitle: Enabling Smart Cities through V2X Communication
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: This paper provides a framework where autonomous vehicles (AV) enable better Smart Cities. Large amounts of data are constantly collected from AVs. To manage the constant influx of data, a real-time data model is proposed. To demonstrate how the database works, four use cases have been introduced as follows: (1) Detecting traffic congestion (2) Identifying empty parking spots (3) Determining weather conditions for a specific location, and (4) Detecting objects or dead animals on the road. The proposed data model will enable real-time data-driven decision-making. The framework can be easily expanded to include other use cases in the future.

articleTitle: Application of Modified K-Means Clustering Algorithm in Battery Grouping
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In the production process of lithium-ion battery, the inconsistency of single cell characteristics in battery pack will seriously affect the whole life and performance of battery pack. In this paper, a lithium-ion battery grouping model is proposed, which includes a data preprocessing model and a novel battery grouping method of K-means algorithm to meet the specific requirements. In the battery data preprocessing model, the faulty battery is removed by designing the process data preprocessing method and actual production standards. In the battery matching algorithm, an improved K-means algorithm is proposed. After the battery grouping is completed, the number of batteries in each cluster is equal. Additionally, experiments for battery grouping and method validation are designed. Compared with the actual method, the proposed method proves its effectiveness.

articleTitle: Research on Simulation Modeling of Tactical Communication Subnet Availability
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Tactical communication network systems are large in scale, widely distributed, and prone to failure. This paper analyzes it and proposes a calculation method for the tactical communication subnet usability standard. Then, the Monte Carlo fault-driven method is used to study the availability simulation of the typical tactical communication level subnet studied, and given a modeling example. This method has certain reference value in the experiment and inspection of tactical communication network availability.

articleTitle: Iterative MIMO Detection Algorithm Based on Successive Interference Cancellation in Multi-cell Scenario
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Multiple input multiple output (MIMO) detection technology, according to the receiver type, can be divided into linear receiver and nonlinear receiver, wherein the linear MMSE algorithm represented. However, other iterative MIMO detection algorithms, despite the complexity involved, have excellent performance. The main idea of this paper is the detection algorithm in the case of spatial multiplexing, and the simulation is carried out in the multi-cell scenario with co-channel interference. Based on the idea of successive interference cancellation algorithm, MMSE-IRC (interference rejection combining) is introduced to replace MMSE to improve the detection performance with low complexity. The simulation results show that the proposed scheme is better than the existing linear detection algorithms.

articleTitle: Power Allocation for Uplink Cognitive Heterogeneous Network with Nonorthogonal Multiple Access
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In this paper, we propose an optimal power allocation scheme in an uplink two-tier heterogeneous cognitive network with non-orthogonal multiple access (NOMA). Secondary users (SUs) in femtocell tier are allowed to access the licensed frequency band owned by macrocell tier in underlay spectrum sharing mode, which causes severe cross-tier interference. We propose an optimal power allocation scheme by considering the cross-tier interference control from the femtocell tier to the macrocell tier and adopting successive interference cancellation (SIC) to improve the spectrum efficiency within the femtocell tier. The effectiveness of the proposed power allocation scheme on the performance of spectrum efficiency and cross-tier interference mitigation validates by simulation.

articleTitle: A Full Life Cycle Monitoring Information System for Cigarette Equipments
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In order to improve enterprises equipment operation efficiency, ensure online product quality, promote energy saving and reduce consumption, this paper proposes standardization of life cycle management information system for cigarette equipment based on TnPM (total normalized productive maintenance) management concept, equipment performance evaluation and health management idea.

articleTitle: The Research on M2M Load Prediction Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: With the development of Internet of things and mobile communication network, more and more devices have the abilities of communication and networking, which makes all terminal devices to connect the network changing into reality gradually. However, with the explosion of machine-type's communication equipment, the problem of preamble collision in random access process becomes more and more prominent. In this article, a hidden markov load based on feedback correction is proposed for M2M network random access. By observing the status of preambles at the base station terminal, real-time load prediction was made for M2M access terminals at different time points, and the predicted load value was fitted with historical data to reduce the error of load prediction. Compared with the existing load prediction algorithm through simulation, the proposed scheme can predict the load of access terminal in real time, significantly improve the system access success rate and reduce the total service time.

articleTitle: A Network Slicing Deployment Method for Guaranteeing Service Performance
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In order to deal with the performance degradation caused by resource contention due to the sharing of physical resources between VNFs in the network slicing, we proposed a network slicing deployment method for guaranteeing service performance. Firstly, estimate the basic performance level of VNF from the perspective of resource supply and demand. Then select the candidate deployment servers for VNF, the candidate servers can guarantee the basic performance level of both new incoming and already deployed VNFs. Finally, to reduce deployment costs, our approach uses the candidate server on the shortest path as the final deployment server.
