The simulation results show that this method not only can reduce performance degradation on physical servers, but also can reduce operating costs.

articleTitle: Blind Identification of Signals with Stochastic Frequency Offset in Non-Cooperative Environment
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: With no knowledge of the transmitted data and multiple unknown parameters of the receiver, blind identification is vulnerable to frequency offset. In this paper, we present a frequency offset estimation algorithm based on the kernel method and an unsupervised method termed as density and metric based spectral clustering analysis (DMSC), so as to identify the modulation type of signals. The stochastic frequency offset is estimated by maximum likelihood based kernel method. Then a new spectral clustering method is therefore proposing to identify the modulation type of signals. We send 8QAM signals of which the frequency offset obeys Rayleigh, normal and gamma distribution. The classification error rate of our method is lower than k-means and traditional spectral clustering method.

articleTitle: How Do HPC Programmers Mix MPC and SMC in Distributed Computing Environment?
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In today's distributed computing environment where clustered symmetrical multi-processing (SMP) nodes interconnect via high-speed network, message passing concurrency (MPC) model is perfectly applicable to inter-node communication and shared memory concurrency (SMC) model applies to intra-node computation. Mixing MPC with SMC in distributed applications is a common programming practice. However, it's unclear how high-performance computing (HPC) developers mix concurrency models. We investigated twenty-two representative mixing HPC applications collected from super-computing laboratories, research-purpose benchmarks and the open source world. Our investigation shows that there are mainly two mixing modes, namely separated mode and tangled mode. Among twenty-two applications, fifteen mix in separated mode while seven others perform mixing in tangled mode. We further find tangled mode is more complicated and error prone than separated mode. We therefore suggest when performing mixing, distributed applications should mix MPC with SMC in separated mode if possible.

articleTitle: Face Alignment Based on 3D Morphable Model
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Cascaded regression has recently become the method of choice for solving non-linear least squares problems such as deformable image alignment. Given a sizeable training set, cascaded regression method learns a set of generic rules that are sequentially applied to solve the least squares problem. Despite the success of cascaded regression for problems such as face alignment and head pose estimation, there are several shortcomings arising in the strategies proposed thus far. For example, the result is sensitive to the initial shape and the storage of the model is too large, and no robustness to self-occlusion. This paper proposes an approach to solve that problem. First, we reconstruct the 3D face from a 2D face image with arbitrary poses and expressions. Second, we project the 3D face shape model to the 2D plane, then we can get a 2D face shape. Third, we use the projected 2D face shape as the initial shape for the cascaded regression instead of the generic mean shape. Comparing to the existing methods the proposed method can increase the accuracy of the face alignment under confirming appropriate performance.

articleTitle: Speech Enhancement Based on Energy-Focused NMF
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a novel loss function of Non-Negative Matrix Factorization (NMF) based on focusing energy on the main part. Based on this loss function, a two-steps model and a new Energy-Focused Non-Negative Matrix Factorization (EF-NMF) model are derived for speech enhancement. We use the statistical distribution to explain the energy-focused meaning and get the two different EF-NMF models inspired by the greedy algorithm. Also, IMCRA is combined to estimate the speech energy in the speech energy-focused elements. Finally, we use the IMCRA combined with EF-NMF to drive linear minimum mean square error (LMMSE) estimator. Comparing with the classical NMF that respectively trains the noise and speech basis vectors, the EF-NMF can focus more speech energy on the speech activation matrix when it decomposes noisy speech signal. The experimental results show that the EF-NMF gives better quality and intelligibility than the traditional training method of NMF, and better speech quality is gained by estimating speech elements of the matrix with IMCRA.

articleTitle: Blind Extraction for PCMA Downlink Mixed Signals Using Guided Signature
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In this paper, a novel single channel blind separation method for the downlink mixed signals of Paired Carrier Multiple Access (PCMA) is proposed by means of an available particular known signal in cooperative communication. The critical idea is that the known source signal on one side of earth station antenna in PCMA serves as a guided signature to assist blind signal separation. In contrast to the conventional scheme, the channel parameter estimation operation is eliminated and computational complexity is lower. Furthermore the proposed algorithm can effectively overcome the self-interference caused by imperfect estimation or estimation error problem. Simulation results corroborate the validity of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Facial Expression Recognition Based on Spatial Transformer Siamese Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: As the development of the computer vision, we could employ the facial expressions recognition technique in the human-computer interaction domain, such as chatting robot, psychological counselling robot and so on. In this paper, we propose a novel method to jointly learn the facial expression features based the combination of Siamese networks and spatial transformer networks. We posit that learning the features from both networks may make them more robust to the image variation especially illumination and viewpoint variation. Particularly, we construct the structure of the Spatial Transformer Siamese Networks(STSN) and learn the features robust to the facial expression image variation. The experimental results show that the proposed method outperforms the-state-of-art method on the MDLTI-PIE dataset.

articleTitle: A Machine Learning Approach to Service Rule Conversion
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: This paper proposed a scheme that automatically converts service rules of cloud manufacturing to semantic rules. The scheme classifies the semantics of typical service rules into several semantic categories. Sentence embedding is used to represent the semantics of service rules. A logistic regression classifier is used to identify the semantic category of a service rule according to its sentence embedding. Based on the identified semantic category, the service rule is converted to a semantic rule. The evaluation of the scheme shows that the scheme achieves good conversion accuracy.

articleTitle: Processing of Multireceiver Sonar Data with Failed Receivers
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: The receiver array used by the modern synthetic aperture sonar (SAS) may confront the issue that some receivers fail to work. Generally, the failed receivers would affect the imaging performance if the echoed signal of failed receivers were not recovered. In order to solve this problem, this paper first recovers the data of the failed receivers based on the method of the linear prediction. Then, the range Doppler algorithm based on the phase centre approximation is exploited to focus the multireceiver data. At last, the simulated data is used to validate the presented method.

articleTitle: A New Data Packet Transfer Strategy for Opportunistic Mobile Network
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Based on the mobile contact and storage-carry-forward model, opportunistic mobile network realizes the communication between nodes. Efficient packet transfer mechanism is one of the key problems of opportunistic mobile network research. Through analyzing the stable online social network graph, the relationship between online social network and offline contact network, we propose a packet transfer strategy based on multi-level social relationship, which combines the online friendship between nodes, the interests of nodes and offline contact information to select the next hop node for the packet. Simulation results show that algorithm significantly improves success rate of data packet transmission, and reduces the transmission time comparing with the classical algorithms.

articleTitle: Modeling of Synchronous Behaviors of Excitatory and Inhibitory Neurons in Complex Neuronal Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In the model of complex networks of excitatory (E) and inhibitory neurons (I), synchronous rhythmic firing patterns is investigated by using Hodgkin-Huxley (HH) type model. Various factors such as synaptic coupling strength, network topology and external input are considered as the main effects on synchronization behavior of the neuronal networks. It is found that when the network is small-world, the degree of synchronization will be improved with the adding edge probability increasing. As for the synaptic inhibition, without inhibitory interactions, neurons would not achieve synchronization. Then once the inhibitory neurons are added, the network would arrive synchrony. Furthermore, different external currents will induce different degree of the synchronization states. The crucial quantity is the expected frequencies of inputs per neuron. So choosing the input current at the appropriate frequency is the key point in enhancing the synchronization of the complex neuronal networks.

articleTitle: Suspected Abnormal Cervical Nucleus Screening Based on a Two-Cascade Classifier
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: The accuracy of traditional computer-assisted cervical cancer screening systems often rely on fine cell image segmentation. In order to avoid the influence of segmentation accuracy on classification accuracy, a complete framework from a whole Pap smear image to screening results for suspected abnormal nucleus screening is proposed, which omits the traditional cell fine segmentation step. The framework is based on a two-cascade classifier, of which the first classifier aims to achieve ROI screening and the second one is used for nucleus classification. Firstly, the regions of interest (ROIs) in the cell clusters are extracted by adaptive thresholding and Selective Search to establish databases. Then, a new feature named Cshape is defined, which is combined with HOG features to train the first classifier used to screen out nucleus ROIs. Finally, the second classifier is trained by the Gray Level Co-occurrence Matrix, which is utilized to divide nucleus into suspected abnormal nucleus and normal nucleus, thus completing cervical cancer screening. Test results show that the highest accuracy of the two-cascade classifier is up to 100% and the random experiments verify the practicability of the framework.

articleTitle: Social-Aware and Payment Incentivized Caching for D2D Communications
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Content caching for Device-to-Device (D2D) communications is considered as a promising approach to solve the problem of data traffic explosion. However, due to users' selfishness towards strangers, they may not be willing to cache data for other nodes even within the physical reach of communication. In this paper, a social-aware and payment incentivized caching scheme for D2D communications is proposed to encourage user nodes to cache data for others actively and efficiently. First, we introduce social ties and payment as factors to form a system gain function. Then we consider the system gain function maximization, which is proved to be NP-hard. Finally, we advocate a greedy algorithm to find a suboptimal solution of this problem. Simulation results verify that the introduction of the payment ensures the user's realizability and the introduction of social ties has greatly improved the effectiveness of users.

articleTitle: Improved Randomness of Visual Cryptography Scheme Based on Basis Matrix
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: How to reducing randomness is an important issue of visual cryptography scheme. In this paper, an improved algorithm for reducing randomness is proposed by adding permuted basis matrix into the secret sharing matrix sets dynamically. The effectiveness of our scheme has been proved theoretically. Compared with the previous schemes, the proposed scheme has better randomness, which means lower computation costs in the secret sharing procedure.

articleTitle: Improved Calibration Procedure of Block Error Rate Estimation for Fast Link Adaptation
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: The fast link adaptation (FLA) used in the OFDM system estimates the channel quality indicator (CQI) suitable for the next channel based on the channel state information (CSI), thereby enabling the system to achieve high throughput. This paper focuses on the calibration method and calibration factors needed to understand the FLA algorithm and to increase the accuracy of the CQI feedback values. The calibration procedure technique we proposed improves the reliability of the optimal calibration factors derived by setting the effective interval. In addition, we present a calibration factor verification algorithm and perform verification simulation based on it. The simulation is performed in various SNR ranges to take into account the actual situation, and the calibration factors are derived from the proposed calibration method. The results demonstrate that the CQI feedback value of the calibration factors derived from the proposed method is more accurate than the previously proposed one.

articleTitle: User and Product Attention Model Based on Recommendation Algorithm for Sentiment Classification
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Document-level sentiment classification aims to predict user's overall sentiment in a document about a product. Existing sentiment classification methods just utilized the document content without consideration of user and product information, which have crucial effects on the sentiment polarities. To address the issue, this paper proposes a Hierarchical Bidirectional Long Short Term Memory (H-BiLSTM) model, where the user and product information captured by recommendation algorithm, and introduce IUF (Inverse User Frequence) as optimization objective, which proves effective. In addition, our model can adapt to the situation when the training data is sparse. Experiments on IMDB and Yelp datasets demonstrate that results are close to the state-of-the-art methods.

articleTitle: A Useful Decision Support Model for Road Owners to Select ETC tags Based on C4.5 Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: This article is dedicated to creating a decision support model that helps Chinese road owners select appropriate ETC tags. The main function of this model is to provide a decision tree to guide road owners to find a suitable path to make decision. In this research, our project team interviewed road owners for requirement analysis and listed suitable ETC application samples with appropriate attributes. Based on these samples, we introduced C4.5 algorithm to generate a decision tree model which provided suitable path for decision. After model creation, the validating work confirmed that decision model is applicable for most ETC application scenarios.

articleTitle: Broadband Asymmetric Transmission of Linear Polarization in a Tri-Layer Metasurface
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In this paper, we report a novel tri-layer structure consisting of diamond-shaped metallic strips sandwiched between two sub-wavelength gratings arrays and printed on two dielectric substrates with a broadband asymmetric transmission phenomenon. Due to the Fabry-Pérot-like effect, the cross-polarization conversion can reach a maximum of 0.94 and exceed 0.7 from 10 GHz to 30 GHz exhibiting a broadband characteristic in microwave spectra. Moreover, our structure is compactness both in the propagating direction and in the transverse directions. It is hoped that the proposed simple, easily fabricated metasurface can be used in further polarization conversion devices and nonreciprocal EM devices.

articleTitle: RGB-D Image Enhancement by Prior Guided Weighted Nonlocal Laplacian
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Compared with RGB image, there are more meaningful information provided by depth sensor for RGB-D image. Therefore, the traditional image processing methods cannot be directly extended to RGB-D images. In this paper, a novel color guided weighted nonlocal Laplacian algorithm is proposed for depth image enhancement. With the guidance of color channels, the performance is improved dramatically against the traditional nonlocal weighted Laplacian method. In addition, the proposed method can be easily extended to the task of image colorization applications. Numerous experiments show that the proposed method outperforms the traditional weighted nonlocal Laplacian algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on Centralized Control Architecture Deployment of Power Optical Network Based on Network Perception
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: The current smart distribution new business is flexible and complex, and business needs are dynamic. The SDN-based power elastic optical network (SD-EON) combines the advantages of software-defined networks in network management and control and the advantages of flexible optical network spectrum resource utilization, which can meet the load-bearing requirements of smart distribution network services. The key to reliable bearer and information transmission of the distribution service is the survivability and efficient control mechanism of the power elastic optical network. Therefore, this paper designs an elastic optical network perception model for smart distribution network, and obtains network traffic and topology information through OpenFlow-based network state awareness method. Based on this, a centralized control deployment scheme for elastic optical networks for multi-media heterogeneous coordination of power grids is designed to realize intelligent centralized control of power elastic optical networks.

articleTitle: Resource Allocation for Delay QoS-Driven Multicarrier Relay Networks with Energy Harvesting Nodes
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: This paper aims to improve the effective capacity (EC) while considering multicarrier relay (MR) network comprised of energy harvesting (EH) base station (BS) and relay node under the quality of service (QoS) constraints. Through considering the energy causality constraint imposed on BS and relay node and the delay QoS constraint, we formulate the optimization problem and the optimized subcarrier and power allocation strategies are obtained by using Lagrange dual decomposition and the Karush-Kuhn-Tucker conditions. Furthermore, a suboptimal algorithm is proposed to reduce the computational complexity. Numerical results demonstrate that the proposed schemes perform better in improving the system EC than the existing resource allocation policies for different QoS exponent sets, especially when the delay requirement is strict.

articleTitle: Properties of ($\lambda, q$)-Bézier Curves and Surfaces
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In this paper, we introduce a new type q-Bernstein basis functions with shape parameter λ, named ( λ, q)-Bernstein bases, we give a practical algorithm of curve modeling by these basis functions. We also give some geometric properties of the basis functions and the corresponding ( λ, q)-Bézier curves. Furthermore, we construct the corresponding tensor product surfaces over the rectangular domain and study the properties of the surfaces.

articleTitle: An Improved Visual Tracking Algorithm Based on Efficient Convolution Operators
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Effcient Convolution Operators (ECO) is one of the most outstanding visual tracking algorithms in recent years, it combines two methods of Deep Learning and Discriminative Correlation Filter (DCF), and has excellent performance in VOT2016, UAV123, OTB-2015 and TempleColor. The paper propose integrating ECO and Fully Convolutional Networks (FCN) to achieve state-of-the-art segmentation for ECO. In our experiments, the original CNN model of ECO is replaced by the FCN model. Compared with the traditional Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN), the FCN has higher accuracy of segmentation and can input any size of image. We perform comprehensive experiments which obtained 0.653 area under curve (AUC) and 0.861 precision plot (DP) on OTB-2013 dataset.

articleTitle: A Robust Authentication Protocol for Multi-server RFID System Applications
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Radio Frequency Identification (RFID) is emerging in a variety of applications as an important technology for identifying and tracking goods and assets. Yet as soon as applications start on RFID solutions, concerns must be raised on security and privacy of these concepts, which are critical because RFID systems communicate via radio waves, subjecting them to unauthorized scanning. In this paper, we consider a security-oriented scenario that a RFID system involves more than one server, which will raise insider attacks, namely an attack from genuine numbers involved in the protocol. In the proposed protocol, the system assigns an identifier for the reader of each server and a key for each of the readers and tags. Moreover, each tag stores all readers' identifiers and the shared keys between itself and every reader. When a reader queries a tag, it is firstly identified by the tag, finding the shared key, and then it has the chance to enter the authentication stage. Compared with other existing protocols of same class, our protocol can resist various attacks and achieve better performance in computational cost.

articleTitle: An Optimized Window Length ased Time-Frequency Representation for Non-Linear Frequency Modulated Signals
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Optimal Window length based Lv Transform (OWLT) is proposed as an improved form of short-time Lv transform (STLVT). STLVT is a short-time time-frequency analysis method based on Lv Distribution (LVD). The performance of STLVT is mainly decided by the length of window. However, it has not been researched how to decide the window length in STLVT. As an improvement, OWLT achieves the optimization of window length in STLVT. Optimal window length is obtained by stochastic approximation method, which is a cornerstone of stochastic optimization. OWLT achieves global optimization by several times local optimizations starting from different origins. In simulations, two non-linear frequency modulated signals are analyzed. Results show that STLVT with the optimal window length can reach the highest signal energy concentration.

articleTitle: Speech Enhancement Based on Cepstral Mapping and Deep Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In this paper, we present three strategies to achieve speech enhancement, which is based on Cepstral Mapping and Deep Neural Networks (DNN). Firstly, we apply DNN to directly predict the clean speech Cepstral feature given noisy Cepstral input. Then, by waveform reconstruction, we can obtain desired clean speech. Comparing with the method of directly mapping log-power spectral (LPS), our method is able to be more effective to recover speech harmonic structure and gain the higher speech quality. Additionally, we also utilize DNN to estimate ideal Wiener filter by giving noisy Cepstral input. Finally, a fusion framework is proposed to acquire enhanced speech signal, which combines Cepstral feature mapping and Wiener filter. Experiments show that the proposed algorithms are able to achieve the state-of-the-art performance in improving the quality and intelligibility of noisy speech.

articleTitle: A Two-layer Image Caching Mechanism Based on Social Relationships
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: With the rapid development of Internet technology, the popularity of social networking has enriched people's lives. A large number of social applications such as Facebook, WeChat and QQ often use a large number of image resources, which will consume much network traffic for transferring the images and affect the speed of loading. Therefore, most applications use the strategy of displaying the thumbnail images first and then loading the original images according to the users' requests. In the design and implementation of the image server, using caching technology can reduce disk I/O and increase image access speed. But current caching mechanisms have not considered the different access patterns for thumbnails and original images, nor the social relationships between image generators. In this paper, a two-layer image caching mechanism based on social relationships is pro-posed, which divides the image cache into the thumbnail layer and the original image layer, and comprehensively considers the social relationships between users and the relationships between the thumbnails and the original images. Experiments show that the two-layer image caching mechanism can effectively improve the cache hit rate for images.

articleTitle: Research on Chinese Spam Comments Detection Based on Chinese Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: With the popularity of mobile Internet, people can express their views in the Internet anytime and anywhere. Personal attack speech is a kind of cyber violence that not only does great harm to others, but also makes the whole network environment become chaotic. In order to detect spam comment in Chinese network, in this paper we carefully analyze the datasets and select four characteristics from the real data. With the help of Chinese language and literature, a malicious dictionary can be obtained by extending the algorithm on the basis of a very small number of seed words. Compared with manual dictionary selection, our method saves a lot of labor costs. Besides, it performs well in natural language processing with the help of deep learning model. Finally, the experimental results show that this method can detect malicious comments in “NetEase” news effectively.

articleTitle: Soft Computing Detection Method for Remaining Capacity of Lead-Acid Battery
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: This paper proposes a new soft computing method based on simplified BP neural network. For the traditional fully connected BP neural network, the optimal structure 8-5-5-1 is obtained through the optimization of the hidden layer, and the output weight and the threshold are obtained. Since the input and output structure of the obtained lead-acid battery is a “black box”, a calculation method of the contribution rate of the weight and the threshold is proposed, and the “black box” is transparent according to the method. By comparing the accuracy of BP neural network before and after simplification, the accuracy has no effect, but the model is simplified, and it is easier to observe the connection strength within the model.

articleTitle: Data Transmission Optimization Method Based on Mobile Nodes
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: This paper proposes a data transmission optimization method based on mobile nodes. The limited energy of the wireless sensor network and the redundant and missing data in some regions affect the reliability of data transmission in the entire network. Considering this, this paper analyzes the energy consumption of network nodes and the data transmission paths, and then it optimizes the data transmission path by the selection method to improve the reliability of the entire network transmission. The simulation results show that the algorithm can achieve a high data transmission success rate and ensure network connectivity with low energy consumption and transmission delay.

articleTitle: Path Loss and Blockage Modeling for Vehicle to Vehicle Channel above 6 GHz
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: With the development of 5th generation mobile communication new radio (5G NR) technology, the channel models need to be studied on radio frequencies above 6 GHz. The channel models of vehicle-to-vehicle (V2V) have been completely specified below 6 GHz. Thus, this paper mainly focuses on the channel models of V2V communications above 6 GHz. The path loss model is analyzed with the propagation conditions, which are line-of-sight (LOS) and Non-line-of-sight (NLOS). In addition, a statistical model of blockage loss is proposed in this paper. Furthermore, Packet Reception Ratio of V2V links is comprehensively analyzed in urban grid and highway cases. The proposed channel models eventually provide a reference for future V2V channel models and the standard on support of Vehicle-to-Everything (V2X) services above 6 GHz.

articleTitle: Research And FPGA Implementation of Security Control System Based On High Alphabet Modulation
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In this paper, a safety remote control system based on the high alphabet modulation is proposed. Compared with the traditional PCM-PSK-FM telemetry system, this system has superior virtual instruction rate, missed instruction rate, and real-time performance, and the large instruction set also makes the system has excellent confidentiality performance, so the system can better meet the current complex security environment. In addition, we also performed performance analysis and comparison of the proposed high alphabet system. Finally, the system was designed and realized by Altera FPGA, and the experimental results show that the design has certain feasibility.

articleTitle: Research on Highlight Snippets Identification Technology Based on Sentiment Analysis of Bullet Curtain
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: At present, the method of extracting highlights snippets of video is restricted to image and audio analysis in sports videos. About this problem, this paper proposes a new method of using bullet curtain text as sentiment carrier for sentiment analysis, and then using its time coupling to identify the highlight snippets. Firstly, according to the particularity of bullet curtain text, a domain sentiment dictionary is constructed. Secondly, the paper proposes a new feature integrating time series of bullet curtain, and classifies bullet curtain text by support vector machine. Finally, bullet curtain with intense sentiment is superimposed on the video time scale, and the full video brilliance curve is obtained. The best threshold is selected to identify highlight snippets. Experimental results show that the proposed method has higher accuracy, precision and recall rate, and the validity of the proposed method is verified.

articleTitle: The Vector Scheduling Game on Two Hierarchical Identical Machines
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In this paper, we study the vector scheduling game on two hierarchical identical machines, both in non-cooperative and in cooperative versions. When the private cost of jobs are maximum over components, we present the POS and its variants are 1, and the POA and its variants are 2. When the private cost of jobs are sum of components, we present the POS and its variants are 2, and the POA and its variants are 2. All the bounds given are tight.

articleTitle: A New Particle Swarm Optimization Algorithm Based on Local-World Evolving Network Model
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In this paper, A new particle swarm optimization algorithm based on local-world evolving network model is proposed to solve the problem that particle swarm optimization algorithm is prone to local optimum. The topology of particle swarm is generally considered to be a very important factor and determine the performance of the algorithm. In this paper, the particle swarm optimization algorithm and the local-world evolving network model are briefly reviewed, and then we use the network generated by the local-world evolving network model to represent the topological structure of the particle swarm. The new algorithm and original particle swarm optimization algorithm are tested in 6 benchmark functions. Comparing the test results, the new algorithm performs better on multimodal functions, the ability of the new algorithm to optimize on complex problems is significantly improved.

articleTitle: The Application of Reliability in the Information Hypernetworks Optimization
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Hypernetworks can be used to represent information networks, such as computer systems and wireless communication networks, which have higher requirements for reliability. In this paper, a concept of reliability to measure the possibility for the hypernetwork to connect when hyperedge may fail is proposed. A greedy algorithm for calculating reliability is given. The application of the reliability to the study of two real-world complex systems has shown that these systems can be optimized by simple methods.

articleTitle: A Modified Version of Huffman Coding with Random Access Abilities
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In this paper, a modified version of canonical Huffman coding is presented, such that a certain level of random access on the compressed file is allowed. Compared with the prior methods, the proposed approach does not need additional space to store the auxiliary information. Thus, it is possible to provide a certain level of random access ability on a compressed file whose size is close to the Huffman coding asymptotically. To our knowledge, this is the first method to possess random access ability without the help by the auxiliary data. Though the Huffman coding is discussed in this paper, the present method can be applied on any variable-length prefix encoding.

articleTitle: Application of Machine Learning and Emotional Fluctuation System in Game Quality Evaluation and Prospective Players Prediction
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Previous studies revealed that the players' emotional fluctuation is associated with and may be used to evaluate the quality of the game. This study aims at determining how the changes in a variety of emotional factors would reflect the quality of the game. Galvanic Skin Response GSR, an emotional-aware UI, was used to gain data from volunteers while they were playing games. The linear regression model was used to predict the prospective players in the game series. Results suggested that some emotion factors like fluent frequency have positive influence of the game quality while more emotion factors such as biggest wave and interval have negative influences.

articleTitle: Face Biometric Identity Authentication System
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: With the popularity of payment by smartphone, mobile financial transactions security becomes serious. This paper takes smartphone as application background, combineing with several algorithms to propose a face identity authentication system. Firstly, samples are preprocessed. Then, Haar and AdaBoost algorithms are adopted for face detection, features of face area are extracted by LBP operator. Finally, Euclidean distance is used for feature matching to achieve authentication. The test results show that preprocessing suppresses the illumination influence effectively, face detection accuracy reach to 97.2% and 96.6% respectively, system authentication accuracy can be as high as 98.86%, FRR and FAR are kept at a low value of 1.14% and 0.89%, the average authentication time takes 271~327ms. In summary, the face identify authentication system proposed in this paper has better robustness and higher authentication accuracy while maintaining good timeliness.

articleTitle: Comparing and Combining MLPs and CNNs for Image Denoising
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Deep Learning has shown great success in image processing tasks such as image denoising. The superiority of those learning based methods is obvious that there is no need for hand-crafted priors. In fact, two of main neural network models Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLPs) and Convolutional Neural Network (CNNs) have been explored for image noise removing. In this work, we concentrate on comparing and combining those two models for image denoising. We identify the MLPs and CNNs have different preference for different image patches, and reveal that the property is related to image patch Signal-to-Noise-Ratio [1]. Furthermore, a new approach based on MLPs and CNNs are proposed for image noise reducing. Experiments on realistic noisy images prove the effectiveness of the new method.

articleTitle: A data Processing Method for Fault Prediction of Industrial Pipeline Time Series Data
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: This paper solves the problem of data processing in fault prediction in the manufacturing process of industrial pipeline based on time series data. A data processing method is provided, which can segment and reorganize the pipeline data, and clean and preprocess the reconstructed data. At the same time, data training and evaluation prediction models are proposed to evaluate the processed data. The implementation of the data processing method is modular and scalable, supporting the underlying production process and collecting data changes. Based on the recurrent neural network, a prediction model was proposed and the data collected by the thin film transistor liquid crystal displayer production line was used to evaluate the method.

articleTitle: Multi-constrained Routing Algorithm Based on PSPSO_FWA in DAG
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: This paper analyzes the existing multiconstrained QoS routing methods, builds a mathematical model that satisfies multiconstrained QoS routing, and converts multiple constraints into a fitness function through a penalty function. On this basis, a new multiconstrained routing algorithm PSPSO_FWA in DAG is proposed. The algorithm first prunes the network topology map, deletes the path that does not satisfy the multiple constraints, and reduces the search space. Then use particle swarm optimization (PSO) to search, to solve the problem of falling into local optimum and speed up local search, the fireworks algorithm (FWA) is introduced for optimization. The simulation shows the success rate of PSPSO_FWA algorithm is increased by 2.47% compared with the current PSO algorithm, and the problem is about 1.95% higher than the PSO_ACO algorithm. The average cost of the last search is about 2.27% higher than that of the PSO algorithm, which is about 1.46% higher than the PSO_ACO algorithm.

articleTitle: Iterative Rank-Two Transmit Beamforming Design for QoS-Diffserv Multi-group Multicasting Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Providing quality of service (QoS) differentiation at the physical layer is possible for wireless multicasting systems. In this paper, a rank-two transmit beamforming mechanism based on the Alamouti space-time (AST) coding is considered to perform differentiated services (DiffServ) in multi-group multicasting systems. Different from the conventional multigroup system model, two kinds of users exist in this QoS-differentiated multi-group multicast system, named high-priority users with guaranteed QoS and low-priority users whose QoS is limited. An iterative beamforming algorithm based on the approximate optimization is proposed to promote system performance. By investigating a convex approximation form for non-convex SINR constraints, the optimization problem in each iteration is reformulated to a convex problem. Then, an iterative procedure is used to improve the probability of the feasibility of the initialization vectors. Computational complexity of the proposed algorithm is analyzed. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed rank-two beamforming algorithm could provide near.

articleTitle: Research and Improvement of a WM Multimode Pattern Matching Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: The performance improvement of multi-pattern matching algorithm has an important impact on intrusion detection. For the two main disadvantages of the WM algorithm, one is to perform a pattern string filter only through the suffix table, and the other is that the average moving distance of the matching window on the text string is too small. Based on above theory, this paper proposes an improved WM algorithm I_WM. Firstly, the I_WM algorithm sorts all pattern strings according to the suffix characters of the pattern string matching window; then it calculates the hash value of the suffix character block in the text string matching window, searches the suffix table according to the hash value, determines the address range of the participating pattern strings, and filters the pattern strings that need to be matched for the first time; then it calculates the hash value of the prefix character block in the text string matching window, searches for the corresponding pattern strings in the prefix table according to the hash value and then traverses them, only the pattern strings within the address range specified by the suffix table need to be matched, which is the second filtration of pattern strings. By filtering twice, the number of pattern strings to be matched each time is greatly reduced. In addition, the text string matching window moves backward for the larger character block jump distances calculated by the BM and BMHS2 algorithms. The experimental test results show that under the same test environment, the I_WM algorithm has a certain degree of improvement over the WM algorithm in matching performance.

articleTitle: An Overlay Routing Algorithm Based on QoS for Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: This paper introduces the basic theory of QoS and Overlay Internet of things, the logical topology structure of the active Overlay Internet of things service routing is expounded, then the routing problem of the Internet of things service is modeled. On this basis, an agent based active Overlay Internet of things QoS ant colony service routing optimization algorithm is proposed, the correctness of the algorithm is proved in theory, the related experimental results is compared with the other two algorithms to verify the superiority of this algorithm.

Index Terms: Number Of Nodes In The Network

articleTitle: Memory-Compact Membership Lookup for Multiple Data Sets by a Single Bloom Filter
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Bloom filter is a memory-compact data structure to encode a set of data items, which can address the set membership query with no false negative and a configurable false positive rate. It is a fundamental tool with a wide range of applications in multiple disciplines, such as data science, networking, computer architecture, and distributed computing. However, Bloom filter faces a challenge of memory allocation: How much memory should be given to its data structure when its encoded data set is dynamically formed and has no prior-known set size. As a result, when more set elements continuously arrives, its data structure will become more crowded, causing its false positive rate of addressing membership query to increase. This problem becomes even more challenging, when there are multiple data sets to represent and each data set is independently formed in a streaming fashion. The traditional way to support the set membership checking for multiple data sets is to allocate each data set a separate Bloom filter. Instead, this paper takes a dramatically different approach: We encode all data sets in a single large filter and yet supports membership lookup for all of them, with a false positive rate bound that is independently configurable for each set. We analyze the properties of the filter and, in particular, the formulas for its feasible region where the false positive rate requirements are met for all data sets.

articleTitle: Epilepsy EEG Classification and Visualization using Linear Discriminate Analysis
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) is an important tool in epilepsy diagnosis practice. Many computer-based EEG analysis methods have been presented in the literature. Most of them addressed automatic classification of EEG recorded from epilepsy patients. In our previous work, a novel visualization tool for epilepsy EEG was introduced to investigate the focus based on Ensemble Empirical Mode Decomposition (EEMD) and Linear Discriminate Analysis (LDA). As well, two contours were rendered to highlight the focus of spike and seizure EEG respectively. However, it segmented EEG records into 2-second epochs and classified them independently. Some seizure epochs were falsely classified into normal. In this study, we consider EEG records continuously. The 8-second EEG in front of the current epoch is also taken into consideration. More features are extracted. Instead of using a greedy search for important features, as done in the previous work, a genetic algorithm with enforced reduction is adopted. The EEG used in this study was collected from six subjects (two normal and four with epilepsy) in National Taiwan University Hospital (NTHU). The classification accuracy is significantly enhanced. Furthermore, contours for the spike and seizure are merged into one. It is much easier for clinicians and nurses to locate the seizure focus.

articleTitle: A Low Power Consumption Period Task Scheduling Algorithm in Real-Time System
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: At present, the embedded real-time system should not only guarantee the real-time performance of tasks, but also consider the energy consumption of the system. In this paper, a low power scheduling algorithm based on periodic task model is proposed. This algorithm is a two-stage scheduling algorithm, which calculates the best processor speed in the offline stage, reclaims and distributes slack time at the running stage to save energy. Experiments show that the proposed algorithm is more efficient than the existing algorithm in saving energy.

articleTitle: A CNN-based Feature Extraction Scheme for Patent Analysis
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: The traditional patent analysis is largely based on the probability analysis method. In this paper, we propose a novel scheme to extract features of the patent text based on an improved Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) for text processing. It integrates text mining techniques and Vector Space Modeling (VSM) for discovering the abstract “topics” that occur in a collection of patent documents; and maps the original data to a dataset of a high dimensional vector space. We also build up a kind of structured data of patent text for our further patent analysis. Finally, various experiments are conducted to evaluate the performances of the proposed scheme.

articleTitle: Multiuser Secret Key Generation based on Received Signal
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: The secret key generation method based on channel characteristic provides a new way for communication security. On the conditions of multiuser and quasi-static fading, Because of the slow channel parameter changing rate, extracting the secret key from channel parameters will result in a low secret key rate. To solve this problem, a multiuser secret key generation method based on the received signal was proposed. By distributing the random signals to different users using block diagonalization (BD) precoding, base station and user can extract the secret key from the received signal of user. The novel method can significantly increase the secret key rate of multiuser under the quasi-static channel and slow fading channel, which is verified by simulations.

articleTitle: Supporting Movie Production: A Recommender Approach
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In order to view the visual effect of scripts, movie and television creators (or directors) often resort to the Web for reference material in the process of movie and television production. These video materials are then used for editing and completing an entire story script. Existing retrieval systems and tools can hardly meet such needs. This is because simply relying on several keywords entered by users would not best model such complex user needs as the one involving a search for movie footage with related scenes or characters. To solve this problem, we make use of Semantic Web technologies to build a knowledge base of the movie domain. Through the semantic extension of user queries, the proposed recommender can reason about its knowledge base to obtain desirable movie and television materials for its user. We conducted a series of experiments for usability test. The results show that our recommender system has obvious advantages over the traditional keyword based query system in support of movie production.

articleTitle: Correction for Energy Level Transition under the Constraint of Elite Rate in Multiscale Quantum Harmonic Oscillator Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Multiscale quantum harmonic oscillator algorithm (MQHOA) is an optimization algorithm based on quantum behavior. It transforms the function optimization into solving the ground state wave function through the transformation of SchrÖdinger equation and utilizes the processes of energy level stabilization, energy level transition and scale adjustment to search the optimal solution of the objective function. Original MQHOA algorithm accelerates the search process by replacing the worst solution with the mean value in the process of energy level transition. This operation may reduce diversity and lead to prematurity. In order to improve the population diversity of the probes, special elite strategy and random replacement mechanism are used to improve the search efficiency. Experiments on benchmark test functions show that the improved algorithm is more effective than the original algorithm and other common algorithms.

articleTitle: An Improved IMCRA Algorithm for Sleep Signal Denoising
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In sleep environment, respiratory signals are inevitably affected by ambient noise. In order to improve the noise estimation ability of noise spectrum estimation algorithm, an improved IMCRA non-stationary noise estimation algorithm is proposed. The algorithm uses the 3 spectral smoothing method to estimate the probability of respiratory signals and control the length of segments. In the case of noise overestimation or underestimation, a safety mechanism is introduced to limit or compensate for the noise estimate. Experimental results show that compared with IMCRA algorithm, the improved algorithm improves the noise estimation ability. At the same time, the intelligibility and sharpness of speech signals are improved, which can be applied to de-noising sleep signals better.

articleTitle: Research on TD-LTE Uplink Frequency Offset Estimation Algorithm for High-Speed Railway
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Nowadays, in order to meet the high-speed date transmission services, a new generation of long-term evolution of mobile communication system (LTE) came inter being. And the uplink used single carrier frequency division multiplexing (SC-FDMA) technology. However, the increase of Doppler frequency shift at high speed produce the channel's fast time-varying fading and destroy the orthogonality between subcarriers, which makes the performance of the system especially the uplink be seriously affected. In this paper, therefore, for the uplink transmission system in high-speed mobile environment, the study was carried out from the uplink Doppler frequency offset estimation technique in the high-speed railway communication system. The uplink channel is modeled and the existing algorithm of traditional frequency offset estimation is studied. The improved frequency offset estimation algorithm is proposed. In the high-speed scenario, the improved method adopted the method of rough estimation and refinement and used the auto regressive model to track the frequency offset estimation between subframes, thus improving the accuracy of estimation, reducing the interference of noise and the complicated calculation degree. The problem of frequency offset estimation of uplink transmission system under high speed scenario is solved to a large extent. The improved algorithm was compared with the performance of the existing algorithm. The results shows that the improved algorithm had a better performance gain.

articleTitle: Transmission Line Evaluation of Smart Grid Based on Big Data Mining
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Large data mining is very important in the application of power system since the data of power system is rather redundant. In this paper, an evaluation method of power system transmission line parameters based on the micro-meteorological environment is proposed. Cloud computing processing technology is utilized for constructing the online dynamic parameter evaluation system, so that the real-time data collected by power system measurement devices and the environment data of the micro-meteorological monitoring system can be identified, evaluated and corrected. This system is calculated theoretically and verified on real web, the results show that the micro-meteorological parameter evaluation system can evaluate the mutation parameters of transmission lines in real time and provide a new opportunity for the security analysis and stability control of large power systems.

articleTitle: A Research on Deep Neural Network Based Airline Market Share Prediction Model in Aviation Market Network Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In this paper, we present an efficient airline market share prediction model, which is important to evaluate the competitive power of an airline in an aviation market. A series of passenger preference attributes in air travel are raised from global booking data. Deep neural network model is used in the market share evaluation model. The experiment with real booking data shows the proposed market share prediction model has a reliable performance. A discussion is conducted on the advantage and disadvantage between neural network and logistics regression under the business application background.

articleTitle: A TCP Decoupling Based SDN Architecture for Asymmetric Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In traditional TCP (Transmission Control Protocol), we commonly acquiesce in that the uplink and downlink paths of TCP sessions are symmetric. But in practice, in wireless communication systems, such as VLC (Visible Light Communication), mmWave, WiFi, or LTE systems, and even in wired systems due to asymmetric routing problems or other reasons, paths for uplink and downlink transmission in TCP sessions are asymmetric. The asymmetry can be reflected in bandwidth, delay, packet loss differences between uplink and downlink paths, and the mismatch between uplink and downlink paths may cause performance degradation on the performance of TCP. Decoupled TCP breaks through TCP's limitation to a unidirectional link, and allows users to fully utilize network resources. In this paper, we analyze the necessity and benefit of TCP decoupling. Then we propose a TCP decoupling based SDN (Software Defined Network) architecture for asymmetric networks and apply a modified Dijkstra's shortest path algorithm to determine the optimal uplink and downlink. Last, we prove that Decoupled TCP and the TCP decoupling based SDN architecture can improve the performance of TCP sessions in different asymmetric scenarios by simulation.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Air Quality Data Processing System Based on Big Data Technology
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In this article, we design and implement an air quality data processing system based on big data technology, which leverages Flume to acquire data, Kafka to cache data, and Storm to process data, and finally save the results to the in-memory database called Redis and distributed database called HBase. In Redis, only the latest data of each monitoring point is saved, and the original data is deleted periodically to reduce the memory load. An application is implemented by which people can get real-time data from Redis and query historical data from HBase. Through experiments, it is proved that querying real-time data from Redis is faster than relational database. The system solves the issues of poor storage capacity and slow query speed when using relational database in the big data environment, and improves the efficiency of data processing significantly.

articleTitle: Statistical Max-SINR Beamforming for Wireless Powered Communications in Airborne Massive MIMO System
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: This paper proposes an airborne massive multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) system for wireless energy transfer (WET) and information transmission. An air platform (AP) equipped with two-dimension rectangular antenna array is employed to broadcast energy and provide wireless access for ground sensors. By exploiting the statistical property of air-terrestrial MIMO channels, the energy and information beamformers are jointly designed to maximize the average received signal-to-interference-plus-noise ratio (SINR), which gives rise to a statistical max-SINR beamforming scheme. The scheme gets rid of the requirement on instantaneous channel state information (CSI), and thus results in significant saving in training resource and energy consumption. The simulation results show that the proposed scheme can achieve comparable performance with the schemes that requires instantaneous CSI.

articleTitle: Style Transfer Based on Normalization Loss
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Gatys et al. firstly proposed artistic style transfer. Based on their research, Luan et al. proposed a method stylizing a photo using the style of a reference photo. Many algorithms have shown great progress in style transfer. The combination of content loss and style loss is commonly used as objective function in style transfer. This paper proposes a new loss term called normalization loss which can replace the classic combination. Normalization loss is easier to converge. Therefore, the generation process requires less iterations. Experiments prove that our method is effective and the result images have better visual effect.

articleTitle: Internet of Building Equipment System Based on Thread Network and Methods for Managing End Devices
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: In order to solve the internal networking, remote communication and optimization control of the end devices in the Internet of Building Equipment, this paper presents an Internet of Building Equipment system based on the Thread network and a series of methods for managing end devices. In this system the single point of failure can be effectively avoided both within the intranet and from the intranet to Internet, and the whole communication process from end devices to the remote server is based on the Internet Protocol and the User Datagram Protocol, without the need for gateways to carry out the protocol conversion. This paper also proposes a method of persisting bidirectional communication between each end device and the server, by which the server can send control commands to end devices at any time. Finally, based on the communication capability among end devices, this paper puts forward an optimization control method for end devices to save energy, or to improve the comfort and security of the occupants' environment.

articleTitle: Semi-dynamic Virtual Network Embedding Algorithm of Wireless Virtualization
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Wireless virtualization is a key technology that enables the coexistence of multiple virtual wireless networks on the same substrate network, where virtual network embedding (VNE) is one of the most crucial problems to be solved. Some static and dynamic algorithms have been proposed to solve the VNE problem in wireless networks. However, the static algorithms lead to poor performance while the dynamic ones bring high complexity. Therefore, in this paper, we propose a semi-dynamic algorithm which only re-embeds the embedded virtual networks with bad impact on the following embedding. Simulation results show that the semi-dynamic embedding algorithm greatly improves the resource utilization at the cost of re-embedding a few requests compared with the static algorithm. Moreover, it avoids re-embedding many requests at the cost of a little performance loss compared with the completely dynamic algorithm. Consequently, we can draw a conclusion that the semi-dynamic algorithm achieves the balance between performance and complexity.

articleTitle: Attribute-based Sentiment Analysis for Recommendation
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Nowadays, driven by the development of the information society, the recommendation algorithm has received tremendous attention and has been extensively applied to a great number of tasks. However, only considering the impact of the total rating and the total emotion of comments, most of the recommendation algorithms can be biased by ignoring the emotions of users on the various attributes in the comments. Based on such motivation, we refer to sentiment analysis and the topic model to fully exploit the emotion information of each attribute in the comments. By obtaining the similarity in the attribute plane of users and combining with the similarity of the overall rating of users, we propose a novel recommendation algorithm called ASAR (attribute-based sentiment analysis for recommendation). Experiments show that mean absolute deviation is in the limitation of 0.5 points, which prove that ASAR has a certain improvement in the accuracy of recommendation, our proposed method plays an important role in the development of recommendation algorithm.

articleTitle: A Deep Learning Approach for Website Fingerprinting Attack
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Website fingerprinting attack is an effective way to infer which web page a user is browsing through anonymous network. Previous studies focused more on the selection of traffic features and improvements in traditional classification methods. In this paper, we present a new website fingerprinting technique based on deep learning. The method uses a complex deep neural network to automatically learn features and classify website fingerprints. The model uses two-layer GRU network to extract the time feature and the 50-layer residual network to extract the spatial features of the website fingerprint. The main idea resides in the fact that deep neural network can achieve complex function approximation and more efficient feature extraction. Our technique performs better than the current state-of-the-art website fingerprint attack. We have achieved more than 99% accuracy over the current largest dataset which consists of 900 classes. The results of experiment show that deep learning is an efficient and robust technique for website fingerprint attack.

articleTitle: Research on Polling Based Traffic signal Control Strategy with Fuzzy Control
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: With the rapid development of social economy in recent years, the number of cars in the city continues to increase, and urban traffic congestion is becoming more and more serious. Traffic lights serve as an important tool for urban traffic control and play a key role in urban traffic control. Therefore, for real-time The research on traffic signal control methods is of great significance. In the research of this paper, we mainly discuss the control strategy and performance analysis of single-point intersection traffic signals. Taking the intersection of Changyuan South Road and Kunzhou Road in Kunming as the sample intersection, based on the VISSIM platform to build the simulation environment, a flow-based dynamic phase traffic signal control strategy based on the polling mechanism is proposed, which is mainly based on the traffic flow of each intersection. The division of the time period is based on a series of data, and the phase of the lane is dynamically planned in different time periods. At the same time, the fuzzy control model is used to dynamically adjust the signal timing according to the real-time road conditions of each time period, so as to ensure the smooth flow of the intersection.

articleTitle: High-Gain Lens Antenna Using Transmissive Phase Gradient Metasurface
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: The Phase Gradient Metasurface (PGMS) is widely used in the flexible control of electromagnetic wave and the improvement of antenna gain. In this paper, a novel type of small-sized metasurface unit cell is designed, and the unit element adopts tri-layer metal and two-layer intermediate medium. Each layer of metal consists of a hexagonal outer ring and a regular hexagonal patch. By changing the metal patch side length, 360° transmissive phase shift is achieved in X-band. Then, according to the plane lens phase distribution principle, the PGMS with a focal length of 30 mm is formed by the above unit. Finally, the microstrip antenna is placed at the focus of the PGMS, and the PGMS converts the quasi-spherical wave radiated by the microstrip antenna into plane wave, thereby increasing the purpose of the antenna gain. The simulations show that the maximum gain of the antenna is increased by 12.3dB, and the E-plane half-power beamwidth is reduced by 74.3 degrees. Due to the hexagonal cell design, the number of PGMS unit cells can be effectively increased, and the antenna gain can be improved to the greatest extent.

articleTitle: Research on IPv6 Transition Technology for Digital Ocean
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Digital Ocean Construction has become a national strategy, the development of which is restricted by traditional IPv4 network. In this paper, IPv6 transition technology is researched to solve the current digital ocean network problems, and an IPv6 transition mechanism is proposed. The work of collecting data with IPv6 sensor network in the digital ocean by deploying border gateway devices which support 6LoWPAN and IPv6 network has been done. The border gateway devices can communicate with digital ocean IPv6 datacenters over an IPv4 network by using 6rd tunnel technology. With dual stack equipment, the digital ocean IPv6 datacenters can be accessed by both IPv4 and IPv6 networks. This transition mechanism satisfies the network demands for research and development of digital ocean.

articleTitle: Incorporating Forward and Backward Instances in a Bi-LSTM-CNN Model for Relation Classification
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Relation classification is a task that identifies entity's semantic relationships from unstructured text. Lately, the method based on convolution neural network (CNN) achieves competitive performance comparing with other complex-structured networks by only using a standard convolution layer, a pooling layer and a softmax layer. However, CNN difficultly extract effective features or even wrong features when processing samples of large-pitch entities, decreasing their classification accuracy. Besides the existing methods could obtain inconsistent relation classifications for the forward and backward instances of the same sample. In this paper, a Bi-LSTM encoding layer is employed to enhance the ability of CNN to captured the contextual information of entities. Then, combining with the forward and backward instances of samples, a classification framework is proposed for relation classification. We conduct experiments on the public dataset SemEval 2010 task 8 verify to the effectiveness of our method. The method we proposed has the significant performance, even without additional artificial features.

articleTitle: Research on Cloud Computing Security Evaluation Model Based on Trust Management
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: At present, cloud computing technology has made outstanding contributions to the Internet in data unification and sharing applications. However, the problem of information security in cloud computing environment has to be paid attention to and effective measures have to be taken to solve it. In order to control the data security under cloud services, the DS evidence theory method is introduced. The trust management mechanism is established from the source of big data, and a cloud computing security assessment model is constructed to achieve the quantifiable analysis purpose of cloud computing security assessment. Through the simulation, the innovative way of quantifying the confidence criterion through big data trust management and DS evidence theory not only regulates the data credible quantification mechanism under cloud computing, but also improves the effectiveness of cloud computing security assessment, providing a friendly service support platform for subsequent cloud computing service.

articleTitle: Optimization Strategy of SDN Control Deployment Based on Simulated Annealing-Genetic Hybrid Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: With the in-depth deployment of software-defined networks in various business scenarios, controller deployment problem has become a hot issue for software-defined network. At the same time, with the development of the private network of the smart grid, the demand for security, real-time and reliability of the grid transmission service has been continuously improved. In order to solve the problem of wide distribution of power grid system, large amount of data and high delay requirements, we propose an SDN controller deployment scheme based on simulated annealing-genetic hybrid algorithm. This algorithm combines the simulated annealing algorithm and the genetic algorithm. After the simulated annealing algorithm is used to quickly search for a better solution, the positive feedback information is used to narrow down the maximum number of searches and find the optimal path faster. Finally, simulation experiments show that this algorithm can achieve a lower cost controller deployment solution while ensuring the delay between the switch and the controller, and the time required for deployment is shorter.

articleTitle: Ultrasound Compressive Sensing Using BCS-FOCUSS
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Compress sensing has advantage of simultaneous sensing and data compression. In recent years block compressive sensing (BCS) is celebrated because of its low encoding complexity. In this paper FOCUSS reconstruction algorithm based on BCS frame work is proposed utilizing iterative re-weighted l<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub> norm minimization. In proposed approach the required sparsity was attained using l<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub> norm minimization and 2D-Median filter is implemented as smoothing operator for removing blocking artifacts. The performance of reconstruction algorithm is verified on different data sets and results obtained from analysis reveal that the suggested approach for image reconstruction offers significant compression performance in contrast to existing techniques.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of the NB-IoT Downlink System on OpenAirInterface Platform
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Narrowband Internet of Things (NB-IoT) is an emerging technology introduced by 3GPP Release 13 which supports the low power consumption in wide coverage conditions. With the rapid development of NB-IoT system, more and more novel technologies and algorithms based on NB-IoT have been proposed. However, there is no universal platform to evaluate and validate the proposed algorithms. To solve this problem, an NB-IoT downlink platform based on OpenAirInterface (OAI) is developed in this paper. To help understand this platform, the architecture and workflow are presented in brief. Then, we propose the design scheme and introduce the implementation. At the same time, the repetition mechanism is highlighted. Finally, the system scenario is constructed and the experiments are implemented to validate the performance of the NB-IoT downlink system. The results demonstrate that the NB-IoT downlink platform is correctly deployed and the implement of the repetition mechanism increases stability in exchange for sacrificing resources. This platform can be used to evaluate the NB-IoT system and demonstrates its potential for machine-type communication (MTC) technology.

articleTitle: QoE-aware Access Node Selection Considering Mobile Edge Computing
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: With the emergence of Mobile Edge Computing (MEC) and Ultra-Dense Network (UDN), the requirements of high user data rate, ultra-low latency and massive number of connection in 5G can be satisfied. However, the access node selection in UDN architecture is getting more complicated due to the introduction of computing resources at the same time. In this paper, we propose an access node selection algorithm, called QoEANS, that takes the Quality of Experience (QoE) into account for the UDN scenarios with MEC. We create the QoE function unified by Mean Opinion Score (MOS) as the performance metric. The latency and energy consumption based pseudo-subjective evaluation method is used to define the QoE function that can meet the real-time requirements of access node selection while focusing on user experience. The simulated annealing algorithm is adopted to solve the problem. Simulation results show that the proposed QoEANS algorithm can improve the QoE significantly, and perform better than the basic access node selection strategy, Maximum Signal to Interference plus Noise Ratio (MaxSINR).

articleTitle: Research on Data filling Algorithm Based on Improved k-means and Information Entropy
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Computer and Communications (ICCC)
abstract: Due to human error, equipment failure and other factors, the industrial Internet platform may generate a part of missing data. In order to fill in the missing data, this paper adopts a data filling method based on improved k-means and information entropy. First, we use the mean or mode to pre-fill the missing data. Then, we change the Euclidean distance in the k-means cluster to the Mahalanobis distance to cluster the data; and within the same category, calculate the similarity between each missing data and all complete data.
